thabs ni stong pa nyid ma yin/ /lta ba rnams las log rnams dang / /bdag tu lta ba 'tshol rnams kyi/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis stong par bstan/ /de phyir dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes/ /bde ba'i thabs kyi sdom pa ste/ /sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid yun ring mi 'gyur/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /mnga' bdag dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /de phyir thabs des bsgrub bya ste/ /thabs ni ston pa'i gzugs can no/ /zhes so/ /de'i don ni/ sh+lau ka dang pos stong pa nyid bsgom pa tsam zhig la gzugs sku sgrub pa'i thabs ma tshang ba'i phyir/ stong nyid bsgom pa gcig pus 'tshang rgya ba mi srid do zhes bstan/ sh+lau ka gnyis pas bdag med pa'i lta ba las log nas bdag gnyis su lta ba rnams kyi bdag 'dzin bzlog pa'i phyir du stong pa nyid bsgom dgos par bstan/ sh+lau ka gsum pas rang nyid da lta nas sangs rgyas kyi sku la nga rgyal bzhag nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom na myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ro zhes gzugs sku sgrub pa'i thabs khyad par ba de bstan/ sh+lau ka bzhi pas 'bras bu ston pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'grub pa la/ sngon du rigs 'dra'i rgyu de dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam bsgom dgos par bstan to/ /'o na ci'i phyir gsang sngags kyi theg pa zhes bya zhe na/gsang zhing sbas pas 'grub la snod min gyi yul min pas de la mi bstan pas na gsang ba'o/ /ji skad du/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ dbang po dang ni yul rnams kyi/ /rkyen gyis gang dang gang phyung yid/ /yid de mān zhes bya bar bshad / /dru ni skyob par byed pa'i don/ /'jig rten spyod las rnam grol bar/ /gang bshad dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /rdo rje kun gyis bsrung ba ni/ /sngags kyi spyod 188—95

pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes so/ /ci'i phyir 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya zhe na/'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi yongs su dag pa bzhi dang rnam pa mthun par/ da lta nyid nas bsgom ste lam bgrod pa'i phyir de skad ces brjod do/ /ci'i phyir rdo rje theg pa zhes bya zhe na/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med par sbyor ba rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ ci'i phyir thabs kyi theg pa zhes bya zhe na/pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las thabs mkhas pa'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ci'i phyir sngags kyi gzhung la rig 'dzin gyi sde snod ces bya zhe na/ rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi dang / grub pa'i mtha' ston pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang sngags la'ang rgyud sde bzhir dbye ste/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud don la 'jug pa las kyang / gsang sngags 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa la ni 'jug pa'i sgo rnam pa bzhi ste/ bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud ces spyir grags pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / /gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i lam la thog mar zhugs nas rgyud sde de dang de'i lam gyi lus rdzogs pa la slob pa'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i gtso bo ni 'dod khams pa yin la/ de yang spyir rig ma'i 'dod yon la chags pa lam du byed pa tsam zhig la mos par khyad par med kyang / lha'i rnal 'byor dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis bsgoms pa'i lha mo la bltas pa'i 'dod chags lam du byed nus shing / de las 'dod chags che ba lam du byed mi nus pa la de tsam gyi 'dod chags lam byed ston pa'i bya ba'i rgyud dang / thabs shes kyis bsgoms pa'i rig ma la ltos par ma zad rgod pa'i 'dod chags kyang lam du byed nus shing / de las rags pa'i 'dod chags lam du byed mi nus pa la de 108—96

tsam gyi 'dod chags lam byed ston pa'i spyod pa'i rgyud dang / thabs shes kyi stobs kyis bsgoms pa'i rig ma'i lag pa 'dzin pa'am/ lus 'khyud pa tsam gyi reg bya la dmigs pa'i 'dod chags lam du byed nus la/ dbang po gnyis sbyor bsgoms pa lam du byed mi nus pa la/ de tsam gyi 'dod chags lam byed ston pa rnal 'byor rgyud dang / bsgoms pa tsam du ma zad dngos kyi rig ma dang dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi 'dod chags kyang lam du byed nus pa la/ de 'dra ba'i 'dod chags lam byed ston pa bla med kyi rgyud gsungs pas bzhir nges pa dang /'dod chags lam du byed pa'i thabs stong pa dang lha'i rnal 'byor gnyis mngon du byed pa khrus la sogs pa'i phyi'i bya ba shin tu mang po la ltos dgos pa'i bya rgyud dang / phyi'i bya ba ha cang mang ba la ltos mi dgos par phyi'i bya ba dang nang gi ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod pa tsam la ltos pa'i spyod rgyud dang / phyi'i bya ba la'ang cung zad ltos shing / nang gi rnal 'byor shin tu gtso bor gyur pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / rnal 'byor de las gong na rim pa gzhan med pas rnal 'byor bla na med pa zhes bya ste/ gdul bya bzhi'i dbang po'i rim pa'i dbang gis / 'dod chags lam du byed pa'i lam rgyud la bskyed pa'i thabs ston tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi po de'i sgo nas rgyud sde bzhir phye ba'ang yin no/ /des na bya ba'i rgyud la rigs drug yod de/ de bzhin gshesas pa'i rigs dang / pad+ma'i rigs / rdo rje'i rigs/ lngas rtsen gyi rigs/ nor can gyi rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sde tshan brgyad de/rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud/ risas kyi bdag po'i rgyud/ rigs kyi yum gyi rgyud/rigs kyi gtsug tor gyi rgyud/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i rgyud/ rigs kyi pho nya'i 188—97

rgyud / rigs kyi bka' nyan gyi rgyud/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud rnams so//rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud ni dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud do/ /rigs kyi yum ni 'od zer can dang gzungs grwa lnga la sogs pa'o/ /rigs kyi gtsug tor gyi rgyud ni gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar la sogs pa'o/ /rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i rgyud ni khro bo rnam par rgyal ba rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud dang /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la sogs pa'o/ /rigs kyi pho nya pho mo'i rgyud ni rdo rje'i be con gyi rgyud dang / rdo rje ro langs kyi rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bka' nyan gyi rgyud ni lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa la sogs pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud ni gza' yum la sogs pa'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs la/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud / pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum gyi rgyud/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i rgyud/bka' nyan pho nya'i rgyud dang lnga'o/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud ni tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo dang / 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa rnams so / /rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud ni thugs rje chen po pad+ma dra ba dang / don yod zhags pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /rigs kyi yum gyi rgyud ni sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa la sogs pa'o/ /rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i rgyud ni rta mgrin gyi rtog pa bdun cu pa dang / par+ṇa sha ba ri'i mdo la sogs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud ni phyir mi ldog pa'i stobs chen gyi mdo dang / dpal chen po'i mdo la sogs pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rigs la yang / rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po / rigs kyi yum/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya pho mo'i rgyud dang 188—98

lnga las dang po ni/ ngan song thams cad sbyong ba mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud dang / 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud dang / rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni me lce 'bar ma'i gzungs zhes bya ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni bdud rtsi thabs sbyor zhes bya ba'o/ /lnga pa ni stobs po che'i gzungs dang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang / rdo rje'i mchu dang / rdo rje'i gnam lcags mchu la sogs pa'o/ /lngas rtsen gyi rigs kyi rgyud ni/ me kha la'i gzungs zhes bya ba yod do/ /nor can gyi rigs ni / nor bu bzang po'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud ni/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo zhes bya ba yod do/ /bya ba spyi'i rgyud la/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ legs grub kyi rgyud/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa/ bsam gtan phyi ma dang bzhi yod do/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs dang gsum las dang po ni rnam snang mngon byang lta bu/ gnyis pa ni rta mgrin gyi rgyud rgyas pa lta bu / gsum pa ni lag na rdo rjes dbang bskur ba'i rgyud lta bu'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la/ rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa/ de'i rgyud phyi ma/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo/dpal mchog dang sbyong rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /de nyid bsdus pa la dum bu bzhi ste/rdor dbyings dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal dang / 'gro 'dul dang / don grub kyi dum bu'o/ /dang po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ gnyis pa rdo rje'i rigs/ gsum pa pad+ma'i rigs/ bzhi pa rin po che'i rigs so/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis las/ dang po dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ mkha' 'gro pha'i rgyud rnams don gcig /188—99

gnyis pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyud rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin no/ /thabs shes gnyis med kyi rgyud ces pa'i thabs dang / thabs rgyud ces pa'i thabs gnyis ming 'dra yang don mi gcig ste/ dang po ni lhan skyes kyi bde ba la byed/ gnyis pa ni sgyu ma'i sku la byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis med kyi rgyud ces pa'i shes rab dang / shes rab kyi rgyud ces pa'i shes rab gnyis ming 'dra yang don mi gcig ste/ dang po ni stong nyid rtogs pa'i blo la byed/ gnyis pa ni bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes la byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na gzugs sku'i rigs mthun gyi rgyu dag ma dag gi sgyu ma'i sku rtsal du bton nas mi 'chad par/ chos sku'i rigs mthun gyi rgyu lhan skyes kyi bde bas stong nyid rtogs pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa'i bla med kyi rgyud dngos sam sder gtogs kyi rgyud de/ ma rgyud ces bya la / mtshan gzhi ni kye rdor dang / bde mchog gi rgyud lta bu'o/ /chos sku'i rigs mthun gyi rgyu bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes rtsal du bton nas 'chad par ma zad/ gzugs sku'i rigs mthun gyi rgyu dag ma dag gi sgyu ma'i sku sgrub tshul rtsal du bton nas 'chad pa'i bla med kyi rgyud dngos sam sder gtogs kyi rgyud de/pha rgyud ces bya la/ mtshan gzhi ni gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'khor lo chen po'i rgyud lta bu'o/ /bla med kyi rgyud yin na gnyis med kyi rgyud yin pas khyab po/ /bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams kyi gzhung gi tshad kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ bde bar gshegs pa 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul yin pa'i phyir/ tshad gzung mi nus kyang rgyud sde 'ga' zhig tu gdul bya'i ngor dgos pa'i dbang gis grangs tshad gsungs pa ni/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ gsang ba 'dus 108—100

pa stong phrag gcig /rdo rje 'phreng ba 'bum phrag gsum/ /dgongs pa lung ston stong phrag bzhi/ /lha mo bzhis zhus brgya bdun cu/ /ut+tar tan+d+ra nyis brgya brgyad / /de yi nye bar bshad pa'i rgyud/ /dam tshig chen po lnga bcu lnga/ /rdo rje lnga 'dus stong phrag gcig /kun las btus pa 'bum phrag gcig /mnyam nyid rnam rgyal nyis brgya bcu/ /zla gsang thig le stong phrag bdun/ /rdo rje sa 'og brgya nyi shu/ /cod pan rdo rje bdun brgya lnga/ /khro zla thig le 'bum phrag lnga/ /rdo rje rnam rgyal brgya dgu brgya/ /mnyam nyid gsang ba stong phrag lnga/ /rdo rje gsang mdzes stong phrag bdun/ nor bu gsang thig 'bum phrag bcu/ /snang mdzad rdzu 'phrul stong dang brgya/ /rdo rje gsang rgyan stong phrag gcig /rdo rje thod pa nyis brgya brgya/ /de nyid brgya stong brgya stong bdun/ /dam tshig mngon rgyan stong phrag gsum/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo 'bum phrag gcig /gsang chen 'dus pa brgya lnga bcu/ /rin chen sdong po dgu brgya bdun/ /dus kyi thig le brgya brgyad cu/ /lha mo bstan chos lnga brgya bdun/ /'di rnams dgongs pa'i bye brag gis/ /nga yis yang dag bstan par bya/ /'di ni gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa yi/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de ltar lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su 'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang grub chen brgyad cu gtso byas sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang sems dang mkhas pa dang grub pa mang po/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par bskyangs te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa dang / lhag par du bod rgyal lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus su bod du dam 108—101

pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa nas bzung / chos rgyal mes dngon rnam gsum dang /mkhan slob chos gsum la sogs pa gtso byas/ mkhas grub gser ri'i phreng ba lta bus bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pa la brten nas/bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di dam pa'i chos kyi zhing sar bsgrubs pas/ gna' nas deng gi bar bod yul chos kyi gling zhes snyan pa'i grags pa dkar po phyogs kun tu khyab pa 'di lags so/ /gong gi 'dis ni bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod zin to//smras pa/ rten 'brel zab mo'i gad rgyangs gcig gis kyang //mu stegs glang po'i snying rtsa 'dar ba dang //lhan cig gangs kyi ri bo mdzes byed pa'i//thub dbang smra ba'i seng chen slar yang dran//zag med sku yi ba spu'i rtse mo rer//rgyal kun bye ba'i mdzad 'phrin lhun rdzogs shing //'gro ba'i yid mkhar sna tshogs zla ba'i ris//snang mdzad sgyu ma'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das//e ma snyigs lnga'i srin mo glal ba'i khar//yang yang chud pa'i dbang med nyam thag 'gror//lhag par brtse bas gzigs pa mi lhod pa//mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po khyod kho na//gang gi tshangs pa'i mgur las rang byung du//'khrol ba'i brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi glu//188—102

skye rgya'i bsod nams zhing gi bum pa'i stor//ci yang 'khyil ba'i bskal bzang 'di rmad byung //rab snyan tshig 'bru'i 'dab ma 'bum du grol//don bzang sbrang rtsi'i ro mchog snying po can//legs gsungs dpal gyi dum bu gsar pa'i ljon//rtag tu bzhad pa'i lang tsho nyams ma gyur//zhes bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam par thar pa dang bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi rnam gzhag mdo tsam brjod pa ste/ skabs dang po rdzogs so// //
phro//skabs gas pa/bka' 'gyar ga tswa ༄de jipar du bsgrubs pa dang dag pe nasgriltar da sdur dang da ga zhus pa la sogs pa'i skor/

༄ga /srid zhi'i gdung ba mtha' dag sel mdzad cing //zhi bsil bdud rtsi'i go 'phang mchog sbyin pa//thub bstan rin chen rtsibs ma brgya pa'i gdugs//'gro 'di'i dpyid du 'khor ba'i rtse dga' 'dzin//rgyal gsung nyi rdul phra mo lhung bas kyang //snying gi mun tshogs 'thor ba 'di 'dra na//gang zhig 'bri dang klog pa'i bsod nams kyi//kun gsal bu mo'i pha mtha' su yis gzhal//rnyed dang bkur sti'i 'du 'dzi rgyang du bsrings//lhag bsam 'o ma'i mngar kha snying la bcangs/bstan la sri zhu bgyid rnams ring zhig nas//legs byas par gyi sgo yang mang du phye//gcig las du mar 'char ba'i rnam 'phrul mkhan//chos sbyin mi zad dpag bsam nor bu bzhin//gyur pa gang la par zhes tha snyad du//springs yig gsal ba phyogs kyi bu mos klog/legs bshad zla stong 'dzum pa'i 'od rlabs rgyun//gus brtson mchu 'dab srab mos nyer 'thungs pas//rnam dpyod g.yu lo rgyas pa'i ge sar gyis//sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'di na nyams su bstar//188—107

de yang mkhas pa'i dbang po dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi zhal nas/ lha gcig phyag na pad+mo mi rje'i tshul/ /lugs gnyis 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug che/ /srid gsum zil gnon srong btsan sgam po yis/ /mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams dbang du bsdus zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir/ legs tshogs thams cad kyi sgo brgya cig car 'byed pa'i byed po/ chos srid lugs gnyis kyi bdag po'am mes po dam par gyur pa/ rgyal po chen po srong btsan sgam po'i ring nas bzung / slob dpon thon mi saṃ bho ṭa gtso byas 'jig rten gyi sgron me lta bur gyur pa'i lo tsā ba brgya phrag mang pos rgya gar dang rgya nag /bal yul dang kha che la sogs pa'i skad du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' dang de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos mang po bod rang gi skad du bsgyur cing zhus pa dang / phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa rnams ni da lta bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid yin la/ de las kyang bka' 'gyur la ni bris ma dang par ma'i rgyun mang du 'phel ba dang / snar thang bka' 'gyur dang tshal pa bka' 'gyur/rgyal rtse them spang ma dang 'phying pa stag rtse bka' 'gyur/ lho rdzong bka' 'gyur dang glo bo bka' 'gyur/ phug brag bka' 'gyur sogs dang / gzhan yang / tshal pa bka' 'gyur las rim bzhin mched pa zhwa li gtsug lag khang gi bka' 'gyur/rin spungs/ rtse thang / gong dkar/ gdan sa mthil gyi bka' bstan 'gyur bris ma mang po dang / da dung si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi phyag bris gser bris bka' 'gyur/ 'brug pa rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i gser bris bka' 'gyur sogs bod dang khyim mtshes rgyal khab mang por bod yig gi bka' 'gyur bris ma bgrang gis mi langs pa byung yod pa lo rgyus rnams su rgyas par gsal bas 'dir bskyar 108—108

zlos kyi ngal ba mi bya'o//dang po/ bka' 'gyur par gzhi khag gi ngo sprod mdor bsdus/de la 'edir rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog par du bsgrubs pa dang de dag ji ltar dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig zhus pa la sogs pa'i skor brjod pa la/ 'dzam gling sa yi dkyil 'khor 'di'i steng du bod yig gi (bka' 'gyur 〉par du bzhengs myong ba'i dpe gzhi khag bcu gnyis tsam bzhugs pa las/ da lta dngos su lag son byung ba par gzhi khag brgyad de (sde dge 〉(g.yung lo 〉〈li thang 〉〈pe cing 〉〈snar thang 〉〈co ne 〉〈khu re 〉〈zhol 〉sogs yin la/ gzhan wan li'i (bka' 'gyur 〉ni g.yung lo'i par ma bskyar brko byas shing / chab mdo'am yab tshang 〈bka' 'gyur 〉ni zhol par ma par slog bgyis pa dang / rwa rgya dang wa ra (bka' 'gyur 〉gnyis ni/ sde par kho na gzhir bzung ba sogs par rtsa gcig tu song ba rnams dpe sdur gyi rin thang chung bas gleng bar mi bya la/ 'dir 〈bka' 'gyur 〉gyi par gzhi khag brgyad las sde dge'i bka' 'gyur (mtshal par)ni dag cing yig gzugs legs pa/ grags che zhing kun gyis khas len pa sogs dge mtshan mang bar dmigs nas bsdur bya'am bsdur gzhi gtso bor (ma yig tu )bzung ba dang /par gzhi gzhan pa khag bdun 〈g.yung 〉〈li 〉〈pe 〉〈snar 〉〈co 〉〈khu 〉〈zhol 〉ni sdur byed kyi par gzhir bzung nas dpe sdur zhus pa yin la/ gang sdur byed kyi par gzhi'i nang du chos tshan dang / le'u/ tshig 'bru sogs chad pa dang / lhag pa/108wa 109

mi 'dra ba/ bskyar zlos/ go rim 'khrugs pa rnams bsdur gzhi'am ma yig tu bsdur mchan dang bsdur 'bras re'u mig gi tshul gyis bkod yod pa sogs te/mdor na sngon gyi ma dpe rnams las cha tshang ba dang / spus dag la tshad mar gyur pa / lta klog dang 'tshol bde ba zhig yin par brten/ sa'i go la 'di'i thog tu bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi par gzhi thams cad kyi khyad chos mi 'dra ba rnams bsdur mchan la brten nas/ dpe bsdur ma 'di'i thog tu gsal lham mer yong bar dmigs shing / nang don thog bcos lhad rtsa ba nas med pa gzhir byas/ dpe skrun thad deng rabs kyi dge mtshan rnam par spyad de/ par du bskrun pa'i bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma 'di'i bsdur bya dang sdur byed kyi par ma khag brgyad ngo sprod mdor bsdus tsam zhu ba la/1 g.yung lo'i bka' 'gyur/g.yung lo'i (bka' 'gyur 〉zhes yongs su grags pa ni/ bod rab byung bdun pa'i lcags stag (spyi lo 1410)lor tā ming rgyal rabs gsum pa gong ma g.yung los tshal pa'i bka' 'gyur la ma phyi byas te grong khyer nan cin nas par du bzhengs pa de la mtshal par ma'am g.yung lo'i bka' 'gyur zhes zer/gong ma g.yung los (bka' 'gyur 〉par du bzhengs rjes rgya bod yi ge gnyis kyis (tā ming rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bka' 'gyur la bstod pa 〉dang / (tā ming rgyal po rang gis mdzad pa'i bstod pa phyi ma 〉 zhes pa'i bstod pa gnyis mdzad cing pod re re bzhin tshar re bkod pa las snga ma'i nang du 6yab yum gyis drin chen pos dang / rab rim pas phan btags pas/ de'i drin bsab par dka' 108wa 110

ba'i don gyis/ gser yig pa mngags nas/ nub phyogs nas bka' 'gyur gdan drangs 'ongs nas/ par du bsgrubs nas/ kun la sbyin pa'i phan yon gyis/yab yum gnyis 'dren par bya ba dang / sems can kun gyi mi 'dzad pa'i bsod nams thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ de lta bu'i phan yon ni brjod kyis mi langs zhes dang 6de'i phyir bstod pa byas shing chos kyi dbu na bris pas/ chos kyi grogs su / phyi rabs pa rnams la rgyud do zhes sogs 'khod cing / bstod pa 'di gnyis ka spyi lo 1410lor g.yung lo khri lo brgyad pa zla ba gsum pa'i tshes dgu'i nyin bris par mngon/(bka' 'gyur 〉'di la rgya yig dang bod yig gi dkar chag re yod cing /bod yig gi dkar chag mdzad byang med pa zhig bzhugs pa'i mtshan la (bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i dkar chag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od 〉ces bya ba de las par gzhi 'di'i ma phyi gang la gzhi byas pa dang / par nam brkos pa sogs 'khod mi 'dug kyang / 6 bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po lots+tsha ba bu ston kha ches rig pa'i gnas lnga'i sgo nas/ so so'i gzhung tshad/ theg pa che chung dang rgyud sde'i rnam dbye / 'gyur byang la sogs gtan la phab pa'i gsung rab kyi rjes su 'brangs nas / 'dir yang 'god par bya'o /zhes 'khod pa ltar bu ston chos 'byung gi mjug tu yod pa'i dkar chag dang cha mtshungs par bkod pa shes so//(bka' 'gyur 〉par gzhi 'di da lta pho brang po ta la dang / se ra theg chen gling du tshar re bzhugs shing / 'di'i snga ma ni tā ming gong ma g.yung los sa skya bdag chen la phul zhing / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs pho brang po ta lar gdan drangs pa la pod gnyis mi tshang zhes bshad/ phyi ma ni spyi lo 1416lor rje 108—111

btsun tsong kha pa'i slob ma byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes la phul ba de yin par grags shing / da dung a mdo bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du'ang tshar gcig bzhugs/(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i sgrig rim ni/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang du byas te rgyud nas dbu brtsams shing / de yang (rgyud 〉kyi skor la pod 2ri (sher phyin 〉gyi skor la pod 2ri (phal po che 〉la pod 6/ (dkon brtsegs 〉la pod 6/ (mdo sde'i 〉skor la pod 32/ 〈'dul ba'i 〉skor la pod 13 / dkar chag bcas bsdoms pas pod brgya dang drug yod do//gzhan yang glegs bam so so'i dbu khang g.yas g.yon du bzhugs pa'i sku brnyan ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun/ bder gshegs so lnga/ bder gshegs mched brgyad/ nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan dang / rgyud sde gong 'og gi yi dam zhi khro'i sku brnyan sogs bzhugs/ g.yung lo'i (bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i khyad chos gtso bo ni/ par gzhi gzhan dag las ches snga zhing / lo rgyus steng du bod yig gi (bka' 'gyur 〉par du bzhengs pa'i thog ma yin no//2 li thang bka' 'gyur/'jang bka' 'gyur ram li thang bka' 'gyur ni/ 'jang rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyis sbyin bdag mdzad de bod rab byung bcu pa'i sa sprel (spyi lo 1608)lo nas dbu brtsams shing / lcags mo bya'i (spyi lo 1621)lo hor zla brgyad par bzhengs grub cing / phyis su dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis par gzhi cha tshang khams li thang dgon du gdan drangs nas bzhugs pa la 'jang par ma'am 108wa 112

li thang mtshal par zhes grags shing / 'di la gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i (bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs can gyi brdas 'dren pa ji snyed pa'i phyi mo par gyi dkar chag thub pa dgyes byed 〉ces bya ba'i dkar chag zhig kyang bzhugs/(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i phyi mo ni/ zhwa dmar sku phreng drug pa gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug tsā ri mtsho dkar du bzhugs skabs 'jang rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan la 〈bka' 'gyur 〉cha tshang par du bzhengs dgos pa'i bkas bskul ba bzhin khas blangs pa dang 'brel/ bod nas ma dpe khungs dag cig gsol ras gnang dgos zhus pa ltar snga phyir 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang / kurma pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ zhwa dmar spyan snga chos kyi grags pa sogs kyis/ zhus dag thengs mang gnang myong ba'i tshal pa'i 〈bka' 'gyur 〉'phyong rgyas 'phying ba stag rtser bzhugs pa de gsol ras su gnang ba de ma phyi zhus pa dang / (dkar chag thub pa dgyes byed 〉du'ang /de yang (bka' 'gyur 〉gyi phyi mo mang yang kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa dus dang bdag po'i sgo nas ming btags pa tshal pa (bka' 'gyur 〉zhes yongs su grags pa gzhin nu shākya rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal ba'i dbang po kurma pa zhwa dmar nag rim par byon pa rnams dang / gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa du ma'i ljags zhus mchan btab brtags shing dpyad par mdzad de/ deng sang bod gangs can 'di na 'gran zla bral ba 'di nyid yin zhes bkod pa ltar ma phyi gtso bo tshal pa (bka' 'gyur 〉yin no//(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i sgrig stangs ni/ theg pa rim 'jug gi dbang du byas te / bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi khongs su gtogs pa/ ('dul ba 108—113

〉lung sde bzhi nas dbu brtsams yod la/ de yang ('dul ba'i 〉skor la pod 13/(sher phyin 〉skor la pod 26/ 〈mdo'i 〉skor la pod 32/ (phal po che 〉la pod 6 / (dkon brtsegs 〉la pod 6/ (rgyud 'bum 〉skor la pod 2ri ('grel pa dri med 'od 〉la pod 1/ dkar chag dang bcas bsdoms pas pod 109yod do//'di'i dbu ldeb kyi lha'i bkod tshul ni/ sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun dang /'khor nyan thos chen po rnams dang / de nas rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ bder gshegs mched brgyad/ nye ba'i sras brgyad/ gnas brtan bcu drug /bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ rgyud ka pa nas ya'i bar dbu khang g.yas su rnam par snang mdzad sogs rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang / g.yon du dbyings phyug ma sogs yum chen mo lnga go rim ltar bsgrigs yod/ 'di ni bod yul du (bka' 'gyur 〉shing par du bzhengs pa'i thog ma yin no//3 khang shis sam pe cing bka' 'gyur/khang shis sam pe cing (bka' 'gyur 〉ni/ bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang du (spyi lo 1682—1700)ching rgyal rabs gnyis pa gong ma khang shis sam bde skyid rgyal pos shing par du bzhengs pa'i (bka' 'gyur 〉te/ 'di nyid par du bzhengs sa pe cing pho brang yin stabs yongs grags su pe cing (bka' 'gyur 〉par gzhi'ang zer/'di nyid thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni/ (bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i dbur bzhugs pa'i (mdzad byang zhu ba'i yi ge 〉zhes pa bka' yi blon po rnams kyis gong ma bde skyid rgyal po la/ bka' 'gyur gyi mgo brjod 'bri rogs zhu ba'i yi ge 188—114

de bde skyid khri lo nyer gnyis pa'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu drug la bris pa yin pa dang / yang (gong ma'i lung gis bsnan nas dpar bzhengs zer ba'i bka' 'gyur do dam byed du bcug pa 〉zhes pa bka' 'gyur do dam byed mkhan gyi las byed pa'i go sa dang / ming tho 'khod pa'i (bod yig )ldeb gnyis can bzhugs pa de'i mjug tu/ rgyal po bde skyid kyi lo sum cu so dgu pa zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bzang por par bzhengs bsgrubs pa'o/ / zhes sogs 'khod pa la gzhigs na /(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i par gzhi thog mar bzhengs pa'i dus ni/ mdzad byang zhu ba'i lo nas brtsi dgos pas/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu phag (spyi lo 1683)lor dbu brtsams shing / mjug rdzogs pa'i dus ni/ rab byung de'i lcags 'brug (spyi lo 1700)lo ste/ gong ma bde skyid rgyal po khri lo so dgu pa'i zla ba bzhi par ngos bzung na 'grig par snyam mo//〈bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i ma phyi ni/ deng dus kyi rtsom yig 'ga' rer wan li'i (bka' 'gyur 〉dpar ma bskyar brko byas pa sogs 'khod kyang / bka' 'gyur 'di'i mdzad byang dang dkar chag (rgya yig )tu mi gsal zhing / gzhan khungs thub kyi yig cha zhig kyang da snga las tu ma son mod/ 〈bka' 'gyur 〉'di dang g.yung lo'i bka' 'gyur gnyis phan tshun zhib bsdur byas tshe pod grangs dang /ldeb grangs/ yig phreng / phreng mtha'i mgo mjug /tha na yi ge nor ba/ mi 'dra ba/chad lhag sogs kyang brgya cha'i nyo bdun tsam 'dra ba las 'di'i ma phyi don dam du g.yung lo'i par gzhi yin pa 'dra'o//(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i sgrig rim ni/ rgyud nas dbu brtsams yod cing / de yang (rgyud 〉kyi skor la pod 25/ (sher phyin 〉gyi skor la pod 2sa 〈dkon 108—115

brtsegs 〉la pod 6/ (phal chen 〉la pod 6/ (mdo sde'i 〉skor la pod 32/〈'dul ba'i 〉skor la pod 13/ bsdoms pas pod 106yod do//gzhan yang glegs bam so so'i dbu khang g.yas g.yon du bkod pa'i sku brnyan ni / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / bder gshegs mched brgyad/ sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun/ bder gshegs so lnga/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs dang /rgyud kyi skor la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo gtso byas rgyud sde rang rang nas byung ba'i lha'i gtso bo rnams bkod yod cing / glegs bam so so'i mjug tu dzam bha la ser po dang / mgon po phyag drug pa/ dpal ldan lha mo/ nor rgyun ma bzhi ka bkod yod do//'di'i par shing ni bkang shus khri lo nyer drug par (spyi lo 1900)rgyal brgyad mnyam 'brel dmag gis brlags par gyur na yang / rab byung bco lnga pa'i mjug tu/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog dang / tsha rong pa zla bzang dgra 'dul gnyis kyi rogs ram la brten nas pe cing (bka' 'gyur 〉dang (bstan 'gyur 〉gnyis tshar re nyi hong rgyal khab kyi grong khyer tho khyo la gdan drangs shing / ta ku'u slob grwa chen mo'i dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs su gsol / spyi lo 1955nas 1958lo'i bar du/ ta ku'u slob grwa chen mo dang / nyi hong bod kyi bka' bstan zhib 'jug khang gis/ pe cing bka' bstan par ma de gnyis brnyan par du bzhengs te 'grem spel zhus pa dang / mtshan byang la (bod kyi bka' bstan chen mo 〉zhes rgya yig gis bris yod cing / dkar chag bcas bsdoms pas deb grangs 151yod la/ de'i dbu'i deb 45〈bka' 'gyur 〉dang / deb zhe drug pa man chad (bstan 'gyur 〉yin/ thengs 'dir dpe sdur 108—116

byed skabs pe cing bka' 'gyur gyi tshab ni brnyan par ma 'dis byas pa yin no//4 cho ne'i bka' 'gyur/co ne'i (bka' 'gyur 〉ni/ mdo smad co ne rgyal rabs bcu gcig pa chos rgyal dmag zor mgon pos/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don la phan par dgongs nas / rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags glang (spyi lo 1721)lo'i hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes bzang por bka' 'gyur par du sgrub pa'i dbu btsugs pa nas lcags phag (spyi lo 1731)lo'i hor zla bzhi pa'i bar/ bgrang bya bcu gcig gi ring la brtson pa chen pos bka' 'gyur cha tshang par du bzhengs te/ co ne dgon chen du bzhugs pa la co ne'i (bka' 'gyur 〉zhes yongs su grags/〈bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i phyi mo ni/ g.yung lo'i par ma dang / li thang par ma/dbus bris kyi (bka' 'gyur 〉bcas gzhir bzung ba dang / de'i zhus chen dang dkar chag 〈co ne'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i dkar chag gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 〉sogs mdzad pa po ni co ne rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub yin no//co de'i bka' bstan gyi par shing yongs rdzogs 1929lo'i dus zing zhig gi skabs su sreg za'i khams su bstims skad/ 1925lor a me ri ku'i mi jo seb rog gis a ri'i rgyal tshogs dpe mdzod khang gi ched du/ co ne'i bka' bstan gnyis ka tshar re blus te rgyal sa wa shing gron du zhus pa dang / bar lam lo shas gong la a ri'i 'dzam gling chos lugs slob gnyer gong spel tshogs pa nas co ne'i (bstan 'gyur 〉spyin shog bzos pas/ 'dzam gling nang bstan slob gnyer khang dang / dpe mdzod khang mang che bar khyab spel byung yod/ gzhan yang da lta ri bo rtse 108—117

lnga'i nub phyogs kun 'dus gling gi dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin lha khang du co de'i bka' bstan par ma rnying pa cha tshang gcig dang / pe cing krung go'i nang bstan mthun tshogs dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba bcas su bka' 'gyur tshar re bzhugs/〈bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i sgrig rim ni rgyud nas dbu brtsams yod cing / de yang (rgyud 〉kyi skor la pod nas (mdo sde'i 〉skor la pod 32/ (sher phyin 〉skor la pod 26/ (dkon brtsegs 〉la pod 6/ (phal po che 〉la pod 6/〈'dul 〉ba'i skor la pod 13/ dkar chag dang bcas bsdoms pas pod 108yod do//(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i dbu lha'i bkod stangs ni gzhan dang mi 'dra bar/sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku nyung zhing / gtso bor rgya bod kyi mkhas grub chen po rnams bkod yod/ de yang 〈rgyud 'bum 〉du rgyud sde rang nas byung ba'i lha'i gtso bo rnams ma bkod par/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad gtso byas rgya gar grub chen las gang chud dang / (mdo'i 〉dbur ston pa dang 'jam dbyangs/ rje tsong kha pa dang rgyal dbang lnga pa/ de nas rim gyis dbu khang g.yas su byams pa dang thogs med nas bzung rgya chen spyod brgyud dang / g.yon du klu sgrub dang zla grags nas bzung zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa rnams bkod yod/ (sher phyin 〉la 'od dpag med sogs sangs rgyas kyi sku 'ga' dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub skor zhig /(dkon brtsegs 〉dang kyiphal chen 〉la sgrol ma nyer gcig /〈'dul bar 〉gnas brtan bcu drug dang nyan thos mchog zung sogs bkod yod do//18(2—118

5 rje dge'i bka' 'gyur/sde dge'i (bka' 'gyur 〉ni/ khams sde dge chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gis sbyin bdag mdzad de bod rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya (spyi lo 1729)nas chu glang (spyi lo 1733)bar bgrang bya lnga'i ngo mthong bar brtson pa chen pos par du bzhengs shing / sde dge dgon chen te lhun grub steng gi par khang chos mdzod chen mor bzhugs pa la sde dge'i mtshal par zhes yongs su grags/(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i yi ge'i phyi mo ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul ni/ bod kyi lo paṇa mang pos brtags shing dpyad nas/ zhus dag mdzad cing mchan bu sogs btab pa gangs ri'i ljongs su khungs thub kyi phyi mor gyur te/ 'phying ba stag rtse'i pho brang du bzhugs pa'i tshal pa bka' 'gyur phyis 'jang yul du spyan drangs nas par du bsgrubs pa'i 'jang ngam li thang (bka' 'gyur 〉ni par gzhi 'di'i ma phyi gtso bor bzung ba dang / de'i steng du sga a gnyan pak+ṣi'i thugs dam gyi rten du gyur pa (bka' 'gyur 〉shin tu dag pa dang / gzhan yang dpe rgyun rnying ma khungs btsun 'ga' zhig la go sdur mdzad cing / mdo stod lho rdzong gi pho brang du bzhugs pa'i (bka' 'gyur 〉yang spyan drangs te/ de dang yang sgo bstun nas par du bsgrubs par bshad do//de yang 〈bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i yi ge mkhan dang zhu dag pa rnams kyi slob ston pa'am zhus chen pa ni/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas sam kurma bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba zhes zhu ba yin te/ khong gis zhus chen mdzad nas dkar chag (bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs can gyi brdas drangs pa'i phyi 788—119

mo'i tshogs ji snyed pa par du bsgrubs pa'i tshul las nye bar brtsams pa'i gtam bzang po blo ldan mos pa'i kun+da yongs su kha bye ba'i zla 'od gzhon nu'i 'khri shing 〉zhes pa mdzad cing / de ni (bka' 'gyur 〉dkar chag rnams las ches rgyas pa zhig go//yang dkar chag de nyid las /kho bo la'ang mi'i dbang po'i bka' nan gser sbram ltar lci ba bstsal bas/ thun mong lcags khyi lo/ dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po'i tshes nas brtsams te/ slar yang zhus dag gi khur blangs pa yin no / / zhes dang / 6 gzhan yang mkhas pa dag gis brtsams pa'i brda legs par sbyor ba'i bstan bcos rnams dang bstun te/ sngon rjes kyi 'jug pa gnyis/ de dgos pa ci'i phyir tshul ji ltar 'jug pa/ de so so'i rtags kyi dbye ba dang dus gsum gyi sgrub pa tha dad pa/ de la'ang spyir btang dmigs bsal/ tshig phyi ma dang sbrel ba'i mtshams sbyor/ rnam dbye dang tshig phrad la sogs pa tshul ji lta ba bzhin du bgyis te/ kho bos ngag bkod byas pa bzhin du blo gsal gzhan dag gis lan mang du bsgrags nas zhus dag legs par bgyis shing / dogs gnas che ba rnams dpyis phyin par rang nyid kyis gtan la phab ste/ gsung rab bzhugs tshogs ches pa dang / zhus dag mkhan po blo gros dman pas phye ma leb kyis nam mkha'i mtha' nyul ba lta bur gyur pa'i phyir ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtog pa gtan med do zhes smra bar mi nus kyang / sngon ṭī na'i yul du gong ma tā ming g.yung lo chen pos bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par bzhengs pa dang / 'di nyid kyi ma phyi sa tham rgyal pos bzhengs pa 'di sogs las khyad par du 'phags shing dpyod ldan gyis yid rton pa'i gnas su 'os par sems so/ / zhes gsungs pa 708—120

ltar / (bka' 'gyur 〉dpe bsdur ma'i bsdur bya'i ma yig kyang sde dge'i 〈bka' 'gyur 〉'dis byas pa yin no//〈bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i sgrig rim ni/ li thang par ma dang cha mtshungs par bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi khongs su gtogs pa/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi nas dbu brtsams yod cing / de yang ('dul ba'i 〉skor la pod 13/(sher phyin 〉skor la pod 21/ (phal po che 〉la pod ri dkon brtsegs 〉la pod 6/ (mdo sde'i 〉skor la pod 32/ (rgyud 〉kyi skor la pod 20/ (gzungs 'dus 〉la pod 2/ ('grel pa dri med 'od 〉la pod 1/ (rnying rgyud 〉la pod 3/dkar chag bcas bsdoms pas pod 103bzhugs/glegs bam so so'i dbu khang g.yas g.yon gyi lha'i 'god stangs ni/ ('dul bar 〉bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun gtsor byas/ dgra bcom pa chen po rnams dang / rim gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / bder gshegs so lnga/ nye ba'i sras brgyad/ skabs dang 'brel ba'i zhu ba po sogs dang / 〈rgyud 'bum 〉du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo gtso byas rgyud sde gong 'og dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dang /chos srung / nor lha/ gter bdag sogs dang / dkar chag gi dbur ston pa shākya thub pa dang / 'jam dbyangs/ sa skya paṇa chen/ bu ston rin chen grub sogs kyi sku brnyan bzhengs yod do//(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i par shing ni da lta sde dge'i par khang chos mdzod chen mor bzhugs shing / skye rgya'i bsod nams kyi zhing du gtan pa med pa'i chos sbyin 'gyed bzhin pa 'di yin no//108—121

6 snar thang bka' 'gyur/〈snar thang bka' 'gyur 〉zhes yongs su grags pa ni/ sngon tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos (spyi lo 1683 1706)sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la/ dbus ljongs su (bka' 'gyur 〉shing par bzhengs dgos pa'i bka' gnang bar brten/ (yum 〉rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gtsos pa'i pod nyi shu rtsa brgyad tsam par bzhengs gnang yang las rgyun lo bdun tsam 'gor zhing yun ring ma song bar tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mdzad 'phrin la bar chad byung ba dang /sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yang rgyal po lha bzang gi btsun mos bgrongs shing /par bzhengs 'phro can du lus/ de'i rjes stag rtse zhabs drung lha rgyal rab brtan/da'i ching pā dur bsod nams rgyal po sogs kyis/ rim par 'phro bskyangs kyang mtha' ma 'khyol bar lus/ phyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags khyi (spyi lo 1730)lor mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis sbyin bdag bkod khyab gnang ste/ par gzhi bzhengs 'phro mthud de lo ngo gcig tsam gyi ring la mjug yongs su rdzogs par grub nas (bka' 'gyur 〉par shing rnams paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes la phul nas snar thang dgon par bzhugs su gsol ba la snar thang 〈bka' 'gyur 〉zhes yongs su grags/'di la dkar chag ni 'ol kha sle lung rin po che blo bzang 'phrin las kyis (bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung par srid gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta'i dkar chag ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i lde mig 〉ces bya ba mdzad cing / bka' 'gyur 'di'i phyi mo gang la gzhi bzung ba'i tshul ni/ dkar chag de nyid las 708—122

gsung par 'di nyid 'go 'dzugs gnang dus tshal pa bka' 'gyur dang khrigs mthun par ljags bkod gnang zhing dus phyis mi dbang chos rgyal chen pos 'phro mthud mdzad dus/ shar phyogs ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khab chen po nas rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i rang gzugs/ gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos mi rje 'di nyid la bstsal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che tshal pa'i bka' 'gyur dang khrigs mthun par snang bas/ de nyid dang go rim mthun par bsgrigs zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di'i ma phyi ni tshal pa (bka' 'gyur 〉yin no//〈bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i sgrig rim ni/ chos 'khor gsum bskor ba'i rim pa dang mthun par bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi nang tshan 'dul ba lung sde bzhi nas dbu brtsams shing / de yang ('dul ba'i 〉skor la pod 13/〈sher phyin 〉skor la pod 21/ (dkon brtsegs 〉la pod 6/ 〈phal po che 〉la pod 6/ (mdo sde'i 〉skor la pod 31/ (myang 'das 〉la pod 2/ (rgyud 〉kyi skor la pod 21/ kha skong la pod 1/ dkar chag dang bcas pod 102yod do//(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i dbu lha'i 'god stangs ni/ sde tshan so so'i glegs bam dang por dbu lha re bzhugs pa ma gtogs/ pod yongs khyab tu bkod mi 'dug la/ de yang thog mar ston pa shākya thub pa dang nyan thos mchog zung / rim gyis sher phyin ma dang dbyangs can ma/ spyan ras gzigs dang tshe lha rnam gsum/rdo rje 'chang dang byams 'jam dbyangs sogs bzhengs yod do//7 khya re'i bka' 'gyur/phyi sog khu re'i 〈bka' 'gyur 〉ni/ phyi sog u sga'i chos sde chen po tā khu 108—123

re'am / deng sang mong gol rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa u lan pā thur gyi dga' ldan dgon zer ba nas sde dge'i par ma gzhir bzung nas bka' 'gyur par bzhengs dbu brtsams kyang mjug ma rdzogs par lus pa la/ khal kha rje btsun dam pa sku phreng brgyad pa chos kyi nyi ma mchog dang / er ti ni che tshang no yon don grub lha mo rnam gnyis kyis/ par gzhi cha tshang legs sgrub dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba ltar/slar yang rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa sprel (spyi lo 1908)lor mu mthud las ku'i 'phro bskyangs nas/ lo ngo gnyis tsam gyi ring la par gzhi cha tshang legs par grub nas tā khu re chos sde chen mor bzhugs su gsol ba la khu re (bka' 'gyur 〉zhes yongs su grags shing / 'di'i phyi mo sde par yin par ma zad/ sde dge'i par ma bskyar brko byas pa dang mtshungs par ldeb grangs dang / yig phreng / phreng mtha'i mgo mjug sogs kyang phal che ba 'dra bar snang ngo //'di la dkar chag 〈〈dge mtshan 'bum phrag phyogs mthar 'phel bar byed pa'i skye ba lnga pa'i sgra dbyangs 〉〉zhes pa bzhugs shing / mdzad pa po ni khal kha rje btsun dam pa chos kyi nyi ma yin no//(bka' 'gyur 〉'di'i sgrig rim ni/ spyir theg pa mtho dman gyi dbang du bgyis nas (rgyud sde'i 〉skor rnams dang por bkod de/ rim par theg pa che chung gi sde snod rnams go rim ltar 'god pa'i lugs dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rim pa dang mthun par bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi khongs su gtogs pa 〈'dul ba lung sde bzhi 〉dang por 'chad pa'i lugs gnyis su mchis pa las/ 'dir gnyis pa'i dbang du byas te ('dul ba'i 〉skor la pod 13/(sher phyin 〉la pod 21/ (phal chen 〉la pod sa dkon brtsegs 〉la pod 6/188—124

(mdo sde'i 〉skor la pod 32/ mdo gsar 'gyur la pod 1/ (rgyud 'bum 〉la pod 20/ (rnying rgyud 〉la pod 3/ 〈gzungs bsdus 〉la pod 2/ ('grel pa dri med 'od 〉la pod 1/ bsdoms pas 103yod do//'di'i dbu lha'i 'god stangs ni/ mgo mjug bar gsum sde par dang 'dra ba yin no/// lha sa'am zhol bka' 'gyur/lha sa'am zhol 〈bka' 'gyur 〉ni/ bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcags sprel (spyi lo 1920)lor gong sa rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa mchog la/ 'bri gong sgo lcog sprul sku nges don bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang po nas/ deng snar thang gi gsung par bgres skyon che zhing / li thang dang sde dge'i bka' 'gyur 'di phyogs su dpe rgyun dkon pas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung par gsar du bzhengs rgyu thugs rjes 'dzin par 'tshal zhes dngul ṭaṃ rdo tshad 1075dngos 'bul dang bcas gsol ba btab pa ltar dgyes pa chen pos zhal gyis bzhes pa dang /gzhan yang dad ldan ser skya khag nas par gyi zhal 'debs byung ba rnams kyi thog nyer mkho ci dgos bod gzhung nas zad len lhur bskyangs bzhes te/ snar thang par ma dang rgyal rtse'i them spang ma/ sde dge'i (bka' 'gyur 〉sogs ma dpe khungs thub rnams gzhir bzung nas lha ldan du par du bzhengs pa'i dbu brtsams kyang / ring po ma thogs par sgo lcog sprul sku dang / rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa rnam gnyis snga phyir sku gshegs pas par bzhengs kyi bya ba re zhig 'phro can du lus/phyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che dang rgyal ba'i gcung srid blon kun dga' dbang 188—125

phyug rnam gnyis kyis 'phro skyong mdzad par brten rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi (spyi lo 1934lor (bka' 'gyur 〉pod brgya tham pa'i bdag nyid can gyi par gzhi cha tshang bzhengs shing legs par grub pa pho brang chen po po ta la'i 'dabs zhol gangs can phan bde'i gter mdzod gling du bzhugs pa la yongs grags su lha sa'am zhol 〈bka' 'gyur 〉zhes zer ro//de yang par gzhi 'di la mtshan zhabs pa stag brag sprul sku ngag dbang gsung rab mthu thob bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / ser smad rgyal dbang sprul sku ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab rgya mtsho/ mtshan zhabs tsha sprul ngag dbang blo bzang / ser byes o tog sprul sku byams pa mchog ldan / lho pa dge slong thub bstan gsung rab/ co ne dge bshes blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs mkhas dbang du mas zhus dag legs par mdzad cing / da dung mtshan zhabs pa rnam gnyis kyis 'di'i dkar chag (bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bka' gangs can 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi gsung par 'dzam gling spyi nor gyi dkar chag legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig 〉ces pa'ang mdzad do//yang zhol par ma 'di'i skor la bod yul mdo dbus khams gsum du/ gleng tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shig mchis shing / 'ga' res po ta la'i par ma dang /lha sa'i par ma zhes par gzhi khag gnyis su 'dod pa dang / yang kha cig gis zhol (bka' 'gyur 〉'di la/ rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos tshig don gnyis char bzo bcos mang po brgyab ces de 'dra mthong chen du mi brtsi ba'ang yod par snang la/ de ni de 'dra'i 'dod lugs 'dzin pa dag gis skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos gsal bor ma rtogs shing / 〈bka' 'gyur 〉gyi dpe khag mang 708—126

po thar chags 'bru 'ded kyis zhib sdur ma mdzad par/ 'ol tshod kyis smras par snyam zhing / don dam du lha ldan gyi par bzhengs skabs rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis thengs 'gar 'phro can du lus pa la/ par gzhi 'di las gzhan zhig logs su med la/ zhus chen mdzad skabs kyang gtso bo snar thang par ma la bstun pas/〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gnyis kyi yi ge chad lhag dang yi ge mi 'dra ba sogs phal che ba phyogs mthun par snang ba mthong na som nyi'i mdud rgya rang grol du 'gyur ro//par gzhi 'di'i nang du tshig phrad kyi 'jug tshul sogs brda sprod kyi gzhung dang mthun la tshig gi gcod mtshams kyi shad 'jog stangs kyang dpe khag gzhan dag las ches zhib tshags dang ldan pa yin no//'on kyang / 〈sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa 〉las lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi pa mthong lam rgyas bshad kyi skabs su sde dge'i par mar (bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i deb bco brgyad pa'i ldeb 418nga12— 456nga13bar )dpag tu med pa'i 'gres rkang zhig gsar du bsnan yod pa dang / zhol par mar (pod ca pa'i ldeb 245ba1 269na4bar )dpag med kyi mdo tshan dor nas lung dang rigs pa'i sgrub byed dang bcas te/ tshad ma med pa'i 'gres rkang zhig gsar du bsnan yod pa sogs ni gzur gnas mkhas dbang rnams kyis dpyad par bya ba'i gzhi yin no//bka' 'gyur 'di'i sde tshan so so'i sgrig stangs ni/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi nas dbu brtsams shing / de yang ('dul ba'i 〉skor la pod 13/ 〈sher phyin 〉gyi skor la pod 21/ (phal chen 〉la pod 6/ (dkon brtsegs 〉la pod 6/〈mdo sde'i 〉skor la pod 30/ (myang 'das 〉la pod 2/ (rgyud 'bum 〉la pod 108—127

18 / (rnying rgyud 〉la pod 3/ dkar chag bcas bsdoms pas pod brgya tham pa yod pa dang / 'di'i rnying rgyud pod gsum ni rgyud kyi pod rtags dza wa zha gsum ste / dkar chag 〈legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig 〉las gsungs pa ltar bkod pa yin no//'di'i dbu lha'i 'god stangs ni/ sde tshan so so'i dbur bkod pa las/ pod re re bzhin bkod mi 'dug la/ de yang ('dul bar 〉mtshon na/ ka dum pa'i ldeb dang po'i dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du gnas brtan nye bar 'khor dang yon tan 'od/ ldeb gnyis par 'jam mgon tsong kha pa dang rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa/ ('bum 〉gyi ldeb dang po'i dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs/ ldeb gnyis par bkod pa'i dbu lha ni rje btsun tsong kha pa dang / rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho rnam gnyis te/ 'di gnyis ni sde tshan thams cad la 'dra ba yin/ (nyi khri 〉la dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du shā ri'i bu dang mod gal gyi bu/ (khri brgyad 〉du dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du shākya 'od dang gser gling pa/ (brgyad stong 〉par dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du klu sgrub dang thogs med/ 〈phal chen 〉la dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dang kun tu bzang po/ (dkon brtsegs 〉la dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po dang sa yi snying po/ (bskal bzang 〉la dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du mar me mdzad dang byams pa mgon po / (myang 'das 〉la dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du sgrib pa rnam sel dang phyag na rdo rje/ (rgyud 'bum 〉la dbus su rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / g.yas g.yon du chos rgyal zla ba bzang po dang rigs ldan pad ma dkar po/ dkar chag tu ldeb 188—128

dang po'i dbus su ston pa/ g.yas g.yon du srong btsan sgam po dang thon mi saṃ bho ṭa / ldeb gnyis pa'i dbus su jo bo a ti sha /g.yas g.yon du rje btsun tsong kha pa dang rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho/ mjug tu myur mdzad mgon po/ dam can chos rgyal / lha mo re ma ti/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ srog bdag bag tse/ rdo rje legs pa rtsal/ dgra lha'i gtso bo ste/ mdor na mgo mjug bar gsum du dbu lha'i grangs 63yod do// par gzhi 'di'i par shing da lta zhol par khang chen mo gangs can phan bde'i gter mdzod gling du bzhugs shing / ris med 'gro la zad du med pa'i chos sbyin gyi nyi 'od 'gyed bzhin pa lags so//gnyis pa/ de dag ji ltar dpe sdur byas pa'i skor/gnyis pa de dag ji ltar dpe sdur byas pa'i skor brjod pa la/ gong gsal gyi bsdur bya sde dge'i par ma dang sdur byed kyi par gzhi khag bdun phan tshun zhib mor gtugs shing bsdur nas byung ba'i 'bras bu la lhag pa dang / chad pa/ mi 'dra ba ste gtso bo rigs gsum du yod pa'i steng la/ bskyar zlos dang go rim 'khrugs pa sogs kyang bsdur mchan du bkod yod la/ bsdur bya'i sde par du ma byung zhing sdur byed kyi par gzhi khag tu yod pa'i chos tshan rnams las gang dag cing gsal ba de bsdur bya'i ma yig tu bsnan nas bsgrigs pa dang bsdur mchan gyi mgor gsal bshad kyang zhus yod par ma zad/ bsdur 'bras re'u mig tu gang la chad pa'i dpe khag de'i re'u mig stong par bskyur yod/188—129

1 lhag pa'i skor/sdur byed kyi par gzhi khag gi nang du/ bya tshig dang ming tshig /phrad dang rnam dbye sogs lhag pa dang / sho lo ka dang tshig rkang lhag pa/ tha na bskyar zlos ma yin par ldeb ngos 'ga' re lhag pa byung tshe/ bsdur bya'i ma yig gi khyad par byung ba'i mtshams su bsdur mchan ang rtags (1)dang / sdur byed kyi par gzhi'i bsdus ming (〈g.yung 〉 〈li 〉 〈pe 〉 〈snar 〉 〈co 〉 〈khu 〉 〈zhol 〉)gi rjes su lhag rtags( ) / lhag pa'i yig 'bru rnams gcig kyang ma chad par bkod yod pa dper na//ma yig tu /ltung ba yod 1la dran bzhin du mi mthol na//bsdur mchan du 11〈snar 〉〈zhol 〉 pa/ lta bu tshig 'bru gcig lhag pa dang //ma yig tu /sdom la/ 1dben pa skyabs yod 'dug pa'o///bsdur mchan du 11〈li 〉〈pe 〉〈co 〉 'dod byar rung dang mi rung ba'i/ /zhes pa lta bu tshig rkang gcig lhag pa lta bu'o//2 chad pa'i skor/sdur byed kyi par gzhi khag gi nang du/ yig 'bru dang tshig thung ngu chad pa/ de las mang ba ldeb ngos gcig lta bu chad pa byung tshe/ ma yig gi ngos su mtshams rtags ( )dang / bsdur mchan ang rtags dang / bsdur mchan du bsdur mchan ang rtags dang / sdur byed kyi par gzhi'i bsdus ming / chad rtags/—)/ chad pa'i yig 'bru dang tshig thung ngu rnams ji bzhin bkod yod la/ sho lo ka dang tshig ring sogs chad pa byung tshe/ bsdur mchan du sdud rtags kyis tshig bar bsdus te bkod yod pa dper na/188wa 130

/ma yig tu )dge slong gang tsho15ltung ba byung ba rnam par dag par//bsdur mchan du 11)〈g.yung 〉〈li 〉〈pe 〉〈co 〉 gang / lta bu yig 'bru gcig chad pa dang //ma yig tu /tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag de skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed cag dge yang rung / sdig kyang rung / dge slong 'di la ci yang ma smra zhig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 3 dge slong 'di ni//bsdur mchan du )915〈snar 〉 ces/ tshe dang ldan pa tshe dang ldan pa dag /ces pa lta bu tshig ring po chad pa lta bu'o//3 mi 'dra ba'i skor/ga don 'dra la 'gyur mi 'dra ba dang / bya tshig dang ming tshig mi 'dra ba/phrad dang rnam dbye mi 'dra ba sogs phal che ba gtsang sdur byas te/ bsdur mchan du bkod cing / de yang mi 'dra ba rnams yig 'bru mang nyung la ma ltos par rtsa ba'i thog mi 'dra bar byas te mchan btab yod pa dper na//ma yig tu /byas so1///bsdur mchan du )1〈li 〉〈co 〉pa lta bu yin no/ /zhes par ma31na na (sde 〉la yig 'bru nyung zhing dpe khag gzhan la mang ba lta bu//ma yig tu /med pa'i sems kun du bzang po'i 1sems can//bsdur mchan du /1〈g.yung 〉〈pe 〉pa dang / zhes par mtshon na (sde 〉la yig 'bru mang zhing dpe khag gzhan la nyung ba lta bu'o//kha skabs rer bsdur mchan 'god lugs kyi dbang gis mi 'dra ba dang chad 188wa 131

rtags mnyam du byung yod pa dper na//ma yig tu 1 byang chub sems dpa' chen po'ishedage 'dun//bsdur mchan du 11)(g.yung 〉〈pe 〉byang sems kyi/ 〈snar 〉〈zhol 〉 byang chub/ ces pa lta bu'o//ga dpe khag mi 'dra ba yin tshe chad pa dang / lhag pa/ mi 'dra ba gsum bsdur mchan ang rtags gcig gis mtshon thub par byas yod pa dper na//ma yig tu /gal te rdzun stims pa yin na//bsdur mchan du )17〈g.yung 〉 rdzun/ 〈co 〉brdzun/ 〈snar 〉〈zhol 〉 du/ zhes pa lta bu'o / /nga bka' 'gyur dpe sdur skabs mi 'dra ba thams cad bsdur rgyu'i rtsa don gzhir bzung nas bsdur dgos kyang / par 'bru chag skyon dang brkos nor byung ba / sbyor klog mi bde ba/ sngags yig ma yin pa'i gug gu phyir log can/ par gzhi mi gsal ba/ pa dang ba/ nga dang da'i khyad par sogs la gdam gses ci yang med par thams cad bsdur mchan du gcal du bkram ste bkod na/ rnyog che zhing dgos pa chung bas bkod med do//(1) par 'dru chag skyon/ par 'bru chag skyon ni dpe khag thams cad la 'byung mod/ gtso bo (g.yung 〉la mang che ste/ dper na/ rnye stong nyid la 6song nyid milta bu ming gzhi chag pa/ 6stong nyad lta bu dbyangs chag pa/ the com lta bu tsa rtags chag pa/ ‘ 'gub po lta bu ra btags chag pa sogs dang / skabs rer yig phreng re'i dbyangs dang tsa tsha dza'i phod sogs chag yod pa rnams sde par sor bzhag gis bsgrigs yod pa las mchan btab med do//188—132

(2) par 'bya brkos nor/ par 'bru brkos nor byung ba ni gtso bo 〈li 〉la mang ste/ dper na/ /'di la 'id dang 2'dod la 'odad lta bu ming gzhi'i dbyangs rnams 'phul yig gi steng du byung ba dang /yang stong nyid la stong nyid dang rdzogs sto la /rdzogs sto lta bu ta dang ha gnyis nor bar brkos pa sogs ha cang mang yang / 'dir gsal bshad kyis 'thus par byas te bsdur mchan du bkod med do//(3) smyor klog mi bde ba/ sbyor klog mi bde ba ni 〈g.yung 〉kho nar mang che ba yin te/ dper na/ ru sdig pa la 6 drisag pa dang / /'bre sog lam 'apes ga snye 'khor lo la lokhor lo dang / (sman ljongs la (smano ljodab lta bu brda sprod kyi 'gros dang mi mthun pa rnams phal che ba bsdur mchan du bkod med do//'on kyang / mtshams rtags kyis bcad pa'i nang du dpe khag kha shas mi 'dra ba dang / 〈g.yung 〉la mi 'dra ba dang sbyor klog mi bde ba gnyis mnyam du byung ba dgos dbang gis re gnyis shig mchan du bkod yod pa dper na//ma yig tu 1 sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis71/bsdur mchan du )1〈g.yung 〉de gzhin gshesab pas/ (li 〉〈co 〉de bzhin gshegs pas/〈snar 〉〈zhol 〉 sangs rgyas/ lta bu'o//(4) sngags yig ma yin pa'i gug gu phyir log can/ sngags yig ma yin pa'i gug gu phyir log can ni tun hong gter yig dang / rdo ring sogs su gsal ba'i gna' bo'i yig gzugs 'bri stangs gug gu phyir log can rnams dang mi 'dra bar / 'di ni 〈g.yung 〉〈pe 〉gnyis gtsos dpe khag gzhan la'ang skabs rer 'byung la/ de yang phreng gong ma'i yi ge de rtseg can nam dbyangs can/ yang na 108wa 133

tsheg khyim sngon ma'i ming gzhi la dbyangs dang tsa tsha dza'i rtags yod pa sogs kyis 'bri stabs ma bde bas phyir log tu bris pa yin pas de dag la mchan btab med do / /(5) par gzhi mi gsal ba/ par gzhi mi gsal ba ni 〈sde 〉〈zhol 〉gnyis las gzhan dpe khag drug po yang dpar dang bskyar dpar mang du byas nas lag son byung ba yin stabs/ mtshams rer snag 'byams su song ba dang / skabs rer yig 'bru chung drags pa sogs kyis par gzhi mi gsal ba rnams mchan du bkod med do//(6) pa ba dang / da nga'i khyad par/ pa ba dang / da nga'i khyad par rnams tshig grogs dang don thob la ma bltas par gzugs sdur kho na byas te mchan du btab na nor ba rdzogs med cig 'byung bas mchan bkod med pa dang / ming mtha'i tshig grogs kyi dbang gis pa dang ba re gnyis tsam bsdur mchan du bkod yod pa dper na//ma yig tu 1 bzung ba 1dang //bsdur mchan du /1〈snar 〉〈zhol 〉bzungs pa/ lta bu'o//tsa sde dge'i par du da drag yod med la ma ltos par skabs reram kun tu dang 6rgyun tu zhes 'byung la/ lan rer kun du midang rgyun du zhes go rim la nges pa med pa dang / 6pha rol tu phyin la /pha rold tu phyind ces na ra la gsum gyi rjes su da drag dngos su yod med ci rigs 'byung zhing / dpe khag gzhan thams cad la yang mgo mjug bar gsum du mi 'dra bar ma zad/6 khab tu la khab du sogs tu dang du miganyis thob thang nor ba dang / de bzhin du kyi 108wa 134

dang /gyi gnyis kyang gcig gyur min par gang 'dod du byung yod pa sogs yig tshogs skyung phyir mchan btab med do//cha seṅge la /seng ge dang / 6 tsan+dan la 6tsan dan / snye gaṅgā la gang hā /6 pad+ma la 6pad ma / ‘ ut+pal la snye.ud pal zhes sogs dang / gzhan yang rgyud kyi skabs su mārba la mār tha dang / ‘ bud+dha la (bud dha / (dharma lam dhar ma /sogs rgyun spyod kyi sngags yig brtsegs min gyi khyad par ram/ rgya bod kyi yig gzugs 'bri lugs mi 'dra ba rnams dang / yang / kai ka ra la (kang ka ra dang / che so gha la smyosang gha / ‘ s+t+waṃ bha ya la 6stam+bha yo / snye nir+sā la nir yā sogs don 'dra la/ klog tshul gyi dbang gis mi 'dra bar bris yod pa rnams dang / da dung rgyu dang hūm̐ / zhe rgyu midang 8rgyu / 6ཿ dang 8: milta bu sngags yig la zla tshes yod med kyi khyad par shin tu che zhing / skabs rer bsdur gzhi'i par mar sngags yig zla tshes can mang zhing / zur blta'i par mar med la/ mtshams rer zur blta'i par mar mang zhing bsdur gzhir mi 'dug pas/ thams cad bsdur mchan du bkod na mang drags pas/ 'dir sde par sor bzhag gis bsgrigs yod pa las mchan btab med do//nga shad kyi skor/ spyir bod yig gi tshig mtshams sogs mtshon pa'i rtags gtso bo ni shad yin la/ de la yang sna tshogs shig mchis mod/ thengs 'di'i dpe sdur skabs chig shad bsdur tshe/ dpe khag so so'i tshig gi gcod mtshams mi 'dra bas / bsdur mchan rdzogs med cig 'byung ba dang / nyis shad dang bzhi shad sogs kyang brda sprod kyi lugs dang mi mthun par ci dgar bzhag 'dug la/lhag par du li thang par ma lta bur mtshon na le'u dang bam po'i rdzogs mtshams su 108—135

bar stong che chung dang bstun te shad bco lnga nyi shu re bzhag pa'ang 'byung bas de rnams bsdur kyang dgos pa cher ma mthong bas mchan btab med pa dang / ma yig tu'ang shad dang tsheg rnams gcig gyur min pas de dag thob thang ltar dag par bcos yod do//4 go rim 'khrugs pa'i skor/ 'dir go rim 'khrugs pa zhes pa ni ming dang tshig 'bru re gnyis tsam ma yin par/ tshan pa dang le'u'i snga phyi'i go rim 'khrugs pa dang / tha na ldeb phreng 'ga' re'i go rim 'khrugs pa sogs yin zhing / de dag bsdur mchan du chad lhag gi rtags kyis mtshon yod la/ gang chad rtags kyis mtshon pa'i ma yig gi khyad par byung ba'i mtshams su/ g.yung drung gi rtags dang bsdur mchan ang rtags brgyab yod cing / bsdur mchan du go rim nor ba'am/'khrugs pa de rigs snga phyi'i ldeb phreng gang du yod pa sogs ni tshig bsdus kyis gsal bshad byas yod pa dang / yang dpe khag 'gar par rtsa sbyar nor byung ba'i dbang gis ldeb grangs phan tshun gyi srib ngos gnyis nor bar brkos te 'khrugs yod pa rnams mchan du btab med do//5 bskyar zlos kyi skor/ bskyar zlos ni ming tshig re gnyis tsam min par/sdur byed kyi par gzhi khag tu yig phreng 'ga' re'am yang na ldeb ngos 'ga' re lhag pa byung tshe dpe khag de'i mgo mjug thams cad du zhib lta byas rjes/ gal te bskyar zlos yin na bsdur mchan du bsdur mchan yong ki/ par gzhi khag gi bsdus ming /lhag rtags sogs kyis mtshon te gsal bshad byas yod pa dper na/1)〈g.yung 〉 de bzhin du bud myed kha cig la yang nyes dmigs rnam pa lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ khro 108—136

ba dang / khon du 'dzin pa dang / 'khu ba dang / byas pa myi gzo ba dang / dug rno ba'o/ /(gong gi dum bu 'di /deb 'di'i ldeb 1 —7 bar 1(g.yung 〉la bskyar zlos su 'khod/)lta bu'o//6 gsal bshad kyi skor/ma chos tshan gyi mtshan byang gsal bshad/ chos tshan gyi mtshan byang gsal bshad ni 'dir bstan 'gyur dang mi 'dra bar mtshan byang 'phar ma sogs med la / mtshan byang logs su snon dgos pa'ang nyung zhing / gtso bo ma yig gi dbu'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod pa'am/ chos tshan de'i mjug byang las blangs te bkod yod pa dper na/(mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/)ces dang / yang ('dul ba gzhi 〉lta bu chos tshan gcig la pod bzhi tsam byung ba yin na/ pod kha pa nas bzung 'di ltar/ (mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i stod 'dul ba ka dum pa'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/) lta bu/kha bsdur mchan gyi gsal bshad/ bsdur mchan gyi gsal bshad ni gtso bo bsdur bya dang sdur byed kyi par gzhi khag tu bya tshig dang ming tshig /phrad dang rnam dbye sogs mi 'dra ba'i rigs gcig mgo mjug bar gsum du bstud mar byung tshe / yig tshogs skyung phyir gsal bshad gcig gis 'thus par byas yod pa dper na/(chos tshan 'di'i nang du ma ga dhā zhes pa rnams (g.yung 〉〈li 〉〈pe 〉〈co 〉la ma ga dha zhes 'khod kyang gsham du bsdur mchan du bkod med/)ces dang /yang gsal bshad kyi rigs de dpe gzhi 'gar mgo mjug thams cad du 'dra zhing ske/ dpe khag gcig tsam la mi 'dra ba byung tshe/ (chos tshan 'di'i nang du gso 188—137

sbyong zhes pa rnams 〈g.yung 〉〈pe 〉la gso sbyin dang / 〈snar 〉la skabs 'gar gso sbyin zhes 'khod kyang gsham du bsdur mchan du bkod med/)ces pa lta bu'o//yang chos tshan gcig la pod 'ga' re yod tshe de'i bsdur mchan gsal bshad kyi 6chos tshan zhes pa dor nas 6pod ces sbyar yod do//ga dkar chag gi zur mchan/ dkar chag gi zur mchan ni gtso bo le'u dang sa bcad kyi go rim mi 'dra ba/ grangs la mang nyung yod pa/ le'u'i mtshan mi gsal ba sogs yin la/ dgos dbang gis tshan grangs dang thod yig sogs kyang zur mchan du gsal bshad byas pa'ang yod/ 〈sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa 〉lta bur mtshon na le'u bdun cu don gnyis bzhugs pa las/ le'u'i mtshan re gnyis tsam las mi gsal bas/ de dag gcig gyur dang lta klog bde ba'i ched du 'grel pa sogs la bstun nas le'u'i mtshan bkod de gsal bshad byas yod pa dper na/('dir le'u'i mtshan ma yig tu mi gsal ba rnams bstan 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i deb nga gsum pa'i chos tshan (3027)pa gzhir bzung ste bsgrigs yod/)lta bu'o / /7 chos tshan gyi mtshan byang / chos tshan gyi mtshan byang ni ma yig gi dbu'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod pa'am yang na chos tshan de'i mjug byang du gsal ba'i mtshan byang ltar bkod yod/ gzhan yang chos tshan gyi mtshan byang logs su mi gsal ba 'ga' re byung tshe/ sde bka'i dkar chag dang bstun te mtshan byang logs su bsnan yod la/ bsdur mchan gyi mgor gsal bshad kyang 108—138

byas yod// bsdur mchan/ bsdur mchan ni ma yig gam chos tshan so so'i mjug tu bkod yod la/ de'i nang du bsdur bya dang sdur byed kyi par gzhi khag phan tshun dpe sdur byas pa'i 'bras bu ste/ chad pa dang lhag pa dang mi 'dra ba'i yi ge rnams la mchan btab yod la/ mtshan byang gsal bshad dang skabs mkho'i gsal bshad kyi yi ge'ang bkod yod/9 bsdur 'bras re'u mig bsdur 'bras re'u mig ni chos tshan dang deb so so'i bsdur mchan gyi rjes su bkod yod la/ re'u mig gi gong du sde tshan gyi ming dang / de'i khongs gtogs kyi tshan grangs ang ki gug rtags kyi nang du bkod yod / re'u mig gi nang du sde dge dang pe cin sogs dpe gzhi gang yin dang /〈'dul ba'am 〉〈sher phyin 〉sogs sde tshan gang yin dang / sde tshan de'i chos tshan gyi pod rtags dang sgrig grangs gang yin dang / chos tshan der le'u dang rab byed / brtag pa dang bam po sogs du yod dang / ldeb phreng gang nas gang bar dang yig phreng du yod dang / tshig rkang dang tsheg khyim du yod bcas bkod yod/tsheg khyim ni/ chos tshan de'i dbu mjug gi yi ge thams cad bsdoms pa'i grangs yin no/ /bstan 'gyur dpe bsdur mar chos tshan so so'i mang nyung la ma ltos par bsdur 'bras re'u mig chos tshan de'i mjug kho nar bkod yod la/ 'dir de ltar ma yin par/ chos tshan gcig pod 'ga' re bzhugs pa rnams la deb re'i mjug tu bsdur 'bras re'u mig re bkod yod do//188—139

gsum pa/ dpe sgrig byed stangs kyi skor/1 dkar chag sgrig stangs/ga dkar chag gi rim pa dang po'i kha byang du deb 〉〉〉pa'i dkar chag ces bkod cing / rim pa gnyis pa'i kha byang du bsdur bya'am bsdur gzhi'i sde tshan gyi kha byang / pod rtags/ spyi'i pod grangs bcas bkod yod/kha chos tshan so so'i mtshan byang gi dbur (bka' 'gyur 〉gyi chos tshan spyi'i sgrig grangs kyi ang ki zhig bkod yod la/ chos tshan chen mo'i le'u dang rab byed sogs kyi mtshan byang yang dkar chag tu phab ste bsgrigs yod/ga chos tshan so so'i mtshan byang gi g.yon 'og tu chos tshan so so'i 'gyur byang dang zhus byang bcas bkod yod/nga bsdur mchan dang bsdur 'bras re'u mig gi ldeb grangs ang gi ni gug rtags nang du bkod nas so so'i kha byang gi 'phror bsgrigs yod/ca dkar chag gi zur mchan ni dkar chag gi mjug tu bkod yod/cha dkar chag gi chos tshan so so'i ldeb grangs kyi ang ki ni bod yig gi ang ki bkod yod cing / des ma yig gi thod thig steng zur du yod pa'i bod yig gi ang spyir gtugs te 'tshol dgos/ ldeb kyi gsham zur du yod pa'i a rab kyi ang khri'i ldeb grangs kyi sngon du deb grangs kyi ang ki zhig kyang bsnan yod/2 ma yig sgrig stangs/ga chos tshan so so'i dbu ldeb kyi g.yas phyogs steng zur du bka' 'gyur gyi chos tshan spyi'i sgrig grangs kyi ang ki zhig bkod yod/188—140

kha chos tshan gyi mtshan byang ji ltar bkod yod gong du gsal ba ltar la/dkar chag gi nang du le'u sogs kyi mtshan byang bkod yod pa/ ma yig tu kha byang logs su bkar med kyang / klog pa pos 'tshol bde ba'i ched du/ le'u sogs kyi dbu rtsom skabs/ yig phreng stong pa gcig bzhag pa'i 'og tu phreng phab nas bsgrigs yod cing / de min tshan pa gal che ba'i mtshams su (bzhi shad yod sar )yig phreng phab pa las phreng stong bzhag med/ga deb kyi thod thig dang thod yig /chos tshan so so'i dbu ldeb kyi mgor thod thig phra sbom nyis gshibs bzhag yod la/ ldeb phyi ma rnams kyi mgor thod thig phra mo brgyab pa'i steng du thod yig bkod yod cing / ya ldeb (dbu ldeb phud )la chos tshan gyi mtshan byang dang / cha ldeb la dpe deb kyi mtshan byang dang / sde tshan gyi kha byang / pod rtags/ spyi'i pod grangs bcas bsgrigs yod/nga bsdur mchan/ ma yig gi ldeb rer bsdur mchan ang rim gcig gyur re bkod yod cing / ldeb re'i bsdur mchan ni ldeb re'i bsdur mchan gyi 'og tu phreng phab nas bsgrigs yod la/ ma yig gi ldeb grangs 'tshol sla ched/ ldeb re'i bsdur mchan gyi mgor ma yig gi ldeb grangs (bod yig gi ang ki )bkod yod/ca bsdur 'bras re'u mig (dpe sdur gsal bshad du gsal/)bzhi pa/ zhus dag byed stangs kyi skor/'di'i zhus dag byed lugs ni dpe skrun khang gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar sngon gyi 〈〈bka' bstan 〉〉par skrun skabs kyi nyams myong mang po bsags nas zhus dag byas shing / 'di'i ma phyi sde dge'i par ma yin pa dang / 'di la sngon gyi zhus 108—141

dag mkhan po rnams kyis ma phyi la zhus chen mdzad pa ltar zhus dag 'gro mi dgos shing / lhag par du 〈〈bka' bstan 〉〉dpe sdur khang gi rtsa don ltar/ 〈〈bka' bstan 〉〉spyi dang nang sgos rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dpe sdur dang / dpe sgrig gi skabs su bsdur gzhi'am ma yig (sde par ni bka' 'gyur par gzhi khag las ches dag shos yin pas 'di la bsre lhad dang bzo bcos lta ci/ tha na yig 'bru gcig kyang bcos mi chog par gna' dpe sor bzhag byed dgos pa'i sgrig srol sogs sngar nas gtan 'bebs byas yod/'on kyang / lag len gyi khrod nas zhib bsdur byas tshe da gzod rta bo rgyug shul tu rta sbangs lhags zhes pa'i dpe ltar ma yig /sde par la'ang yi ge dang thob thang nor ba chad lhag byung ba sogs par yig bri nor dang brkos nor la zhus dag gis ma thon pa mang tsam 'dug pas/ 'di'i skor khro ru mkhan po tshe rnam mchog zhal bzhugs dus bka' 'dri zhus par/ khong gis 6yi ge nor ba shes bzhin du ma bcos na de ni nor 'khrul chen po zhig red/ ma dag pa rnams brda sprod dang bstun nas dag par bcos na legs shing / de ltar mi byed na brda sprod kyis ci byed / dgos pa med par 'gyur ro mizhes gsungs pa dang / da dung ched las mkhas pa skor zhig la'ang dngos dang brgyud nas zhus par/ phal che ba zhig nor bcos byed rgyu 'di la 'thad pa byung bas/ 〈〈bka' bstan 〉〉dpe sdur khang gi gzhung las gros mol tshoms khang du/ dbu khrid dang ched las mkhas pa mang po gdan 'dzoms nas/ ma phyi'i nor ba 'chos rgyu dang bcos tshul sogs 'di ltar gtan 'bebs byas pa ste/1 bsdur bya'i ma yig sde par gyi nor ba yin thag chod pa rnams sdur byed 188—142

kyi dpe khag bdun la bstun nas 'chos dgos pa dang / bcos zin pa dag kyang zur du ldeb ngos dang phreng gang yin pa'i tho gsal bor 'god pa/2 nor ba yin min the tshom can rnams ni spyi khyab las 'dzin pa dang / rting zhus mkhas dbang rnams lhan du 'dzoms dus 'dri ba dang / gros kha bsdur nas thag gcod pa las rang 'dod kyis bsgyur ba'am bcos mi chog pa/3 chad lhag gi skor ni tsheg khyim gcig re byung ba rnams ma yig la snon 'phri byed rgyu dang / de las mang du byung tshe bsdur mchan du 'god pa/dper na/ ma yig tu /dus rtag snyedu sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams la 6gzig te /zhes pa'i thob thang dang / bya tshig nor ba rnams dpe khag bdun la bstun te /dus rtag 6tu sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams la snyegazigs te /'di ltar dag par bcos yod/ma yig tu /sangs bcom ldan 'das rnams ni /zhes pa'i ming gi cha shas chad pa dpe khag gzhan la bstun te /sangs (rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni /'di ltaram rgyas mizhes pa'i yig 'bru gcig ma yig tu bsnan te dag par bcos yod/'di lta bu ni bsdur mchan du dpe khag gzhan la lhag rtags kyis mtshon par byas yod na'ang / don dam du ma yig sde par la chad pa'i gas yin no//ma yig tu /rdo rje lta bu'i ting ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so///zhes par ting yig cig lhag mar byung ba yang dpe khag gzhan la bstun nas /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so///'di ltar dag par bcos yod/'di 'dra phal che ba ni par yig 'bri dus kyi nor ba yin la/ de yang phreng gong ma'i mjug dang phreng 'og ma'i mgor gong gi de bzhin yi ge rigs 'dra bar 188—143

brkos yod pas yin/ 'di 'dra ba bsdur mchan du dpe khag gzhan la chad rtags kyis mtshon par byas yod na'ang / don dam du ma yig (sde par la lhag pa'i gas yin no//gong gi 'di bzhin ma phyi'i ‘ sde par gyi nor ba rnams dag par bcos pa dang / shad sogs kyang thob thang dang bstun nas gcig gyur gyis bcos yod/ da dung zhu dgos pa gzhan zhig ni/ sde dge'i bka' 'gyur lta bu la mtshon na/ da lta 'grems spel byed bzhin pa'i mtshal par dang snag par gnyis kyang phan tshun cung mi 'dra zhing / de las kyang lo ngo brgya phrag sngon gyi mtshal par rnying pa rnams ni deng gi mtshal snag par ma gnyis las kyang ches dag par yod pas/ bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i ma phyi'ang sngon gyi mtshal par rnying pa la bstun yod/ des na deng gi mtshal par dang / lhag par du snag par la ni snying khams can mang pos bcos te mon yul rdor gcod kyi dper byas pa'ang mang du mthong ngo /spyir zhus dag gam par zhus kyi las rim 'di ni dpe sgrig gi bya ba'i khrod kyi ches gal che ba'i las tshan zhig yin pas/ dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa gcig la lag rogs par zhus pa gnyis rtsa 'dzugs byas shing / de nas par zhus pa gnyis kyis sbyor klog 'bru 'ded kyis smar zhus byas pas zhu thengs dang po grub/ slar yang ma phyi dang bu yig gnyis yig 'bru re re bzhin phan tshun mdzub 'ded kyis bskyar zhus te zhu thengs gnyis pa grub/ de nas dpe sgrig pas ma phyi dang bu yig gnyis yi ge re re bzhin mdzub 'ded kyis par zhus dang po ste zhu thengs gsum pa grub / de nas par zhus pa gnyis kyis slar yang gong gi smar zhus dang bskyar zhus ji lta ba bzhin byas pas zhu thengs bzhi pa dang lnga pa grub/ de nas dpe sgrig pas 108—144

yang bskyar mdzub 'ded kyis par zhus gnyis pa ste zhu thengs drug pa grub/ de nas zhus chen pas klog 'don gyis zhus chen dang po ste zhu thengs bdun pa grub/de nas dpe sgrig pas ches mtha' ma'i gtsang zhus te zhu thengs brgyad pa grub/ de nas rting ma'i mdzub 'ded pas par zhus dang po byas pas zhu thengs dgu pa grub/de nas ched las mkhas dbang rnams kyis zhus chen lan gnyis pa mdzad pas zhu thengs bcu pa grub/ de nas rtsis len pas klog 'don gyis par zhus te zhu thengs bcu gcig pa grub/ de nas zhus chen pas slar yang klog 'don gyis rting ma'i zhus chen mdzad pas zhu thengs bcu gnyis pa grub pa yin no//gong gi zhu thengs rim pa bcu gnyis po de yang mi gcig gis byas pa min par/phan tshun res mos dang brje len gyis par zhus byas pa yin la/ yig nor shor ba dag kyang phan tshun gcig gis gcig la gzab nan gyis chad pa lag bstar byas pa dang / zhu thengs re re'i mtshams su'ang bu dpe rnams yig gtags par 'chos rgyu sprod pa dang / slar yang bcos thub yod med la bskyar zhib byed pa sogs yin/ 'di ltar zhus dag gi rim pa mang pos gtan la phab cing / 'gyig shog tu ma par ba'i sngon du rting ma'i mdzub 'ded pas par zhus thengs gnyis pa byed dgos te/ 'di ni dmigs bsal gyi zhus dag cig yin la/ gtso bo glog rdul rtsis 'khor la 'gyur ldog yod med dang / yig tshags re re mthud mtshams su yi ge chad lhag dang / phreng dang yig gzugs 'gyur yod med bcas la blta dgos pa yin no//mdor na par zhus kyi rnam grangs ji 'dra mang na de ltar glegs bam de'i spus ka je legs dang mthor 'degs 'byung kyin yod pas/ 〈〈bka' bstan 〉〉dpe 108—145

bsdur ma'i gzhung yig rkyang par yang zhu thengs bcu gsum song yod pa yin no//lnga pa/ mtshon rtags rgyag stangs kyi skor/1 dpe rtags (( 〉)ni bsdur mchan sogs su par gzhi'i mtshan byang bsdu skabs spyad yod/2 ang rtags sgor khyim ma (15)ni ma yig dang bsdur mchan phan tshun gtug byed du spyad yod/3 lhag rtags ( )ni bsdur mchan gyi nang du spyad yod la/ de'i rjes kyi yi ge rnams lhag pa mtshon byed yin/4 chad rtags ( )ni bsdur mchan gyi nang du spyad yod la/ de'i rjes kyi yi ge rnams chad pa'am med pa mtshon byed yi na/5 mtshams rtags ( )ni ma yig gi nang du spyad yod la/ bsdur bya dang sdur byed kyi par gzhi'i bar phan tshun tsheg khyim gnyis yan mi 'dra ba byung skabs mi 'dra ba de'i sngon du mtshams rtags dang / mthar bsdur mchan ang rtags bkod de / mi 'dra ba'i mtshams gang yin dbye sbyor thub pa byas yod/6 sdud rtags ( )ni sdur byed kyi dpe gzhir sho lo ka dang tshig ring sogs chad pa byung tshe/ bsdur mchan du sdud rtags kyis tshig bar bsdus te bkod yod/7 mchan rtags (bo)ni bstan 'gyur gyi skabs su gtso bo bsdur mchan gyi nang du sdur byed kyi dpe gzhi'i sngar yod mchan yig mtshon byed du spyad yod mod/bka' 'gyur du sngar yod mchan yig nyung zhing / gtso bo ma yig gi yi ge'i go rim mi 'dra ba'i mtshams su spyad yod/108wa 146

/ ldeb ngos dang ldeb phreng mtshon rtags (na dang ba )ni bsdur mchan dang bsdur 'bras re'u mig sga nang du spyad yod la/ na yis nyin ldeb dang / ba yis srib ldeb mtshon pa dang / (nga )ni bsdur mchan gsal bshad kyi skabs su spyad yod la/ de yis ldeb phreng mtshon pa yin no//9 'dab rtags (5)ni dkar chag gi mchan yod sa dang dkar chag gi zur mchan phan tshun 'tshol byed du spyad yod/drug pa/ mdzes cha 'god stangs kyi skor/1 dpe shubs/ deb spus legs kyi dpe shubs ni shog pang ja mdog dang /deb rtse phud kyi dpe shubs ni dar gos rgya smug gis byas yod cing / deb byang mdog li ser gyi steng du deb kyi mtshan byang dang sde tshan gyi mtshan byang / pod rtags / deb grangs kyi ang ki sogs bsgrigs yod/2 deb g.yogs/ deb g.yogs kyi mdun shog gi ngos su shākya thub pa'i sku brnyan (shing brkos ston sku 'di ni lha sa nas thon )zhig dpar yod/ deb ltag tu mtshan byang dang sde tshan gyi mtshan byang / pod rtags/ deb grangs kyi ang ki dang /bod kyi rgyan ris bcas dang / rgyab shog tu gser ris kyi bkra shis rdzas brgyad bcas dpar yod/3 nang deb phyi shan/ deb spus legs kyi phyi shan dar gos li ser dang / deb rtse phud kyi phyi shan lug lpags kham ser gyis byas yod la/ mdun ngos su deb kyi mtshan byang dang / ri dwags chos 'khor gyi ri mo dpar yod/ deb ltag gi yi ge ni dpe shubs kyi yi ge dang 'dra zhing / steng 'og tu tsi mgo pa tra dang / pad gdan 108—147

ri mo dang / rgyab ngos su rdo rje rgya gram gyi tsha gser bkod yod/4 mdun shog nang ma snga phyi gnyis/ mdun shog nang ma'i snga mar thig skud ser skya'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig dang / mdun shog nang ma'i phyi mar ja ljang mdog can gyi mtha' ris pa tra can gyi nang du deb kyi mtshan byang dang /spyi'i deb grangs/ dpe sdur dang dpe skrun byed mkhan gyi las khungs kyi ming bcas bkod yod/5 spyi'i bar bcug ri mo/ shākya thub pa'i sku brnyan tshon khra can zhig deb thams cad kyi mdun shog nang ma phyi ma'i rjes su bkod de/ spyi'i bar bcug ri mo byas yod/6 sde tshan gyi bar bcug sku brnyan/ gtso bo glegs bam so so'i nang don dang 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan re bzhag yod ste/ 'dir bstan 'gyur dang mi 'dra bar glegs bam re deb re byas te bsgrigs yod pa dang / deb rer bar bcug sku brnyan gnyis re yod la/ bar bcug sku brnyan de glegs bam gyi bar bcug shog lhe'i sngon du bzhag yod/7 glegs bam gyi bar bcug shog lhe/ glegs bam re'i sngon du glegs bam gyi bar bcug shog lhe re bcug yod cing / bar bcug shog lhe'i steng phyogs te pa tra dang thig gis bcad pa'i nang du bsdur gzhi'i dbu lha gnyis dang / de'i bstod tshig dang / 'og gi thig khang du sde tshan gyi tshan grangs dang mtshan byang / pod rtags / spyi'i pod grangs bcas bkod yod// mchod rten/ deb re'i mjug tu mchod rten cha brgyad kyi ya gyal byang chub mchod rten thig ris can zhig par yod pa ste/ deb so so'i dbur sangs rgyas 188—148

byang sems kyi sku brnyan dang / bar du legs par gsungs pa'i bka'/ mjug tu byang chub mchod rten gyi ri mo bcas bzhugs su gsol bas deb rer sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum yongs su tshang bar byas yod do//de ltar bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma 'di'i dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig byed stangs/mtshon rtags dang mdzes cha 'god stangs/ 'bru 'ded dang mdzub 'ded/ gtsang zhus dang zhu chen gyis mtshon pa'i zhus dag byed lugs bcas la gna' deng zung 'brel gyi dge mtshan rnam par spyad yod pa 'dis/ bka' 'gyur dpe sgrig dang dpe skrun gyi spus tshad de rgyal nang gi bod yig dpe skrun khang mang po lta zhig /'dzam gling gi rim pa dang po'i gas su bgrang chog ces kho bos mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas smra'o//smras pa/ bde gshegs mkhyen brtse'i 'od lnga'i gur khyim can//lung rtogs chos kyi mkha' la bkra ba'i 'dzum//shes rab mig zhags dkar pos zin pa'i tshe//dga' dad 'o mtsho mi 'gyur rang dbang ci//mdun na bka' lung chu bo'i gter bzhin 'khyil//rgyab na bstan bcos brag ltar brtsigs na yang //tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyi don tsam la//klog smra'i lce rtse thung rnams nyam re chung //'on kyang rnam dpyod gshog sgra'i 'gyur khugs can//dus kyi skal bzang rkang pa drug pa'i bu//legs bshad pad+ma'i tshal la bag yangs su//108—149

mngon par rol ba'i rtse dga' su yis 'gog/khyad par zab gsal myur ba'i shes rab kyi//mchu sgros 'od kyi thur ma rnon po yis//rgyal gsung dgongs don sbubs brgya cig car du//'byed pa'i blo ldan skye bo sus mi bsngags//e ma lha lam sgeg ldan zhal yangs ma//dgyes 'dzum sprin gyi dar gos g.yo ba las//'gro kun sems pa dmar po myos byed pa'i//bkra shis sbrang char sil ma 'bebs la brtson//zhes bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las/ bka' 'gyur ro cog par du bsgrubs pa dang de dag ji ltar dpe sdur dang dpe sgrig zhus pa la sogs pa'i skor brjod pa ste/ skabs gnyis pa rdzogs so// //108—150
rilathong ༄le so nabyang dang 'u gas da bsdur musgri ngama' ga ram ltar mthar chags su bkod pa/

mug /sgo gsum mi dge'i bag chags dri ma'i khams//sbyong byed legs gsungs bka' yi sid+dha'i klung //gangs can brda yi lam du 'dren mkhas pa'i//lo paṇa skal ldan shing rta slar yang dran//thub pa'i gangs ri'i mgul las lhung ba'i chab//legs bshad zegs ma 'thor ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun//skal bzang ngang mo gar gyis rol ba'i mtsho//zhi bsil lbu ba'i me tog ci yang dkrigs//chos 'dul nyi zla'i 'dzum phreng bzhad pa nas//sna tshogs gzungs phran rdo rje'i mdud pa'i bar//gsal byed 'od kyi me long 'di 'o zhes//tshig sbyor lang tsho rgyas pa'i nyams kyis 'bod//de la 'dir bzhugs byang dkar tshochag dngos la/ mdo dang sngags kyi sde tshan gnyis las/ dang po la'ang 'khor lo dang por gtogs pa 'dul ba lung gi skor dang ske/ bar pa sher phyin gyi skor dang / tha ma'i mdo bzhugs tshogs che ba'i skor dang ske/ mdo mang du grags pa theg pa che chung gi mdo ci rigs pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i skor dang bzhi'o/ /dang po 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i go rim la bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang / gong dkar ba sogs kyis mi 'dra bar mdzad mod kyi/ 'dir sngon gyi dkar chag 'phang thang ma dang / tshal pa bka' 'gyur sogs dang rjes mthun du byung ba'i sde bka' sor bzhag gis bsgrigs pa la/188—153
