nyi shu dgu pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa'i le'u/ 32 552sum cu pa/ rang bzhin gyi le'u/ 32 591sum cu gcig pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i le'u/ 32wa 615su ma cu gnyis pa / mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u/ 32 653sum cu gsum pa/ mjug sdud kyi le'u/ 32 678rgya sar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā war ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba bad de ye shes sdes (snyis te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(722) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(764)brgyad stong / () ( 33)0029 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa/ 33 3dang po/ rnam nga thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi spyod pa'i le'u/ 33 3gnyis pa/ brgya byin gyi le'u/ 33wa 43gsum pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang mchod rten la bkur ster byed pa gzhal du med pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa'i le'u/ 33 65bzhe pa/ yon tan yongs su brjod pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 32—125lnga pa/ bsod nams kyi rnam grangs kyi le'u/ 33wa 135drug pa/ rjes su yi rang ba dang yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u/ 32—179bdun pa/ dmyal ba'i le'u/ 33 228brgyad pa/ rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 33 274dgu pa/ bstod pa'i le'u/ 33 266bcu pa/ 'dzin pa'i yon tan yongs su brjod pa'i le'u/ 33ge305bcu gcig pa/ bdud kyi las kyi le'u/ 33 331bcu gnyis pa/ 'jig rten yang dag par ston pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 33 366108wa 223

bcu gsum pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i le'u/ 33 376bcu bzhi pa/ dpe'i le'u/ 33 386bco lnga pa/ lha'i le'u/ 32—404bcu drug pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'u/ 33 426bcu bdun pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rnam pa dang rtags dang mtshan ma'i le'u/ 33 448bco brgyad pa/ stong pa nyid kyi le'u/ 32—462bcu dgu pa/ sring mo gang gā'i lha mo'i le'u/ 33 483nyi shu pa/ thabs mkhas pa la spyod pa'i le'u/ 33ge503nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ bdud kyi las kyi le'u/ 33 517nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi le'u/ 33 534nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ brgya byin gyi le'u/ 33 542nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi le'u/ 33ge550nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ bslab pa'i le'u/ 33 563nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ sgyu ma lta bu'i le'u/ 33 576nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ snying po'i le'u/ 33 591nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ me tog bkram pa'i le'u/ 33 617nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ rjes su rig pa'i le'u/ 33de625sum cu pa/ rtag tu ngu'i le'u/ 33 663sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ chos 'phags kyi le'u/ 33 680sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 33 684rgya sar gyi mkhan ngo shākya se na dang / dz+nyā na sirnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de dharma tā shrī la la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad kyis dbang phyug dam pa/'i mnga' bdag bod kyi dpal lha btsan po bkra shis lha sde btsan gyi bkas/ rgya bar gyi mkhan po su bhā k+ṣa ta dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba dge 108wa 224

slong rin chen bzang pos 'grel pa dang mthun par bsgyur/slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos yul dbus kyi 'grel pa dang gtugs nas bcos shing zhus te gtan la phab/yang slad kyis kyi smad gnye thang na mo cher/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang /lots+tsha ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gnyis kyis brgyad stong pa bshad pa'i dus su che long tsam zhig gtan la phab/phyis ra sgreng btsub las khang du lots+tsha ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rgya bar gyi mdo gsum dang gtugs nas lan gnyis gtan la phab/slad kyis yang lots+tsha ba de nyid kyis bshad pa mdzad cing phran tshesas kyang gtan la phab/dus phyis lots+tsha ba chen po shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis kha che'i dpe dang yul dbus kyi dpe du ma bsags nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈snar 〉〉zhol 〉〉par ma'i 'gyur byang gi mjug tu /slar yang snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po zhwa lu 'o tsā ba dpa/la rin chen chos skyong bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis rgya bod kyi dpe du ma dang bstun nas shin tu rnam nga ra dag par mdzad pa'i ma phyi las slar yang zhus te gtan la phab/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(685) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(723)shes rab sna tshogs/ () ( 34)0030 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa/ 34 'argya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsesas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/bsdur mchan/(45) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(53)108—225

0031 'phags/ pa rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas zhus pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa/ 34 54dang po/ gleng bzhi'i le'u/ 34 54gnyis pa/ kun dga' bo'i le'u/ 34 83gsu/ma pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'u/ 34 92bzhi nga / dpe'i le'u/ 34 117lnga pa/ rab 'byor gyi le'u/ 34 155drug pa/ spyod pa'i le'u/ 34 163bdun pa/ phan yon gyi le'u/ 34 217rgya bar gyi mkhan ngo shī len dra bo dhi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 6snar sde'i dkar chas tu bam po bdun gsungs kyang / mdo rang du bam po drug las mi snang / 'es 'khod/bsdur mchan/(252) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(278)0032 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga brgya pa/ 34 279zur mchan/ bzhung dngos lam skad gas ra chad kyis kyang bcos nas btan la phab/ ces pa ma gtogs 'gyur byang mi bzhugs mod/ sde bka'i dkar chas tu /'gyur snga ma dang mtshungs shing skad bas rabacad kyis bcos pa zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(321) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(326)0033 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje gcod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 34 327zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi gsal yang / sde bka'i 188wa 226

dkar chas tu shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur la skad sas ra bcad kyis bcos pa zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(358) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(363)0034 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ 34 lde(24zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di snar thang dkar chas tu rgyud 'bum gyi khongs su ba'ed kyang ma phyi bzhin bkod/ zhis dang / 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chas tu 'di rgyud dang sher phyin sanyis kur satosas zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(381) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(383)0035 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bcu pa/ 34 384bsdur mchan/(390) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(3(21)0036 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin nga/ kau shi ka zhes bya ba/ 34re /(22bsdur mchan/(396) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(3( 7)0037 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 34ge3( 8zur mchan sazhung dngos la ska da sas ra chad kyis bcos nas btan la phab nga / zhes nga ma satosas 'gyur byang mi bzhusas/chos tshan 'di snar thang dkar chas tu rgyud 'bum/ gyi longs su ba'ed kyang ma/ phyi 7192—227

bzhin bkod/ zhes dang / 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 6rgyud dang sher phyin gnyis kur btogs zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(401) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(401)0038 bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ 34 402rgya bar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen sdes bsgyur cing /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge blo dang nam mkha' la sogs pas zhus te gtan la phab/dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa 'i gtsug lag sga dge rgyas bye ma gling bi rtsis ngos la bris pa/ dang zhu das legs par bgyis/bsdur mchan/(406) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(407)0039 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge nyung ngu zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 34 408bsdur mchan (412) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(413)0040 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yi ge gcig ma zhes bya ba/ 34 414bsdur mchan/(415) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(416)0041 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 34 417zur mchan sazhung dngos/ la skad bsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab nga / zhes pa ma satosas 'gyur byang mi bzhugs/1192wa 228

chos tshan 'di 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs stong phrag brgya pa las le'u bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa ste/ 'dir dpe khas thams cad la bskyar zlos su 'khod/song gi chos tshan (0025wa 0041)'di dag la yum sras bcu bdun du grags/0042 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ 34 go0bsdur mchan (495) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(496)0043 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyi ma'i snying po theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 34 rga7bsduramachan/(501) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(502)0044 'phags pa zla ba'i snying po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 34ge503bsdur mchan/(506) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(507)0045 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu bzang po theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 34 508bsdur mchan (510) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(510)0046 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lag na rdo rje'i 108—229

mdo theg pa chen po/ 34 511bsdur mchan/(513) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(513)0047 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo theg pa chen po/ 34 514bsdur mchan/(516) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(516)0042 chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ 34 517pa ṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo ā nan+da shrī'i 'al snga nas / ma/nga du thos pa 'i 'o ts+tsha ba shākya'i dase slo nga nyi ma/ rgyal ma chan dang la bzang ngo sa / ska da sanyis smra ba rnam/sa kyi sadan sa / gtsus la sa khang chen ngo dang la thar nga gling du bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(ji 25) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(526)00mi khye)sa pa rabs kyi gleng gastuno/ 34 527ring ba'i gleng sa'i 'chad pa/ 34 527bar ma/'i gleng gzhi 'chad pa/ 34 602nye ba'i gleng sa'i 'chad pa/ 34 661nga ṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i 'al snga nas / ma/nga du thos nga 'i 'o ts+tsha ba shākya'i dbe slong nyi ma rgyal ma tshan dang la bzang ngo sa / skad sanyis smra ba rnam sa kyi 0dan sa / btsus la sa lang chen ngo dang la thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/bsdur mchan/(6(24) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(723)0050 lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ 34 724lcang 'o can gyi pho brang i mdo la sa skabs rab mchos dang po 'chad pa / 34 724(1 miwa 230

lcang lo can gyi pho brang bi mdo las skabs rab mchog gnyis pa 'chad pa/ 34wa 735pa/ṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa 'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dbe slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi sadan sa/ btsug las khang chen ngo dpa la thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(748) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(752)0051 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ 34 753nga ṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas / ma/nga du thos pa 'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dase slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngo sa / skad gnyis smra ba rnam sa kyi sadan sa/ btsus la sa khang chen ngo dang la thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/bsdur mchan/(762) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(764)0052 dra/mas pa'i mdo/ 346765pa ṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dbe slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang la zang ngo sa / skad sanyis smra ba rnam sa kyi sadan sa / btsus la sa lang chen ngo dang la thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/bsdur mchan/(782) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(785)0053 byams pa bsgom pa'i mdo/ 34 786pa ṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo ā nan+da shrī'i 'al snga nas/ mang du thos pa 'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dbe slong nyi ma/ rgyal ma tshan dang la bzang ngo sa / r+yā da 0nyis smra ba rnams kyi 0dan sa / satsās la sa khang chen ngo dang la thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mis( 790)0054 bslab pa lnga'i phan yon gyi mdo/ 34 791nga ṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo ā nan+da shrī'i 'al snga nas / mang du thos nga 'i 'o tsā ba shākya'i dge slo nga

nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug las khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(805) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(808)0055 ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ 34 809 kuṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngo sa/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(816) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(818)0056 klu'i rgyal po dga' bo nyer dga' 'dul ba'i mdo/ 34 819pa ṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo/ ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang/la bzang ngo sa/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi gdan sa/ gtsug las khang chen ngo dang la thar nga gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(825) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(826)0057 'od srung chen po'i mdo/ 34 827pa ṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dbe slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngo sa/ skad sanyis smra ba rnams kyi sadan sa/ btsub la sa lang chen ngo dpa la thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(830) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(231)0058 nyi ma'i mdo/ 34 232paṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa/'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dbe slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngo sa / skad sanyis smra ba rnams kyi sadan sa/ btsus las khang chen ngo dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(834) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(835)188wa 232

0059 zla ba'i mdo/ 34 836paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi bdan sa/ btsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(838) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(839)0060 bkra shis chen po'i mdo/ 34 840paṇ+ḍi ta ā nan+da shrī'i zhal snga nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dbe slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyi sadan sa/ btsug las khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/zur mchan/ thong bi chos tshan (0048ge0060)'di das mdo sde sasar 'gyur gyi gras yin la/ snar thang pa ra mar mdo sde'i mjug tu bkod yod na'ang / dpe khas gzhan rnams la sher phyin gyi mjug tu byung ba dang / sde bka'i dkar chas las kyang gsar 'gyur gyi mdo rnams ni shes phyin du satogs nga ma yin mod kyi/dus phyis 'gyur ba rnams phyogs gcig tu sngar nas glegs bam 'di'i bsham du bkod 'dus cing / theg nga che chung sang yin dang / snga 'gyur dang zlos pa yod med sogs kyang ma brtasas par bzhas snang ba bzhin/ 'dir yang de ltar byas zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(843) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(844)mtshan nyid med pa'i 'khor lo sher phyin gzhung / /bcu phrag gnyis la gsum gyis lhag pa dang / /gsar 'gyur mdo la gtogs pa bcu gsum ste/ /bsdoms pa'i chos tshan sum cu so drug bzhugs/ /zhes bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las/ 'khor lo bar pa sher phyin gyi skor brjod pa ste/ gnyis pa'o// //188—233

gsum/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo bzhugs tshogs che ba'i skor/(0061wa 0110)1 shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo spre sangs rgyas phal po che'i skor/(0061)phal po che/ () (35)0061 sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ 35 3dang po/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi tshul rab tu byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 35 3gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u/ 35wa 145gsum pa/ kun tu bzang po'i ting nge 'dzin dang rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ ldan 186bzhi pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shin tu bstan pa'i phyogs gsal bar bya ba yang dag par bsgrubs pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 35 196lnga pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho yongs su dag pas snang ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 35 226108wa 234

drug pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mchosare 'khor yug gi rgyan rgya mtsho shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 35 229bdun pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho'i sa'i gzhi rgyan shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 35 232brgyad pa/ zhing gi rgyud kyi gnas shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 35 234dgu pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rnam par dgod pa shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ ldan 248bcu pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi le'u/ 35 325bcu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rmad ga cad kyi le'u/ 35 350bcu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/35 393bcu gsum pa/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i le'u/ 35 412bcu bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer las rnam par sangs rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 32—428bco lnga pa/ byang chub sems dpas dris pa snang ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 35 455bcu drug pa/ spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i le'u/ 35 470bcu bdun pa/ bzang po'i dpal gyi le'u/ 35 go1bco brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab kyi rtser gshegs pa'i le'u/ 35 533bcu dgu pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u/ 35 536nyi shu pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa bcu bstan pa'i le'u/ 35 548nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i le'u/ 35ge578nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i dpe yang dag par bsags pa tshigs su 108—235

bcad pa'i le'u/ 35 584nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ chos snang ba'i le'u/ ldan 636nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ rab mtshe ma'i gnas na rnam par 'phrul pa'i le'u/ 35 663nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 35 668nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 35 680nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ gter mi zad pa bcu bstan pa'i le'u/ 35 739nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhud pa dang gshegs pa dang /bzhugs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'i le'u/ 35wa 769nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ dga' ldan gyi gnas su byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 35 813sum cu pa/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u/(stod) 35 828bsdur mchan/(865) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1039)phal po che/ (/ ) (36) 0061 sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ 36 ldasum cu pa/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u/(smad) 36 3sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ sa bcu'i le'u/ 36 355sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ kun tu bzang pos bstan pa'i le'u/ 36 604sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ ting nge 'dzin bcu'i le'u/ 36 618sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ mngon par shes pa'i le'u/ 36 751sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ bzod pa'i le'u/ 36 774188wa 236

sum cu rtsa drug pa/ sems kyi rgyal pos dris nas grangs la 'jug pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 36 807sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ tshe'i tshad kyi le'u/ 36 825sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i gnas kyi le'u/ 36bo827bsdur mchan/(830) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1027)phal chen/ () (37)0061 sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen cipo'i mdo/ 37 3sum cu rtsa dgu pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 37 87bzhi bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i mtshan rgya mtsho bstan pa'i le'u/ 37 118bzhi bcu gcig pa/ dpe byad bzang po'i 'od zer bstan pa'i le'u/ 37rtse133bzhi bcu gnyis pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 37 158bzhi bcu gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 37 300bzhi bcu bzhi pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u/ 37ce590bzhi bcu lnga pa/ sdong bos brgyan pa'i le'u/(stod) 37 891bsdur mchan/(892) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(912)108wa 237

phal po che/ tshozlos ( 38 )0061 sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ 38 ldabazhi bcu lnga pa/ sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u/(smad) 38 ldanor bzangs kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig tu bstan pa/ 386800rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu sangs rgyas phal po che ni/ brda rnying du sangs rgyas rma ga chad dang / meg chad dang / smad chad du grags shing / yang snyan gyi gong rgyan dang / pad+ma'i rgyan/ shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo zhes bsgyur ba'ang yod de/ de lta bu'i mtshan de'ang bye brag gi ming spyi la btags par gsal te/mdo 'di'i le'u nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du phal po che zhes dkar chag ldan dkar ma sogs su bshad pa gang zhig/des lhag ma rnams la'ang mtshan de ltar grags pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mtshan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i mdo sde 'di la/ spyir sh+lau ka 'bum dang / le'u brgya yod pa las/ sngon na len+d+ra bi ha ra la me'i dgra byung ba'i rkyen gyis/ma tshang ba'i 'phro ji tsam bzhugs pa zhes 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈sde 〉〉dkar chag dang phal cher 'dra bar 'khod pa dang / da dung 'di la snar thang dkar chag tu bam po brgya dang sum cu/sde dger brgya dang bcu drug gsungs kyang mdo rang la bam po brgya dang bco lnga snang zhes 'khod/bu ston gyi dkar chas tu chesangs rgyas phal po che 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi le'u nas sdong ngo/ brgyan pa'i le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga yan chad la sho lo ka sum khri dgu stong sum cu ste/ bam po brgya sum cu dang sho lo ka sum cu be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas zhu chen bgyis zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(801) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1013)188—238

2 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi skor/(0062wa 0110)dgon brtsegs/ () (39 )0062 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs stong phrag brgya pa las sdom pa gsum bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 39 ldargya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu la lar bam po phyed bzhi/ sh+lau ka bcu zhes bshad pa'ang mchis zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(108) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(128)0063 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par sbyong ba bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 39 129rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsa ba ban de dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(259) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(288)0064 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis 108wa 239

mi khyab pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 39 289dang po/ des pa'i le'u/ 39 289gnyis pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ngag gi gsang ba'i le'u/ 39ge315gsum pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi gsang ba'i le'u/ 39 324bzhi pa/ sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa 'ongs pa'i le'u/ 39 331lnga pa/ yul 'khor srung gi sngon gyi tshul gyi le'u/ 39 332drug pa/ byang chub kyi lam gyi le'u/ 39 351bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba'i le'u/ 39 353brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi gsang pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 39wa 369dgu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba'i le'u/ 39 396bcu pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i yon tan yongs su brjod pa'i le'u/ 39 400bcu gcig pa/ zas len pa sems can yongs su smin par byed pa dka' ba spyod pa yang dag 'phags kyi le'u/ 39r+sha402bcu gnyis pa/ byang chub kyi snying por bzhud pa'i le'u/ 31—406bcu gsum pa/ bdud btul ba'i le'u/ 39 420bcu bzhi pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i le'u/ 31—425bco lnga pa/ dmigs pa'i le'u/ 39 435bcu drug pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 39 449bcu bdun pa/ gnyis su med pa brjod pa'i le'u/ 39 457bco brgyad pa/ lcang lo can du gshegs nas bshos gsol ba'i le'u/ 39 461bcu dgu pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i le'u/ 39 473nyi shu pa/ bzhud pa dang byon pa'i le'u/ 39 go0108wa 240

nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ dpa' stobs kyi le'u/ 39 497nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ ma skyes dgras zhus pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 39 506nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ rgyal po bzang gi le'u/ 39go517nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ gzungs kyi yon tan gyi bsngags pa'i dpe dgod pa mi zad pa'i le'u/ 39ba522nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ dam pa'i chos yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 39go532rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang dā na shrī la dang / mu ni bar ma dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur ma na/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 6'ga' zhig gis bam po bcu gcig dang / sh+lau ka nyis brgyar bshad pa'ang mchis zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(543) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(598)0065 'phags pa rmi lam bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 39 599zur ma na/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / sde bka'i dkar chag tu rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ zhes 'khod pa dang / 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 6dkar chag ldan dkar mar sh+lau ka stong dang / rig ral gyis sh+lau ka brgya par bshad ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(681) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(696)0066 'phags pa 'od dpag med kyi bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 39 697rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/108—241

bsdur mchan/(780) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(795)dgon brtsegs/ sgro) (40 )0067 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 40 3le'u dang po/ 40 3le'u gnyis pa/ 40 46le'u gsum pa/ 40 71le'u bzhi pa/ 40 80le'u lnga pa/ 40wa 106le'u drug pa/ 40 120rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(166) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(187)0068 'phags pa go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 40 188zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / sde bka'i dkar chag tu lo tsā ba 'bos chos grub kyis rgya dpe las bsgyur ba/ zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(357) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(390)0069 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dbyer med pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 40 391188wa 242

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(449) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(459)0070 'phags pa chos bcu pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 40 460rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 'di'i bam grangs dang / sh+lau ka 'dra min ci rigs snang / zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(510) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(521)0071 'phags pa kun nas sgo'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 40 522rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(548) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(554)0072 'phags pa 'od zer kun tu bkye ba bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 40 554bsdur mchan/(702) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(736)0073 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 40 737dang po/ khyim bdag gi le'u/ 406737gnyis pa/ gnod sbyin ci 'jigs kyi le'u/ 40 787708—243

gsum pa/ byang chub sems dpa' brtag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 40 800bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i le'u/(stod) 40wa 816bsdur mchan/(833) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(861)dgon brtsegs/ (k+ṣi (41)0073 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 41— bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i le'u/(smad) 41wa 3lnga pa/ btang snyoms kyi le'u/ 41wa 123drug pa/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 41—141bdun pa/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 41—154brgyad pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 41 237dgu pa/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 41 250bcu pa/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 41 351bcu gcig pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u/ 41 383rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya su ren dra dang / shrī len dra dang / ā tsār+ya rnyarma tā shī las bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ sde bka'i dkar chag tu le'u bcu gnyis su bshad kyang nor ba yin par snyam/bsdur mchan/(500 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(636)0074 'phags pa dga' bo la mngal na gnas pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 41wa 637108wa 244

zur ma na/ ldan dkar ma dang bu ston dkar chag tu 'di la bam po gnyis su gsungs/bsdur mchan/(716) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(736)0075 'phags pa tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo la mngal du 'jug pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 41 737zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 'gos chos grub kyis rgya nag gi dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(767) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(774)0076 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 41 775rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo rnyi dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di la 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po phyed bzhi/ chos 'byung rnams su bam po gsum dang / sh+lau ka nyis brgya bzhi bcu/dpa' po'i gsan yig tu bam po gsum dang / sh+lau ka brgya bzhi bcur gsungs/ zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(892) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(912)dkon brtsegs/ () (42)0077 'phags pa yab dang sras mjal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 42ge3188wa 245

0139 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo / 54ge377rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gup+ta dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(382) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(383)0140 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 54 384zur mchan/ dkar chag ldan dkar mar chos tshan 'di rgya las 'gyur bar gsungs/bsdur mchan/(386) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(386)0141 sangs rgyas kyi mdzod kyi chos kyi yi ge/ 54 387dang po/ chos so cog gi bden pa'i mtshan ma'i le'u/ 54ge387gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas bsam pa'i le'u/ 54 387gsum pa/ chos bsam pa'i le'u/ 54 397bzhi pa/ dge 'dun bsam pa'i le'u/ 54 405lnga pa/ tshul khrims gtsang ma'i le'u/ 54 410drug pa/ gtsang ma'i chos kyi le'u/ 54 424bdun pa/ gna' 'das pa'i le'u/ 54ge455brgyad pa/ gtsang ma mthong ba'i le'u/ 54 466dgu pa/ dogs pa bye brag phyed pa'i le'u/ 54 480bcu pa/ bcol ba'i le'u/ 54 go0zur ma na/ sde bka'i dkar chag tu /them spang ma la rgya las 'gyur ba'i brda rnying par snang zer ba las 'gyur byang gsal kha med pa/ 'di la sngon gyi mkhas pa das gis tshad mar mdzad mod kyi/ phyi nas 'ga' zhig gis dpyad gzhir byas snang ngo 108wa 273

zhes 'khod/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu'ang de dang mthun par gsungs/bsdur mchan/(530) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(552)0142 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 54ge553rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas slad kyis gtan la phab/bsdud mchan/(740) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(757)0143 'phags pa gser gyi mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 54bo758bsdur mchan/(759) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(760)0144 'phags pa gser gyi bye ma lta bu zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 54 761rgya bar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pa sa bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(768) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(769)mdo sde/ () (55)0145 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ ldan 3108wa 274

dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 55 ldaganyis pa/ sā la'i dbang po'i rgyal po'i le'u/ ldan—17gsum pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yang dag par bsngags pa'i le'u/ 55 23bzhi pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ ldan 29lnga pa/ dbyangs byin gyi le'u/ nan 34drug pa/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyang ba bya ba'i le'u/ ldan 43bdun pa/ bzod pa la 'jug pa'i le'u/ ldan 47brgyad pa/ dngos po med pa las byung ba'i le'u/ 55 53dgu pa/ chos zab mo la bzod pa'i le'u/ ldan 58bcu pa/ grong khyer du gshegs pa'i le'u/ ldan 69bcu gcig pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa'i le'u/ 55 95bcu gnyis pa/ ting nge 'dzin la rjes su slob pa'i le'u/ ldan 104bcu gsum pa/ ting nge 'dzin nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 55ge108bcu bzhi pa/ 'dzum pa bstan pa'i le'u/ ldan 112bco lnga pa/ 'dzum pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ ldan 123bcu drug pa/ sngon byung ba'i le'u/ ldan 125bcu bdun pa/ sangs rgyas mang po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo'i le'u/ ldan—130bcwa brgyad pa/ ting nge 'dzin rjes su gtad pa'i le'u/ ldan 155bcu dgu pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ ldan 161nyi shu pa/ dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po'i le'u/ ldan 168nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ sngon byung ba'i le'u/ ldan 171nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ lus nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 55 176nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nges par bstan pa'i le'u/55ge177108—275

nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i le'u/ 55khe183nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 55 200nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u/ 55 207nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ sbyin pa'i phan yon gyi le'u/ 55 210nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ tshul khrims nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 55 212nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ phan yon bcu'i le'u/ ldan 213sum cu pa/ gzi brjid tshogs kyi rgyal po'i le'u/ 55 228sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ phan yon gyi le'u/ 55 242sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 55 244sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa'i phan yon gyi le'u/ 55 2gosum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ bde bas byin gyi le'u/ 55go277sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ ye shes ldan gyi le'u/ 55 288sum cu rtsa drug pa/ me tog zla mdzes kyi le'u/ 55 300sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ tshul khrims kyi phung po nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ ldan 339sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ snyan pa'i 'od kyi le'u/ 55 350lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdom pa dang tshig sum brgya po rgyas par bstan pa sogs bshad pa/ ldan 362rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dharma tā shī las bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ dkar chag rnams su le'u so dgu zhes 'byung yang gzhung du le'u so dgu pa'i mtshan grangs mi gsal/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu zla ba sgron ma'i mdo yang 'di nyid la ngos 'dzin mdzad pa mang ngo // zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(412) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(445)108—276

0146 'phags pa chos nyid rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid las mi g.yo bar tha dad par thams cad la snang ba'i mdo/ ldan—446rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shrī la dang ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur ma na/ 'gyur byang gi mjug tu dā na shī la'i zhal nas sde snod kyi bstan bcos dang / dbu ma'i lta ba tha dad rnams 'di las 'phros pa yin gsung skad ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(455) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(457)0147 'phags pa rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 55ge458rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur ma na/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu dkar chag dang gsan yig rnams su le'u so brgyad ces gsal yang mdo rang du le'u ma 'khod/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(547 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(551)0148 'phags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 55 552rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chas tu snar sder le'u dgu par bshad kyang gzhung rang du le'u ma 'khod/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(601) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(605)01ga 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i 108wa 277

ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 55 606rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / mu ni warma dang / dā na shrī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(663) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(669)0150 'phags pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 55 670rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de rat+na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu sde dge'i dkar chag tu le'u dgu/ dkar chag tādī /dhi/ yis gzhan du le'u bcu dgur gsungs kyang gzhung du le'u ma 'khod/ bsdur mchan/(821) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(835)mdo sde/ r+sha) (56)0151 'phags pa da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 56 3le'u dang po/ 56 3le'u gnyis pa/ 56wa 18le'u gsum pa/ 56 25le'u bzhi pa/ 56 35le'u lnga nga// 56 39le'u drug pa/ 56 43108wa 278

le'u dang po/ 56 196le'u gnyis pa/ 56wa 223rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzha warma dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ dkar chag rnams su le'u lnga bcu zhes 'byung yang / mdo rang du le'u dang po las gzhan rnams kyi ma35mas mi gsal/bsdur mchan/(318) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(328)0153 rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chos kyi yi ge/ 56 329dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 56 329gnyis pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i chos kyi le'u/ 56wa 331gsum pa/ skye ba med pa spyod pa'i le'u/ 56ge339bzhi pa/ phyi mo'i tshor ba'i phan bsod kyi le'u/ 56gre344lnga pa/ yang dag pa bden pa'i dbyings su 'jug pa'i le'u/ 56 351drug pa/ yang dag pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa'i le'u/ 56 358bdun pa/ yang dag par gshegs pa'i mdzod kyi le'u/ 56gre366brgyad pa/ mdo 'dzin pa'i le'u/ 56ge373bsdur mchan/(382) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(389)0154 'phags pa khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 56ge390rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā bza dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(475) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(483)108wa 280

0155 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa/ 56 484bsdur mchan/(505) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(508)0156 'phags pa 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 56 509dang po/ bdud spa bkong ba'i le'u/ 56 509gnyis pa/ sngon byung ba'i le'u/ 56 531gsum pa/ bdud btul ba'i le'u/ 56 559bzhi pa/ drang srong skar ma la dga' ba'i le'u/ 56 582lnga pa/ mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 566607drug pa/ gzungs kyi le'u/ 56 633bdun pa/ dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung ba'i le'u/ 56 666brgyad pa/ lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 56 671dgu pa/ snying brtse ba'i le'u/ 56 685bcu pa/ kun tu bsrung ba'i le'u/ 56 689bcu gcig pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul bsrung ba'i le'u/ 56 704bcu gnyis pa/ 'brog gnas kyi le'u/ 56 718bcu gsum pa/ mthar phyin pa'i le'u/ 56 727rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas btan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu snyerdo rje bdan pas le'u bcu bcig pa zhes gsungs/ zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(737 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(737)108wa 281

0157 'phags pa rdo rje'i snying po'i gzungs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 56 768rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(796) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(799)0158 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 56 800zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu ('di'i steng sh+lau ka drug cu lhag po yod ces bzhed pa'ang snang / zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(822) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(825)0159 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 56 826zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chas tu 6sgo mtha' yas pa dang / sgo drug 'di gnyis rgyud kyi khongs su bzhugs kyang / dbyig gnyen gyis mdor bkral bar grags/ zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(828) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(829)mdo sde/ () ( 57)0160 'phags pa rnam par mi rtog pa 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs / 57 ldargya sar gyi mkhan ngo dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ka ba dang/la brtsegs kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(15) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(16)788wa 282

0164 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 57 220dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 57 234gnyis pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 57 245gsum pa/ thabs la mkhas pa'i le'u/ 57 249bzhi pa/ theg pa gcig tu bstan pa'i le'u/ 57 259lnga pa/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin pa'i le'u/ 57 266drug pa/ rgyal po'i tshul gyi le'u/ 57 289bdun pa/ bden smra mgron du bos pa'i le'u/ 57 293brgyad pa/ yon tan dang skyon bstan pa'i le'u/ 57 304rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu /snar sder bam po lnga zhes gsungs kyang mdo rang la bam grangs mi snang / zhes 'khod pa dang / sde bka'i dkar chag tu le'u bcu zhes 'khod kyang / gzhung rang la le'u dgu pa dang bcu pa'i mtshams mi gsashāX/bsdur mchan/(360) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(376)0165 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 57 377rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo shī len dra bo dhi dang/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(611) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(636)108wa 284

mdo sde/ () (58 )0170 'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhu/sa pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ ldan 3dang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che yongs su sbyang ba'i le'u/ 58ge3gnyis pa/ gnod pa bzod pa dang nges par 'bigs pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ ldan 30gsum pa/ ting nge 'dzin bstan pa'i le'u/ ldan 51bzhi pa/ dpe bstan pa'i le'u/ 58 72lnga pa/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i le'u/ ldan—92drug pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa'i le'u/ 58wa 108bdun pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 58 121brgyad pa/ chos kyi sgo'i le'u/ 58wa 136dgu pa/ yongs su bsngo ba'i le'u/ ldan—175bcu pa/ sngon byung ba'i le'u/ 52—196bcu gcig pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun du bstan pa'i le'u/ 58wa 200bcu gnyis pa/ byin gyi rlabs kyi le'u/ 58wa 256rgya bar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / bud dha pra bha dang/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(271) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(302)0171 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya ma31sa zhus pa zhes bya ba 188wa 286

theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 58 303dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 58 303gnyis pa/ smon lam gyi le'u/ 58 335gsum pa/ mi zad pa'i za ma tog gi gzungs kyi le'u/ 58ge348bzhi pa/ mi zad pa'i za ma tog gi gzungs kyi phan yon gyi le'u/ 58 373lnga pa/ lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 58ge393drug pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gnas pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 58gre403bdun pa/ klu yongs su bskyab pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 58 428brgyad pa/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho lung bstan pa'i le'u/ ldan—452dgu pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'i le'u 58ge471rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā ban dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 'di la klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chen por grags/bsdur mchan/(492) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(518)0172 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 58 519rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ne bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 'di la klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa dge ba bcu bshad pa'am mdo 'bring bar grags/bsdur mchan/(536) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(538)0173 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg 108wa 287

pa chen po'i mdo/ 58 539rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 'di la klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ngur grags/bsdur mchan/(541) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(541)0174 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 58 542rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / ban de ye shes sde dang /yi ge pa dbon gling rma la sogs pas zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu /snar sder bam po bzhi gsungs kyang mdo rang du bam grangs mi gsal/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(650) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(663)0175 'phags pa mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sdong pos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ ldan 664zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de dpal gyi lhun po dang / dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(817) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(836)mdo sde/ 0 (59 )0176 'phags pa tshangs pas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 3rgya bar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs 188wa 288

pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(24) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(27)0177 'phags pa tshangs pas byin gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 28rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu /snar thang du bam po gcig par gsungs kyang mdo rang la mi snang / zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(57) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(62)0178 'phags pa tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 63rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / dharma pā la dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de dharma tā shī la dang / par zhus kyi lo tsā ba ban+de de ben dra rak+ṣi ta dang / ku mā ra rak+ṣi ta la sogs pas zhus shing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(249) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(270)0179 'phags pa lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 271rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(363) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(373)0180 'phags pa dpal dbyig gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa 188wa 289

chen po'i mdo/ 59 374rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba brje ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(385) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(387)0181 'phags pa rin chen dra ba can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 388rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gar bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/zhus chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu /snar sder bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka drug cu gsu ngas kyang / mdor bam grangs mi gsal/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(426) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(432)0182 'phags pa rin chen zla bas zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 433rgya bar gyi mkhan po bi bhud+dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban+de dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur/rgya bar gyi mkhan po bi r+ya ka ra sidha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de de ba tsan dras zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(451) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(4570183 'phags pa bde byed kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 455rgya sar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bza dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(465) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(467)188wa 290

0184 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 468rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/'di ni 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo chung ba mar grags/bsdur mchan/(477) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(479)0185 'phags pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59she480rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(563) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(575)0186 bri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa/ 59 576zur mchan/ 'di la li yul lung bstan du'ang grags/bsdur mchan/(693) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(718)0187 'phags pa theg pa chen po'i man ngag ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 719rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 'di la bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdor grags/bsdur mchan/(834) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(851)0188 'phags pa bram ze mo dpal ldan mas zhus pa zhes bya ba 108wa 291

theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59 852rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(860) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(862)0189 'phags pa bgres mos zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 59 863rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(874) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(877)mdo sde/ sgro'i (60 )0190 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis dris pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 60 ldabasdur mchan/(12) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(13)0191 'phags pa bdag med pa dris pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 60 14rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gub ta dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/sde bka'i dkar chag tu 6'di la klu mes kyis bka' ma yin par bsgrags kyang / lo chen gyis bsgyur ba 'dis the tshom med/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(20) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(21)108wa 292

le'u dang po/ 61—155le'u gnyis pa/ 61wa 161le'u gsum pa/ 61—168le'u bzhi pa/ 61—178rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/bsdur mchan/(185) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(202)0200 'phags pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 61 203le'u dang po/ 61 203le'u gnyis pa/ 61wa 220rgya gar gyi mkhan po pra dz+nyā ban dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur ma na/ dkar chag rnams su le'u bzhi par gsungs kyang / mdo rang du le'u dang po tsam las mi gsal/bsdur mchan/(248) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(256)0201 'phags pa sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ 61 257rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chas tu sde dge dkar chag dang bskal bzang rgya mcho1re gsan yig tu/ 'di la chos rnams kyi rgyan bkod srungs pa lhab lhub bkod pa'i mdo'i le'u bcu pa dang / bcu gcig pa khol du phyung bar ngos 'dzin mdzad/ snar thang dkar chag dang chu bzang gsan yig tu mdo snga ma la ngos 'dzin mdzad 'dug ces 'khod/188wa 297

bsdur mchan/(261) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(262)0202 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 61 263rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā wan dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/bsdur mchan/(284) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(288)0203 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 61 289rgya bar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gar+bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(376) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(386)0204 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs skyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 61 387zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu (sde dger bam po gcig dang sh+lau ka bcu/ snar thang du bam po gcig tshal par bam steng sh+lau ka lnga bcur gsungs kyang / mdo rang la bam grangs mi sasal/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(421) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(425)0205 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa 188wa 298

po'i mdo/ 61 724rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(736) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(738)0215 'phags pa bdud rtsi brjod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 61 733rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzha barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(747) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(749)0216 'phags pa byams pa 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 61 750rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā warma dang / dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(801) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(808)0217 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dga' ldan gnam du skye ba blangs pa'i mdo/ 61—ra08zhu ba'i lots+tsha ba ban de pab tong dang / ban de shes rab seng ges rgya'i dpe las bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(827 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(825)0218 'phags pa 'jig rten gyi rjes su 'thun par 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 61 826108wa 301

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(837) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(838)mdo sme/ a (62)0219 'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62—3rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(146) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(159)0220 'phags pa nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62—160rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā barma dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(194) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(198)0221 'phags pa chos kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 62—199lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang po dang / lha'i zla bas bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(207) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(209)0222 'phags pa mar me 'bul ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 62 210108wa 302

rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(236) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(240)0223 'phags pa grong khyer gyis 'tsho ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62she241rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gar+bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i dbang po sdes bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(246) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(247)0224 zas kyi 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62 248bsdur mchan/(252) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(253)0225 glang po'i rtsal zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62 254bsdur mchan/(288) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(292)0226 'phags pa sgra chen po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62 293rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dge ba dpal gyis bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(300) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(301)108wa 303

0227 'phags pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa zhes dra/ ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62gre302rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de sba rje ye shes snying pos bsgyur nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu dkar chag chen mo rnams su bam po gcig tu byas kyang bam po'i sum cha tsam las med/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(312) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(313)0228 'phags pa sā lu'i ljang pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 62nge314bsdur mchan/(333) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(335)0229 rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 62cha336zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / bu ston dang 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag sogs su ban+de nam mkha'i 'gyur/ zhes 'khod/bu ston dkar chag tu 6'di theg pa chung ngur grags kyang dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang / rig byed ma yin pa gzugs min pa la sogs pa bstan pa'i phyir theg pa thun mong du 'thad do/ / zhes 'khod pa dang / 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu'ang de dang mthun par gsungs/bsdur mchan/(340) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(341)0230 'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62bo342108wa 304

rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(345) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(346)0231 'phags pa sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62 347rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dharma tā shī la dang /rgya'i lots+tsha ba ban de tong ā tsar+ya la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(529) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(549)0232 rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62 550rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur ma na/ 'di la rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa'i mdor grags/bsdur mchan/(558) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(559)0233 rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62 560rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ gong gi chos tshan 'di gnyis la sde bka'i dkar chag tu 'di gnyis la dpyad gzhi mdzad mkhan mang du byung yang / tshal pa si tu thams cad mkhyen pas tshad mar mdzad pa'i phyir bzhag ces 'khod pa dang / 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu'ang de dang mthun par gsungs shing / 〈〈snar 〉〉du mdo gong ma 'di gnyis ldan dkar ma dang phyis kyi chos 'byung dag tu ma grags zhes zhwa dmar ba gsung zhes 'khod/'di la bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa'i mdor grags/bsdur mchan/(567 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(565)108wa 305

0234 'phags pa ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62 566ā tsār+ya mañju shrī gar+bha dang / rat+na rak+ṣi tas zhus chen bgyis/bsdur mchan/(700) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(715)0235 'phags pa dpal sbas zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 62 716rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(753) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(759)0236 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62 760rgya bar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pra dz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(794) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(799)0237 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62—no00rgya sar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis bcos shing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(825) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(828)mdo sme/ 0 (63)0238 sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal pa tshar gcod pa 188wa 306

zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 63 3dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 63 3gnyis pa/ dran pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 63bo19gsum pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi le'u/ 63 28bzhi pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi le'u/ 63 34lnga pa/ 'chal pa'i tshul khrims kyi le'u/ 63ba52drug pa/ yongs su ma dag pa'i chos bstan pa'i le'u/ 63 97bdun pa/ sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u/ 62—110brgyad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bkur sti dang / bla mar byasas pa dang / rjed pa dang / mchod pa dang / mnyes par byas pa'i le'u/ 62—129dgu pa/ 636137rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī pra bha dang / lo tsā ba dge slong dpal gyi lhun pos/ pho brang lhan dkar du bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(188) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(206)0239 'phags pa rgyal po la gdams pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 63 207rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shrī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 'di la rgyal po gsal rgyal la gdams pa'i mdor grags/bsdur mchan/(224) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(226)0240 'phags pa rnga bo che chen po'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 63 227188wa 307

rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra pra bha ba dang / lo tsā ba ban de dpal gyi lhun pos bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lo tsa ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(329) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(342)0241 'phags pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 63 343rgya gar gyi mkhan po pra dz+nyā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(431) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(442)0242 'phags pa lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 63 443rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / pra dz+nyā bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ sde bka'i dkar chag tu 8le'u gnyis dang bam po bzhir dkar chag sngon ma tshor bshad kyang bam po gcig tsam las med / ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(467) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(470)0243 'phags pa gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62—471rgya bar gyi mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(475) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(476)0244 'phags pa srid pa 'pho ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i 188wa 308

mdo / 63 477rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(482) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(483)0245 'phags pa rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 63ge484rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / mu ni bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(512) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(516)0246 'phags pa sangs rgyas bgro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 63 517lots+tsha ba ban de dpal dbyangs dang dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(605) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(615)0247 de bzhin gshegs pa bgro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 63 616rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gar bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de dpal gyi dbyangs kyis bsgyur cing / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(713) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(722)0248 'dus pa chen po theg pa chen po'i mdo sde las de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig ces bya ba theg pa chen 188wa 309

po'i mdo/ 63 723dang po/ nyan thos mtshon pa/ 63 723gnyis pa/ bsam gtan mtshon pa/ 63wa 735gsum pa/ than chen rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mtshon pa/ 63 745bzhi pa/ 63 764rgya gar mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab/ zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tum 'dir las tshogs dang bsnyen pa sogs bshad pas bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bzhugs dgos zhes mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gsungs/ zhes 'khod pa dang / le'u bzhi pa'i mtshan mdo rang la mi gsal/bsdur mchan/(798) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(810)mdo sme/ () ( 64)02ge 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 64 ldalots+tsha ba ban de rin chen 'tsho dang / chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(275) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(313)0250 'phags pa sprin chen po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 64ge314dang po/ lha thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba ste phung po'i le'u/ 64ge314gnyis pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 64ge384gsum pa/ gzungs kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 425bzhi pa/ ldem po ngag gi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 428188wa 310

lnga pa/ srid par skye ba'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 430drug pa/ 'khor ba nyon mongs pa'i zhing gi las kyi sa 'thob pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 431bdun pa/ ye shes la rmongs pa gzud pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64ge432brgyad pa/ ye shes zab mo brtan pa 'thob pa la 'jug pa'i rnam pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 433dgu pa / rnam par thar pa'i bsod nams kyi mdzod kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 433bcu pa/ bsod nams kyi rnam pa yongs su brjod pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/64 434bcu gcig pa/ sprin chen po'i tshogs nam mkha' las 'byung ba'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 435bcu gnyis pa/ glog gi 'od kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 436bcu gsum pa/ sprin chen po'i glog 'gyu ba dang ldan zhing mun pa 'joms pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 437bcu bzhi pa/ sprin chen po'i glog gi sgyu 'phrul gyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 438bcwa lnga pa/ cho 'phrul chen po'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 439bcu drug pa/ chos kyi thog tog gi 'bel ba'i gtam gyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 440bcu bdun pa/ ye shes rdo rje'i rnam pa la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 441bcwa brgyad pa/ longs spyod mi zad pa'i rnam pa la 'jug pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po'i chos kyi sgo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 442bcu dgu pa/ yang dag pa'i lam gyi rnam pa mngon par mtshon pa la 'jug pa'i chos kyi sgo'i gleng ga'i'i le'u/ 64 443nyi shu pa/ phra zhing zab pa'i gleng gzhi'i rnam pa la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 64 444108—311

nyi shu gcig pa/ seng ge rnam par rtse ba la dmigs pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 444nyi shu gnyis pa/ mtshams sbyar ba tshogs pa'i rnam pa 'jig rten dang 'thun par 'jug par bya ba la 'jug pa'i mdo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 446nyi shu gsum pa/ mngon par rtse ba rin po che'i mdzod la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 447nyi shu bzhi pa/ nam mkha' lding gi rtsal chen po'i stobs la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 448nyi shu lnga pa/ sgra chen po'i dus rnam par bsgrags pa bkod pa'i rgyal po'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 4gnyi shu drug pa/ mi 'jigs pa chen po'i stobs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 450nyi shu bdun pa/ gnas kyi rnam pa dang bcas pa yangs pa'i chos kyi sgo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 451nyi shu brgyad pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i cho ga la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64ge452nyi shu dgu pa/ dmag chen po dpa' ba'i rgyal po stobs bkod pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 452sum cu pa/ bzang po'i rnam pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sgo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 453sum cu gcig pa/ rtse ba dang bcas pa yang dag par sbas pa ston pa'i dpung bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 454sum cu gnyis pa/ ye shes rtsom pa'i cho ga la zhugs pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64she456108—312

sum cu gsum pa/ ye shes kyi nor bsgrims te bsgrub pa'i mdzod kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 456sum cu bzhi pa/ yang dag pa'i mchod sbyin la phan pa'i cho ga bkod pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 457sum cu lnga pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yang dag pa'i sa bon rab tu skyed pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 458sum cu drug pa/ de kho na'i snying po'i tshul gyis mngon par rtse ba la dga' ba'i rgyal po'i rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 64 459sum cu bdun pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phung po'i le'u/ 64 460rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(569) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(598)0251 'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo las phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rtse ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 64 599rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rin dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dkar chag tu 6cung zad ma gtogs snga ma las bsdus par 'dus go/ /zhes chos rje dpa' bos gsungs/ zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(675) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(682)0252 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 64 683188—313

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(694) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(697)0253 'phags pa sprin chen po/ 64 698rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ gong gi chos tshan 'di gnyis la 〈〈snar 〉〉dkar chag tu 6'di gnyis bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi brgyad pa gnas gtsang ma'i lha la sogs pa'i khongs su gtogs pas rgyud 'bum par yang yod la/ dkar chag 'phang thang mar sprin chen po nyung ngu sho lo ka nyis brgya nyi shu zhes pa dang / sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u bam po gcig pa bya ba byung /lnga pa'i gsan yig tu sprin chen po'i le'u 'bum pa las re bzhi pa khol du phyung bar grags/ zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(730) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(736)0254 bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba sgrub pa'i don mngon par thob pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo le'u stong phrag bcu pa las le'u bcu pa/ 64 737zur mchan/ 'di la dkar chas rnams su klu mes kyis bka' yin min the tshom du mdzad kyang / bu ston gyis tshad mar bzhed ces gsungs/bsdur mchan/(792) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(801)0255 gtsug tor chen po bam po dgu pa las bdud kyi le'u nyi 188—314

tshe phyung ba/ 64 802bsdur mchan/(830) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(836)mdo sde/ () (65)0256 'phags pa chos yang dag par sdud pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 65 3rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañju shrī gar+bha dang / bi dza ya shī la dang shī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos naphaṭa gtan la phab/zur ma na/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 'di la mtshan gzhan chos bgro ba zer bas dkar chag chen mo'i chos kun bgro ba dang gcig min brtag ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(232) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(250)0257 'dus pa chen po las sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo bcu pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ zhin 251dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 65 251gnyis pa/ 'khor lo bcu'i le'u/ 65rtse294gsum pa/ gnas shing spyad par mi bya ba'i le'u/ 65 335bzhi pa/ gnas pa dang / spyad pa'i le'u/ 65 413drug pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 65wa 467bdun pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing gi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 65—534brgyad pa/ bde ba'i don thob pa yongs su gdams pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/65 581rgya'i mkhan ngo hwa shang zab mo la sogs pa dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de rnam par 188wa 315

mi rtog gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ dkar chag rnams su le'u brgyad par gsungs kyang le'u lnga pa'i grangs :sgo ba/sa75/bsdur mchan/(586) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(62gru0258 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 65 622rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ne bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(769) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(787)0259 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 65 788bsdur mchan/(792) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(793)0260 'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 65 794li'i dge slong sde snod gsum dang ldan pa shrī la dharmas/ rgya gar gyi dharma rgya'i yi ge las ban de rnam par mi rtog gis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(802) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(800mdo sde/ () (66)0261 dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal po theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 3108wa 316

zur mchan/ dkar chag rnams su 'di la'ang 'ga' zhig gis the tshom byas snang ngo zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(35) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(39)0262 'phags pa chos kyi tshul zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 40rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bar ma dang / lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(68)bsdur 'bras re'u mig(72)0263 'phags pa chos kyi phung po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 73rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyā bar ma dang / lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(86) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(88)0264 'phags pa don dam pa'i chos kyis rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 89rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(112) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(116)0265 'phags pa chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 117rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(126) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(127)108wa 317

0266 byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa chos bzhi sgrub pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 128rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya blo gros dang / dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(158) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(162)0267 'phags pa chos bzhi bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 163rgya sar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(165)bsdur 'bras re'u mig(165)0262 chos bzhi pa'i mdo/ 66 166bsdur mchan/(168)bsdur 'bras re'u mig(168)0269 'phags pa chos bzhi pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66sde169bsdur mchan/(171) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(171)0270 'phags pa bzhi pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66ge172zur mchan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu rgyal tshab pas mdo 'di dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la/ ye shes sde sasu ma gyis bsgyur zhes gsungs zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(192) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(194)188wa 318

0271 chos gsum pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 66 195rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de wa tsan+d+ras bsgyur /lots+tsha ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(198) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(199)0272 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mdo theg pa chen po/ 66 200bsdur mchan/(201) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(202)0273 theg pa chen po'i mdo chos rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ 66 203bsdur mchan/(211) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(221)0274 chos kyi rgya mo/ 66 213zur ma na/ sde bka'i dkar chag tu 'di la'ang 'ga' zhig gis the tshom byas kyang /sngon gyi mkhan po rnams kyis tshad mar byas so zhes 'khod pa dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉du ‘ zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa ni mdo 'di las mdo 'dul gzhan dang 'gal ba'i don mang po byung bas the tshom za bar snang yang / kun mkhyen bus chos 'byung du dpyad pa ma mdzad par 'dug gsung zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(254) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(261)0275 'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 66 262dang po/ dam pa'i chos bsrung ba'i le'u/ 66 262gnyis pa/ pho nya'i le'u/ 66wa 299gsum pa/ gzungs sngags kyi le'u/ 66—368188wa 319

bzhi pa/ las 'byang ba'i le'u/ 66 391lnga pa/ kun tu bsrung ba'i le'u/ 66 464drug pa/ 66gre475bdun pa/ rgyu skar gyi sbyor ba rnam par gzhag pa'i le'u/ 66 486brgyad pa/ 66she541dgu pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i le'u/ 66she547bcu pa/ ri rab la gshegs pa'i le'u/ 66 558bcu gcig pa/ klu skyabs su 'gro ba'i le'u/ 66 569rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de wa dang / bit+yā ka ra pra bha dang / dharmā ka ra dang / lots+tsha ba ban+de bzang skyong gis bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 'di la dkar chag rnams su le'u bcu gnyis su 'khod kyang / gzhung dngos la le'u bcu gcig las mi snang zhing le'u drug pa dang brgyad pa'i mtshan yang mi gsal/bsdur mchan/(616) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(677)0276 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 678rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(710) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(716)0277 'phags pa yi ge med pa'i za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 717rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / mu ni bza dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus nas gtan la phab/108wa 320

bsdur mchan/(728) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(730)0278 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 731rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / ban de rat+na rak+ṣi tas zhus shing bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(777) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(785)0279 'phags pa thabs mkhas pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 66 786bsdur mchan/(851) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(868)mdo sde/ () (67)0280 sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ 67de3zur mchan/ 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 6'di mtshan mang po bsabs pa'i rgyun yin kyang da dung cung zad ma tshang zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(201) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(220)0281 'phags pa yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha'i mdog gis 'dul ba'i bzod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 67 221le'u gsum pa/ 67 221le'u bzhi pa/ 676317108wa 321
