po'i mdo/ 67 770rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na sid dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dharma tā shī la la sogs pas zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(849) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(858)mdo sme/ 0 (68)0285 dpang skong phyag brgya pa zhes bya ba/ 68 ldazur ma na/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / dkar chag rnams su thu mi saṃ bho ṭa'i 'gyur yin par gsungs/bsdur mchan/(11) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(12)0286 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 68 13bsdur mchan/(17) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(17)0287 'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 68 18rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de rtsangs de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis zhu chen bgyis te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(33) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(35)0288 'phags pa sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen 188wa 323

po'i mdo/ 68 36zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / sde bka'i dkar chag tu 8paṇ+ḍi ta shākya sidha dang / lo tsā ba de len+d+ra rak+ṣi ta'i 'gyur/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(46) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(48)0289 'phags pa sangs rgyas brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 68 gargya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(58) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(59)0290 sangs rgyas bcu pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 68 60rgya gar gyi mkhan po pra war ma la sogs pa dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(71) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(73)0291 'phags pa sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 68 74rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(82) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(870292 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo chos kyi rnam grangs chen po/ 68 85108wa 324

rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de de ben dra rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(99) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(101)0293 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 68 102rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bo dhi dang / pradz+nyā bar ma dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes ṭī ka dang sbyar te gsar du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(123) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(125)0294 'phags pa sangs rgyas mi spang ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62—126rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(139) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(141)0295 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62—142rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(149) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(150)0296 'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 62—151108wa 325

rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(156) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(157)0297 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa/ 68 158bsdur mchan/(160) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(160)0292 chos rjes su dran pa/ 68 161bsdur mchan/(162) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(162)0299 dge 'dun rjes su dran pa/ 68 163bsdur mchan/(164) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1600300 bslab pa gsum gyi mdo zhes bya ba/ 68 165bsdur mchan/(166) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(167)0301 'phags pa sku gsum zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 68ge168bsdur mchan/(171) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(171)0302 'phags pa phung po gsum pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 68 172bsdur mchan/(218) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(222)188wa 326

0303 'phags pa bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 68 223bsdur mchan/(229) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(230)0304 'phags pa 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/ 68 231rgya gar gyi mkhan po bsto ka ra pra bha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(236) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(237)2 theg dman gyi mdo mang skor/(0305wa 0384)0305 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/ 68 238bsdur mchan/(772) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(843)mdo spre/ () (69 )0305 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/ 69ge3bsdur mchan/(727) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(813)788wa 327

mdo sde/ sgros〉 ( 70 )0305 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/ 70 3bsdur mchan/(740) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(829)mdo sme/ sgroslo ( 71)0305 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa/ 71— zur mchan/ 'di la 〈〈sde 〉〉bka'i dkar chag tu bam por bcad na brgya nyi shur bshad kyang / bam po bzhi bcu rtsa dgu man bam mtshams ma bcad par snang ngo //'di ni bstan pa snga dar la blo ka khri nyis stong dgu brgya ste bam po zhe gsum las ma 'gyur la phyis pa tshab lo stos bsgyur zhes dang / snye pa tshab dang rngog lo'ang theg chen du bzhed kyang / sngon gyi dkar chag chen mo rnams su theg dman du bshad pa ltar 'dir bkod ces 'khod/〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu bam por bcad na brgya nyi shur bshad kyang / bam po bzhi bcu rtsa dgu man bam mtshams ma bcad par snang ngo / /'di ni snga 'gyur la dus phyis shākya rak+ṣi ta/ bhu ti tsan+d+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra dang / pa tshab lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis 'gyur chad bsab ste bcos pa dang / yongs dril dran pa nyer bzhag po ti bzhi cung ma longs tsam zhig yod ces 'khod pa dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉dkar chag tu phal cher gong gi 'di gnyis dang mthun par gsungs la/ 2paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra la a dri ta tsan+d+ra zhes 'khod yod/ bsdur mchan/(542) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(603)0306 mdo chen po sgyu ma'i dra ba zhes bya ba/ 71 604rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā warma dang/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de 188wa 328

ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(640) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(643)0307 mdo chen po gzugs can snying pos bsu ba zhes bya ba/ 71 644rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / padz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(658) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(660)0308 mdo chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba/ 71 661rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(670) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(6770309 mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po zhes bya ba/ 71 675rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(695) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(698)0310 mdo chen po rgyal mtshan mchog ces bya ba/ 71she699rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(708) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(709)0311 mdo chen po rgyal mtshan dam pa zhes bya ba/ 71 710rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(715) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(716)108wa 329

0312 mdo chen po lnga gsum pa zhes bya ba/ 71 717rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / pradz+nyā warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(738) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(740)0313 'phags pa rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo/ 71 761lots+tsha ba bzang skyong gis bsgyur/dpal brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis/bsdur mchan/(789) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(795)0314 gzhon nu dpe'i mdo/ 71 796bsdur mchan/(800) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(801)0315 khams mang po pa'i mdo/ 71 802bsdur mchan/(813) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(815)0316 gaṇa ḍi'i mdo/ 71 816rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(822) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(823)0317 gaṇa ḍi'i dus kyi mdo/ 71 824rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur/188wa 330

bsdur mchan/(827) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(828)0318 'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo/ 71 829zur ma na/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈sde 〉〉dkar chag tu 6paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā ka ra dang / lo tsā ba bzang skyong gi 'gyur zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(831) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(832)mdo sde/ () (72)0319 mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo/ 72 3rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dharma shrī bha dra dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur ma na/ 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 6'di la kha cig bstan bcos su 'dod pa'ang yod ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(297 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(336)0320 dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ 72 337bsdur mchan/(341) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(342)0321 tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo/ 72 343bsdur mchan/(345) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(346)0323 ltung ba sde lnga'i dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i mdo/ 72 347108wa 331

rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya dz+nyā na shrī gub ta dang bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/zur ma na/ 'di la 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tum 'ga' zhig 'bras bu bstan pa zhes kyang bshad ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(357 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(355)0323 mchog tu gdags pa'i mdo/ 72ge356zur mchan/ 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 6'di la 'ga' zhig gis las gdags par ngos 'dzin pa'ang yod ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(358) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(359)0324 rnam par grol ba'i lam las sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa/ 72 360rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra pra bha dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈sde 〉〉bka'i dkar chag tu 'di la'ang kha cig bstan bcos su dogs pa skyes kyang / sngon gyi dkar chag chen mo rnams las mdor bshad pa nyid khungs su che'o// zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(378) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(388)0325 tshe'i mtha'i mdo/ 72 389rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shud dha sing ha dang lots+tsha ba ban de dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur/rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(405) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(407)0326 tshe 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba zhus pa'i mdo/ 72—408188wa 332

zur mchan/ 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 'di'i 'gyur byang gsar ba ma rnyed kyang snga 'gyur zhig la skad gsar bcad kyis ma bcos pa zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(430) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(433)0327 mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ 72—434rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de zhang ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus nas skad gsar chad kyis kyang bsnan nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(436) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(436)0328 mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ 72—437bsdur mchan/(441) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(442)0329 'phags pa 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa'i mdo/ 72—443zur mchan/ 'di la bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal chems su grags/bsdur mchan/(447 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(445)0330 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo chen po/ 72—446zur ma na/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu /'di bya rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(456) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(458)0331 'phags pa mtshan mo bzang po zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 72—459bsdur mchan/(465) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(466)108wa 333

0332 sun gyi nags tshal gyi sgo zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 72—467zur mchan/ 'di la 〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tum byang phyogs rgyud kyi phreng ba'i khri pa'i nang nas yul na len+d+ra'i byang phyogs kyi mtshams kyi ri u shi ri'i bsngags pa'o// zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(480) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(482)0333 pa ma'i mdo/ 72—483bsdur mchan/(485) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(485)0334 'phags pa bden pa bzhi'i mdo/ 72—486bsdur mchan/(488) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(489)0335 don rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 72—ga0rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang pradz+nyā barma dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(490) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(534)0336 'phags pa don rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 72 535zur mchan/ dkar chag rnams su 6'di'i mjug cung ma tshang bar bshad ces 'khod pa dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉dkar chag tu g.yo ru dgon pa'i mdo mangs su mdo 'di'i zhabs dpal sa skya'i mdo sde lha mo'i rgyan mchog ma nas/ dpe zhus te rnyed nas drug ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bris/ zhes pa byung bas mjug tshang ba'i dpe rgyun yang mchis so// zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(548) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(549)188wa 334

0337 'phags pa rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 72 550rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang su ren dra bo dhi dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhu/sa te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(558) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(559)0338 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ 72 560rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes snying pos bsgyur/ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(565) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(566)0339 mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 72 567bsdur mchan/(573) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(574)0340 gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 72 575bsdur mchan/(582) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(584)0341 tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ 72ba585bsdur mchan/(586) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(586)0342 tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ 72bo587108wa 335

bsdur mchan/(588) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(588)034 klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa/ 72 589bsdur mchan/(599) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(601)0344 ched du brjod pa'i tshoms 72 602dang po/ mi rtag pa'i tshoms/ 72 602gnyis pa/ 'dod pa'i tshoms 72 608gsum pa/ sred pa'i tshoms/ 72 608bzhi pa/ bag yod pa'i tshoms/ 72wa 610lnga pa/ sdug pa'i tshoms 72wa 614drug pa/ tshul khrims kyi tshoms/ 72wa 617bdun pa/ legs par spyad pa'i tshoms 72 618brgyad pa/ tshig gi tshoms/ 72 620dgu pa/ las kyi tshoms/ 72wa 621bcu pa/ dad pa'i tshoms/ 72 623bcu gcig pa/ dge sbyong gi tshoms/ 72wa 625bcu gnyis pa/ lam gyi tshoms/ 72wa 626bcu gsum pa/ bkur ste'i tshoms/ 72 629bcu bzhi pa/ 'khu ba'i tshoms/ 72 630bca lnga pa/ dran pa'i tshoms/ 72 632bcu drug pa/ sil bu'i tshoms/ 72 635bcu bdun pa/ chu'i tshoms/ 72 637bco brgyad pa/ me tog gi tshoms/ 72 638108wa 336

bcu dgu pa/ rta yi tshoms/ 72 641nyi shu pa/ khro ba'i tshoms/ 72wa 643nyi shu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshoms 72 645nyi shu gnyis pa/ thos pa'i tshoms 72wa 647nyi shu gsum pa/ bdag gi tshoms/ 72 khyi49nyi shu bzhi pa/ bsgre ba'i tshoms 72 651nyi shu lnga pa/ mdza' bshes kyi tshoms/ 72 654nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshoms 72 657nyi shu bdun pa/ mthong ba'i tshoms 72 661nyi shu brgyad pa/ sdig pa'i tshoms 72 665nyi shu dgu pa/ phrugs kyi tshoms/ 72ba669sum cu pa/ bde ba'i tshoms 72 675sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ sems kyi tshoms/ 72 681sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ dge slong gi tshoms/ 72 687sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ bram ze'i tshoms 72 695rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā pra bha ka ra dang lots+tsha ba ban de rin chen mchog gis bsgyur/zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhus nas gtan la phab/zur mchan/ 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu snye'adi mdo sde pa rnams kyis bstan bcos su 'dod kyang / bye smras bka' yin par 'dod ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(705) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(718)0345 'phags pa skyes bu dam pa'i mdo/ 72 719rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang lots+tsha ba ban de bzang skyong gis bsgyur/ban de dpal brtsegs kyis zhu chen bgyis/bsdur mchan/(722) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(723)188wa 337

0346 dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo/ 72 724rtsangs de ben dra rak+ṣi tas zhus chen bgyis/bsdur mchan/(731) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(732)0347 lha:rno myo/cado/ 72 733bsdur mchan/(737) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(738)0348 lha'i mdo nyung ngu / 72 739zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(741) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(742)03ga zla ba'i mdo/ 72 743bsdur mchan/(745) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(745)0350 khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo/ 72 746zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba rad na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(755) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(756)0351 'phags pa gnas 'jog gi mdo/ 72 757rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dz+nyā de ba dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de dpal brtsegs la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(767) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(769)0352 'phags pa dga' ba can gyi mdo/ 72 770rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya sing ha dang / lots+tsha ba ban de byin gyi snying pos bsgyur te 108wa 338

zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(788)0353 'phags pa 'khar gsil byi) mdo/ 72 789bsdur mchan/(792) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(793)0354 'khar gsil 'chang ba'i kun tu spyod pa'i cho ga 72 794bsdur mchan/(799) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(800)0355 chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo/ 72 801zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i mjug tu sde bka'i dkar chag tu las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i mdo lo tsā ba rgya nag lha btsun chos kyi rin chen gyi 'gyur zhes 'khod kyang gzhung dngos la mi bzhugs/bsdur mchan/(806) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(807)0356 las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu'i mdo/ 72 815sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa rgya'i lots+tsha ba thang sam tsang zhes bya bas rgya gar dngos las rgya nag tu legs par bsgyur/phyis gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa la sa rab tu byung ba rgya nag chen po'i lha btsun chos kyi rin chen gyis dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug las khang chen por bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(806) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(807)0357 las rnam par 'byed pa/ 72 808zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / sde bka'i dkar chag tu paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ni warma dang / lo 108wa 339

tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde'i 'gyur zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(859) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(866)0358 las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi gzhung / 72 867bsdur mchan/(895) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(899)0359 las rnam par 'byed pa/ 72 900rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ni barma dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus nas gtan la phab/zur ma na/ 'di la las rnam 'byed chung ngur grags shing / 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gsum las dpe khag gzhan du mi bzhugs la/ 〈〈snar 〉〉dkar chag tu 6tshal pa dkar chag tu med cing / dpe rgyun gzhan nas ma rnyed par dkar chag sngon ma rnams su bshad kyang 'dir zin bris su chung ba bam po gcig byung ba brtag ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(944) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(945)mdo sde/ (mi (73)0360 las brgya tham pa pa/ 73 ldasdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang po/ 73 3sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa/ 73wa 122sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa/ 73 281sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ 73 416sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa/ 73 481sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa drug pa/ 73 584188wa 340

sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa/(stod) 73 723bsdur mchan/(731) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(838)mdo sde/ (zhi (74)0360 las brgya tham pa pa 74 3sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa/(smad) 74 ldasdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ 74 80sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa/ 74ge120sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa/ 74ge174bsdur mchan/(310) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(398)0361 mdzangs blun zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 74cha399dang po/ dpe sna tshogs bstan pa'i le'u/ 74 399gnyis pa/ sems can chen pos stag mo la lus byin pa'i le'u/ 74ge420gsum pa/ kun tu rgyus tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i le'u/ 74cha427bzhi pa/ lus btsongs nas mchod pa byas pa'i le'u/ 74 431lnga pa/ rgya mtsho'i lhas dris pa'i le'u/ 74 434drug pa/ lha'i bu gang gā da ra zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 74 438bdun pa/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo rdo rje'i le'u/ 74 444brgyad pa/ gser dbyig gi le'u/ 746451dgu pa/ lha'i me tog gi le'u/ 74 454bcu pa/ lha'i rin chen gyi le'u/ 74 456108wa 341

bcu gcig pa/ bzod pa'i le'u/ 74 459bcu gnyis pa/ rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyi sbyin pa'i le'u/ 74 463bcu gsum pa/ ston pa drug btul ba'i le'u/ 74 465bcu bzhi pa/ gcan gzan kun tas lus kyi sbyin pa byas pa'i le'u/ 74 499bco lnga pa/ rab tu byung ba'i yon tan bsngags pa'i le'u/ 74 505bcu drug pa/ dge tshul gyis tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i le'u/ 74 528bcu bdun pa/ khyim bdag dbang po med pa'i le'u/ 74 540bco brgyad pa/ dbul mos ras phul ba'i le'u/ 74 548bcu dgu pa/ bran mo dbul mos kā t+yā ya na la dbul btsongs pa'i le'u/ 74 552nyi shu pa/ gser lha'i le'u/ 74ge555nyi shu gcig pa/ rigs gnyis pa'i le'u/ 74 559nyi shu gnyis pa/ rgyal po zla 'od kyis mgo sbyin pa'i le'u/ 74 563nyi shu gsum pa/ blon po ri dwags kyi bu bdun gyi le'u/ 74 581nyi shu bzhi pa/ ka pyi na chen po'i le'u/ 74ge598nyi shu lnga pa/ dge slong ma ud pa la'i le'u/ 74 605nyi shu drug pa/ shud do lag gar ni'i le'u/ 74 613nyi shu bdun pa/ rgyal po a sho ma'i le'u/ 74r+sha615nyi shu brgyad pa/ gser gyi bum pa'i le'u/ 74 618nyi shu dgu pa/ bram ze mo bde ba'i le'u/ 74 622sum cu pa/ sbyin pa chen po rgya mtshor zhugs pa'i le'u/ 74 625sum cu gcig pa/ rgyal po me long gdong gi le'u 74 652sum cu gnyis pa/ legs tshol dang nyes tshol gnyis kyi le'u/ 74 657sum cu gsum pa/ rgyal bu dge don gyi le'u/ 74 660108—342

sum cu bzhi pa/ khyim bdag sdums byed kyi le'u/ 74r+sha681sum cu lnga pa/ rgyal po mig 'byed kyi le'u/ 74r+sha686sum cu drug pa/ mi gdung ba sor 'phreng can gyi le'u/ 74 698sum cu bdun pa/ bu mo bsnyen dga' mo'i le'u/ 74 726sum cu brgyad pa/ ba shi tsir gyi le'u/ 74 733sum cu dgu pa/ khyim bdag dbyug pa can gyi le'u/ 74 737bzhi bcu pa/ bram ze shin tsir gyi le'u/ 74 746bzhi bcu gcig pa/ khyim bdag dan byi la zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 74 752bzhi bcu gnyis pa/ glang po skyong gi le'u/ 74 758bzhi bcu gsum pa/ bram zes lhan pa phul ba'i le'u/ 74 763bzhi bcu bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas thog ma byams pa'i thugs bskyed pa'i le'u/ 74 766bzhi bcu lnga pa/ rgyal po spyi bo skyes kyi le'u/ 74 767bzhi bcu drug pa/ bu mo su ma na'i bu bcu'i le'u/ 74 775bzhi bcu bdun pa/ u pa gub ta'i le'u/ 74 781bzhi bcu brgyad pa/ ngang pa lnga brgya lhar skyes pa'i le'u/ 74 790bzhi bcu dgu pa/ seng ge yi dam brtan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 74 792lnga bcu pa/ srin bu'i lo rgyus bstan pa'i le'u/ 74 797lnga bcu gcig pa/ dge tshul kyun te'i le'u/ 74 801zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / dkar chag rnams su 6lo tsā ba 'bos chos grub kyis rgya sar dang rgya nas bi dpe las bsgyur ces 'khod pa dang /〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu dkar chag bstan pa rgyas byed du bam po bcu gcig /su ren+d+ra dang ye shes sdes bsgyur bar bshad ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(800 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(995)188—343

0362 kun tu rgyu ba sen rengs kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 74 996bsdur mchan/(1000) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1001)mdo sde/ sgrokhyi (75)0363 gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa brgya pa/ 75 3sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang po/ 75 3sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa/ 75 80sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa gsum pa/ 75—147sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ 75 206sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa/ 75 278sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa drug pa/ 75ge329sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa/ 75ge395sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ 75 450sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa/ 75 518sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu pa/ 75 596rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(680) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(780)0364 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa shes ldan gyi mdo/ 75 781rgya gar gyi mkhan po bibyā ka ra sing ha dang / sarba dz+nyā de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha 108wa 344

ba ban de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(789)0365 phag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 75 790rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(795) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(796)0366 ma ga dhā bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ 75khe797rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims yon tan gyis bsgyur te/ sgra sgyur gyi lots+tsha ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(815) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(819)mdo sde/ sgromi (76)0367 bsod nams kyi stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ 76 3rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de de ba tsan dras bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(52) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(61)0368 zla 'od kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ 76 62rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shes rab legs pas bsgyur cing zhus te/ dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(85) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(90)108wa 345

0369 dpal gyi sde'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ 76 91rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shes rab legs pas bsgyur/sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(136) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(143)0370 gser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba zhes bya ba/ 76 144bsdur mchan/(158) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(160)0371 'phags pa rgyal bu don grub kyi mdo/ 76 161zur mchan/ 'di ni thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs su grags/bsdur mchan/(196) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(2070372 tshangs pa'i dra ba'i mdo/ 76 205zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dkar chag tu lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ces 'khod/bsdur mchan/(243) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(249)0373 thabs mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas drin lan bsab pa'i mdo/ 76 250dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 76 250gnyis pa/ sri zhu'i le'u/ 76wa 273gsum pa/ gnyen po'i le'u/ 76 290bzhi pa/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 76 319lnga pa/ bstan bcos kyi le'u/ 76wa 326188wa 346

drug pa/ ngan don gyi le'u/ 76 362bdun pa/ snying rje'i le'u/ 76 399brgyad pa/ ma 'gags pa'i le'u/ 76 432dgu pa/ nye bar bsnyen pa'i le'u/ 76 480bsdur mchan/(514) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(563)0374 'phags pa legs nyes kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 76 564zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de chos grub kyis rgya gar dang rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(590) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(595)0375 dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa bstan pa'i mdo/ 76 596bsdur mchan/(613) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(616)0376 'phags pa zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i tshul lung bstan pa/ 76 617bsdur mchan/(628) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(633)0377 'phags pa glang ru lung bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 76 634188—347

bsdur mchan/(662) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(668)0378 ltag rna'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ 76 669rgya gar gyi mkhan po dge slong a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba seng kur dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(774) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(796)0379 khre bdun zhes bya ba skar ma'i mdo/ 76khe797bsdur mchan/(806) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(807)0380 mig bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 76 808zur mchan/ 〈〈g.yung lo 〉〉dkar chag tu 66(0378)stag sna dang (0380)'di gnyis klu mes dbang phyug grags bka' min par smra'o :zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(818) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(8270381 'phags pa dum bu zhe gnyis pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 76 825bsdur mchan/(843) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(843)0382 bkra shis chen po'i mdo/ 76khe844bsdur mchan/(846) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(847)0383 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ 76 848bsdur mchan/(866) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(867) 108wa 348

0384 'phags pa byams pa lung bstan pa/ 76she868bsdur mchan/(877) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(878)theg chen sder gtogs brgya dang go bzhi dang / /theg dman chos tshan brgyad cu tham pa bcas/ /bka' lung rgya mtsho'i klong na mdo mang du/ /grags pa'i chos tshan nyis brgya don bzhi bzhugs/ /zhes bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las/ mdo mang du grags pa theg pa che chung gi mdo ci rigs pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i skor brjod pa ste/bzhi pa'o// //smras pa/bde gshegs sprin dkar bzhad pa'i gur khyim du//ljags dmar glog gi bu mo myos pa las//'khor gsum gru char babs pa'i rgyun bzang 'dis//rigs gsum gdul bya'i pad+ma'i tshal rab rgyas//dad gsum 'dzum ris gsal ba'i me tog dkar//gsung gsang nags ma'i tshal du mngon bzhad cing //bshad sgrub bung ba gzhon nu'i rtsed 'jo yis//lung rtogs phyogs kyi bu mo ci yang mdzes/zhes bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las/ mdo'i sde tshan gyi skor rdzogs so// //188—349

༄ga /bsod nams ye shes shar gyi ri las 'khrungs//don gnyis 'dab brgya grol ba'i dpyid du 'phags//chos gzugs sprul ba'i lang tsho'i snang ba'i mgon//'od gsal dbyings nas 'dzum pa'i spyan gyis gzigs//pha rol phyin pa'i pha mthar bsnyegs na 'ang //rdo rje theg pa'i lam 'di brten dgos zhes//rgyud sde bang rim brtsegs pa'i gong kha na//bskyed rdzogs glu dbyangs 'jig rten dpal du sgrogs//da ni gnyis pa gsang sngags rgyud 'bum du grags pa'i skor ni/ spyi'i go rim tshal pa bka' 'gyur ltar gtso phal gyi rim pas bkod yod pa dang / rgyud sde so so'i nang gses kyi sgrig tshul ni sde bkar bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs kyis mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin bsgrigs yod pas/ 'dir yang de ltar du rim bzhin 'bod pa la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi skor/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi skor / spyod pa'i rgyud kyi skor/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi skor te rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhi dang / mthar phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu bsngo smon shis brjod kyi skor/rgyud 'bum las gzungs phran rnams 'gro phan gyi ched du phyogs gcig tu bkol ba'i gzungs 'dus dang dus 'khor gyi rgyas 'grel dri med 'od kyi skor/ da dung sde bka'i dkar chag bi chos tshan spyi'i bzhugs byang du ma 'khod pa rnying rgyud pod gsum dang / kun mkhyen bu ston chen pos gzungs phran rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i skor ro//188—350

gnyis pa/ gsang sngags rgyud 'bum du grags pa'i skor/(0385wa 1142)gcig rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyad kyi skor/(0385wa 0503) sto1 zung 'jug gco bor ston pa gnyis med kyi rgyud kyi skor/(0385wa 0390)rgyud 'bum/ () ( 77)0385 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ 77 3sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā nga dbe slong blo gros brtan pas legs pa ra bsgyur cing das pa ra byas /zur mtshan/ 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dkar chas tu pa ṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la gup+ta dang / 'o tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba la shong blo gros brtan nga sa bcos/ zhes 'khod pa dang /〈〈col 〉〉dkar chas tu (chu bzang gsan yis dang snar thang dkar chas tu le'u bcu sgo blo ka sum brgya nyi shu dang zang pa sanyis pa zhis dang / sde dbe dkar chas tu le'u bcu bzhi pa ra sasu ngas kyang rgyud rang du le'u mi bsal zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(32) bsdur 'bras re'u mis(36)038 tsho dbang mdor bstan pa/ 77 37kha che'i pa ṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'bro dbe slong shes rab grasas pas 108wa 351

bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ slar yang rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis dpal nā ro pa'i 'grel bshad dang mthun par bsgyur zhing zhus te dag par byas/bsdur mchan/(54) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(56)0387 mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas las phyung ba rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ 77 57le'u dang po/ 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par bkod pa/ 77 57le'u gnyis pa/ nang nges pa zhes bya ba/ 77 98le'u gsum pa/ mngon par dbang bskur ba/ 77go140le'u bzhi pa/ sgrub thabs bstan pa/ 77 189le'u lnga pa/ ye shes bstan pa/ 77 246kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta so ma nā tha dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'byo dge slong shes rab grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa las/ bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung dang / dpon chen shākya bzang po'i gsung bzhin du mkhas chen zhang ston mdo sde dpal dang / dge slong tshul khrim dar gyis don gyi cha legs par dpyad cing bskul te/ legs sbyar gyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos rig pa'i dge slong shong ston gyis/sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du rgya dpe gnyis la gtugs shing bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(312) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(360)0388 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma rgyud kyi snying po zhes bya ba/ 77 361shākya'i dge slong gnyen chung dharma grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(397) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(406)0389 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi snying po/ 77 407bod kyi lots+tsha ba gyi jo ban+de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis 'byo dge slong gi phyir bsgyur cing zhus 108wa 352

te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(412) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(413)0390 dbang gi rab tu byed pa/ 77 414lots+tsha ba dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(427 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(425)2 shes rab gtso bor ston pa ma'i rgyud kyi skor/(0391wa 0463)(1) rigs drug ka mnyam par ston pa'i rgyud/(0391wa 0392)0391 dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i rgyud phyi ma/ 77 426dang po/ de kho na nyid snang ba dam pa'i yul la 'jug pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rtog pa/ 776426gnyis pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu sbyor ba'i rtog pa/ 77 429gsum pa/ lha mo thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor pa skal ba mchog bzang po dpal rdo rje dam tshim gi rtog pa/ 77 431bzhi pa/ sna tshogs thams cad kyi skal ba bzang po mchog gi dngos grub ces bya ste dpal dam tshig gi rtog pa/ 77 434lnga pa/ gtam gyi phyag rgya zhes pa rtog pa/ 77nge436drug pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i 108wa 353

dkyil 'khor gyi rtog pa/ 77 446bdun pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi phyag rgya shes pa'i rtog pa/ 77 456brgyad nga// mchod pa thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal skal ba bzang po dam tshig gi rtog pa/ 77 463dgu nga// kun tu rnam pa sna tshogs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rtog pa/ 77 466bcu pa/ kun tu sna tshogs bshad pa/ 77 524bsdur mchan/(527) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(549)0392 rtog pa thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog gi rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma/ 77she550bcwa brgyad pa/ de kho na nyid thams cad nges pa'i tshig gi rtog pa/ 77 550bcu dgu pa/ chos kyi yi ge 'byung ba'i rtog pa/ 77 552nyi shu pa/ sngags 'byung mi rtog pa/ 77rdo558nyer gcig pa/ gsang ba bsgrub pa'i rtog pa/ 77 583nyer gnyis pa/ rjes su sbyor ba dang ldan pa bsgrub pa'i rtog pa/ 77 588rgya bar gyi mkhan po smri ti dz+nyā na bīrti nyid kyis bsgyur/yon bdag bod kyi mkhan ngo gzhon nu grags pas zhus te bshad nas gtan la phab pa/bsdur mchan/(596) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(603)(2) te ru ma'i rigs kyi rgyud/(0393wa 0449)108—354

ba bde mchog gi skor/(0393wa 0439)0393 rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal bde mchog nyung ngu zhes bya ba/ 77 604dang po/ dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i le'u 77 604gnyis pa/ 'khor lo mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 606gsum pa/ yon tan dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 609bzhi pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med par dbod pa'i le'u/ 77wa 611lnga pa/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyi yi ge btu ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77wa 612drug pa/ dpa' bo drug gi bo cha btu ba'i le'u/ 77 617bdun pa/ sngags btu ba'i cho ba'i le'u/ 77 617brgyad pa/ bo bzlog pa'i snying po dang rnal 'byor ma drug bi sngags btu ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77go623dgu pa/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyi las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77wa 623bcu pa/ sku gsum grub pa'i snying po'i sngags kyi las kyi cho sa'i le'u/ 77go626bcu gcig pa/ skye ba bdun pa'i mtshan nyid kyi cho sa'i le'u/ 77 627bcu gnyis pa nye ba'i snying po'i las kyi cho sa'i le'u/ 77 628bcu gsum pa/ bo cha'i sngags kyi las kyi cho sa'i le'u/ 77 630bcu bzhi pa/ dpal he ru ka rnam pa ra mdzad pa'i cho ba'i le'u/ 77 632bcwa lnga pa/ yi ge'i brda'i cho sa'i le'u/ 77 633bcu drug pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i mtshan nyid nges par brtas pa'i le'u/ 77 634bcu bdun pa/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gzugs yongs su brje ba dang phyag mtshane dang phyag rgya bstan pa'i cho ba'i le'u/ 77 636bcwa brgyad pa/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi kha dos bi mtshan nyid dang 188—355

mtshan ma'i nges pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 637bcu dgu pa/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan bstan pa'i le'u/ 77 639nyi shu pa/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi lag pa'i phyag rgya'i brda'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77wa 641nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ yan lag gi mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 643nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ khyad par gyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 644nyi shu rtsa sasu ma pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i khyad par gyi mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 645nyer rtsa bzhi pa/ sde bzhi'i mtshan nyid thams cad kyi brda'i tshig gi brdar btabs pa'i cho ba'i le'u/ 77 646nyer lnga pa/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyi gsang ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 647nyer drug pa/ slor ma yongs su brtag pa dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77she648nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ spyod pa dang brtul zhugs dang mchod pa dang gtor ma'i cho sa'i le'u/ 77 649nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ nang gi sbyin sreg dang rig gcig dang ldan pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 652nyi shu rtsa dgu nga// pho nya'i mtshan nyid dang gnas skabs kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 654su ma cu pa/ rdza rnga bcing ba'i sngags btu ba'i le'u/ 77 655su/ma cu rtsa gocig nga// bzang ba dang sbyin sreg dang gtor ma'i bya ba la lag pa'i brda'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 657sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ dud 'gro phyugs dang ro langs sgrub pa dang bskyed nga/'i rim pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77she659sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ sasang ba'i mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur gyi mchod 108—356

pa'i le'u/ 77cha tsho(20sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ pho nya mo'i sbyin sreg dang las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 662sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ gnyis su med pa'i las dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba blu ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 662sum cu rtsa drug pa/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 663sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ nang gi bdag nyid kyi dbang du bya ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 664sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i sa dang gsang ba'i dpa' po'i gnas kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 665sum cu rtsa dgu pa/ blta ba dang ha har rgod pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 667bzhi bcu pa/ rigs lnga po dbang du bya ba dang phyag rgya chen po bsten pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 667bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dbod pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 668bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ bzhad pa'i sngags dang mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs kyi sgyu ma'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 670bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ nye ba'i snying po'i las sgrub pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 671bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor ma drug gi yi ge bdun gyi las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 674bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ rnal 'byor ma drug dang tshis bi dngos grub lung bstan pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 77 675bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa/ yi ge ha lnga'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 678bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags kyi bas thams cad kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 77 679188—357

rgyan rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba/ 79khe768paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(780) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(782)0437 rgyud kyi rgyal po rnyog pa med pa zhes bya ba/ 79 783rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/zur mchar/ 〈〈sde 〉〉dkar chag tu de ltar ra li so gnyis la bu ston 'bas kyis rgyud sde spyi rnam du/ 'di rnams sngar rtsod pa can du grags shing / rgyud yang dag yin par nges pa'ang 'ga' zhig snang la/ gzhan rnams la'ang the tshom gyi gzhi shin tu che bar snang bas dpyad par bya'o/ /zhes bkod kyang / chos 'byung du/ 'di dag ga ya dha ras 'brog mi dang gnyos lo tsā gnyi ga la bshad pa'i rgya dpe can yin nga sa bod kyis byas zer ba mi bden no/ /zhes thugs thag bcad snang ngo / / zhes 'khod/〈〈zhol 〉〉dkar chag tu 6ra li so gnyis la 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen pos bod snga ma'i 'dod pa bkod nas/ mang du mkhyen cing blo gros che la zhib pa rnams kyis legs par dpyad par bya'o/ /zhes rgyud rnam dag yin min gyi gsal kha ma mogasu/ngas la/ bu ston rin po che'i chos 'byung du/ 'di dag ga ya dha ras 'brog mi dang gnyos lo tsā gnyi ga la bshad pa'i rgya dpe can yin pas bod kyis byas zer ba mi bden no/ /zhes rnam dag tu bzhed snang zhing / rgyal rtse dang / tshal pa bcas kyi dkar chag tu'ang bzhugs/ zhes 'khod pa dang / 〈〈snar 〉〉dkar du'ang sasal bshad 'di las rgyas tsam bzhugs/bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(789)0438 dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 79 790le'u dang po/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dum bu/ 79 790188wa 390

le'u gnyis pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dum bu/ 79 792le'u gsum pa/ las sna tshogs kyi dum bu/ 79 793kha che'i mkhan po dz+nyā na badz+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/bsdur mchan/(795) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(796)0439 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa'i mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 79 797dang po/ gsang ba mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u/ 79 797gnyis pa/ gsang ba spyi la dgongs pa'i le'u/ 79 800gsum pa/ gsang ba'i rim pa'i le'u/ 79khe803bzhi pa/ gsang ba mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u/ 79 807lnga pa/ gsang ba lha'i gnas mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u/ 79 810drug pa/ gsang ba sngags kyi le'u/ 79 814bdun pa/ gsang sngags rim par bstan pa'i le'u/ 79nga819brgyad pa/ gsang sngags dang 'khor lo bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 79 822dgu pa/ drag po'i mngon spyod bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 825bcu pa/ drag po'i sbyin sreg bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 828bcu gcig pa/ dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams dang / pho nya ba khyad par ba rnams dang ma mo dang zhing skyong gi phrin las bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 830bcu gnyis pa/ phyi dang nang gi dngos po pho nya ma'i las bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 235bcu gsum pa/ lha mo'i 'khor lo dang las bsgrub pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 836bcu bzhi pa/ dkyil 'khor ba'i mabon po dang yum dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags dang phrin las kyi le'u/ 79rdo839bco lnga pa/ phyi nang gsang ba dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten gzugs pa 108—391

bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 842bcu drug pa/ gtso bo dang 'khor du bcas pa mchod pa'i le'u/ 79 844bcu bdun pa/ gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar byed pa'i le'u/ 79 845bco brgyad pa/ dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i le'u/ 79 847bcu dgu pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa rnam thos sras gnod sbyin chen po brgyad dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 79 848nyi shu pa/ rgyal po rnam thos sras la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i le'u/ 79 851nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa bsgrub pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 853nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ las nye bar bsgrub par bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 855nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ sna tshogs pa'i las kyi rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 858nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ gsum du sgrub pa'i dbang phyug tu bstan pa'i le'u/ 79 863nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ gsang ba grub pa dang gtor ma'i le'u/ 795867rgya sar gyi mkhan ngo ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ra gup+ta pā da'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mkhas pa chen ngo khe'u rbad 'khor lo grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus/yang slad nas mkhas pa chen ngo/ sangs rgyas grags pa'i spyan sngar kre bo shes rab dang/la gyis kyang zhu tis bgyis/zur mchan/ 'di la rgyud rtsod pa can du grags/bsdur mchan/(869) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(883)la dgyes rdor gyi skor/(0440 0445)108—392

rgyud 'bum/ () (8༷ )0440 kye'i rdo rje zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 80 3brtag pa dang po/ 80 ldadang po/ rdo rje rigs kyi le'u/ 80ge3gnyis pa/ sngags kyi 6)(snyi/ 80wa 7gsum pa/ lha'i le'u/ 80 10bzhi pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 80 13lnga pa/ de kho na nyid kyi le'u/ 80613drug pa/ spyod pa'i le'u/ 80 15bdun pa/ brda dang gnas gtan la phab pa'i le'u/ 80 18brgyad pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'du ba'i le'u/ 80 21dgu pa/ rnam par das pa'i le'u/ 80626bcu pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 80 28bcu gcig pa/ 80 32brtag pa gnyis pa/ 80ge33dang po/ rab sanas kyi le'u/ 80ge33gnyis pa/ dngos grub gtan la phab pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80wa 35gsu ma pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi dang gsang ba'i skad ces bya ba'i le'u/ 80 41bzhi pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi phyag rgya bsdus pa'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 48lnga pa/ kye rdo rje ma ngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80rdo58drug pa/ bris sku'i cho ga'i le'u/ 80nge64188wa 393

bdun pa/ bza' ba'i le'u/ 80 65brgyad pa/ 'dul ba'i le'u/ 80 67dgu pa/ sngags btu ba'i le'u/ 80 68bcu pa/ bzlas pa'i le'u/ 80 72bcu gcig pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sbyor ba don gyi le'u/ 80 72bcu gnyis pa/ 80 74rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slar yang lots+tsha ba bzhon nu dpal gyis 'gyur chad bsabs shing dag par bgyis/bsdur mchan/(75) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(92)0441 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i brtag pa/ 80 93dang po/ thams cad kyi rnam pa mchog tu zhi ba sems can la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 80 93gnyis pa/ glu sna tshogs dang rol mo'i sgra dang gar dang 'dul bar 'jug pa dang char dbab pa dang mi g.yo ba'i bdag nyid che ba'i le'u/ 80 97gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan gyi le'u/ 80rdo103bzhi pa/ khro bo chen po 'khor lo'i snying po'i sngags la 'jug pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 80rtse106lnga pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dbugs dbyung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80ge122drug pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po snang ba'i le'u/ 80ge125bdun pa/ sngags thams cad rnam par dag pa bdud rtsi lnga mchog tu byung ba rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 80 129708wa 394

brgyad pa/ bzhengs pa dang las sna tshogs kyi sbyor ba dang sbyin sreg gi le'u / 80 132dgu pa/ las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 80wa 145bcu pa/ rdo rje skye mched rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 80 150bcu gcig pa/ las thams cad pa'i le'u/ 80 151bcu gnyis pa/ rnal 'byor ma 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 151bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje sdom pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 154bcu bzhi pa/ dngos po sna tshogs rnam par phye ba'i le'u/ 80ba156bco lnga pa/ 80 174rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/zur mchan/ le'u bco lnga pa'i mtshan gzhung dngos la mi gsal/bsdur mchan/(183) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(207)0442 dpal phyag rgya chen po'i thig le zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i mnga' bdag 80 208dang po/ rgyud thams cad kyi rgyu zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 208gnyis pa/ slob dpon dang slob ma brtag pa dang / yon dbul ba dang / dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 210gsum pa/ sbyor ba drug gi mtshan nyid dang 'khor lo drug gi rang gi ngo bo zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 213bzhi pa/ 'khor lo drug gi rtsa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 214lnga pa/ srog dang mtshan mo dang / nyin mo dang mtshams dang / shar ba dang nub pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 218drug pa/ ā li kā li 'byung ba dang dus kyi mtshan nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 220188wa 395

bdun pa/ rdo rje'i mtshan nyid dang / bdag sgra'i nges pa'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80ba222brgyad pa/ gsang ba dang dga' ba bzhi dang / rigs lnga'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 80rdo223dgu pa/ phyas rgya'i brda dang mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80she225bcu pa/ dkyil 'khor dang / lha mo dang / gnas dang / dur khrod dang / shing dang / mchod pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 227bcu gcig pa/ don dam pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80ba230bcu gnyis nga// bdud rtsi lnga bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80she231bcu sasum nga// rnal 'byor ma 'dus pa'i gnas su gsang ba'i skad bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 235bcu bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi yan lag gi phyag rgya la sogs pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80go237bco lnga pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gzugs dang / mtshan nyid dang / rigs 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 238bcu drug pa/ dkyil 'khor dang / dga' ba'i bye brag dang / thig le'i mtshan nyid dang / bskyed pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80rtse240bcu bdun pa/ tshul dang / char yang dang / thig le dang / ye shes kyi gnas dang / rtsa'i kun spyod ces bya ba'i le'u/ 80 247bco brgyad pa/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par byed pa dang / bsam gtan brtan nga/ zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80cha2gabacu dgu nga / dbang gi ye shes dang / ā li kā li'i rgyu 'bras dang / zla ba 'byung ba dang / rtsa dang / thig le dang / dga' ba bstan pa zhes 108wa 396

bya ba'i le'u/ 80 2genyi shu pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i spyod pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 252nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'khor lo drug gi sa bon dang / sngags btu ba dang /bdud rtsi lnga bza' ba dang / spyad pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 253nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ gtor ma'i las zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 258nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i yan lag gi mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i le'u/ 80 259nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ las kyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80she264nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rang bzhin gyi bzlas pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 265nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ dus kyi don gyi rang bzhin gyi don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 266nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ sbas pa'i sngalas gsal ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80bo268nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ rmad du byung ba'i rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80rtse269rgya sar gyi slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen ngo dang la shes rab bsang ba'i zhal sngar/ ka ma chos kyi ye shes dang / phyug mtshams dgra bcom gyis dad cing gus pas zhus te bsgyur cing btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(272) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(284)0443 dpal ye shes snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rgyal po/ 80 285dang po/ lhan cig skyes nga/'i dba' ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80she285gnyis pa/ phyag rgya chen po dang / dbang bskur ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 289gsum pa/ dbang bskur ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 291bzhi pa/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 294188wa 397

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal shes rab gsang ba'i zhal snga nas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(300) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(302)0444 dpal ye shes thig le rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po mchog tu rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba/ 8༷ 303dang po/ 'pho ba'i dus shar ba dang nub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80gre303gnyis pa/ de kho na nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid dang zla ba mchog gi bde ba dang phyag rgya chen po'i mtha' la sogs pa'i phyogs tsam bstan pa'i le'u/80 310gsum pa/ yon dbul ba dang bcas pa'i dbang gi rim pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ naX 311bzhi pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 315lnga pa/ sngags btu ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 318drug pa/ mchod sbyin gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80ge323bdun pa/ mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 324brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 325dgu pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang / gtor ma chen po dang /rnal 'byor ma'i mtshan nyid dang / gsang ba'i tshig dang / phyag rgya'i brda zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 330bcu pa/ rnam pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/80 336bcu gcig pa/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i rim pa dang / mchod sbyin gyi cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor skyed pa'i rim pa dang / gnas kyi don dang rtsa'i 'khor lo 'byung ba dang / de kho na nyid kyi don bstan pa'i le'u/ 80 342bcu gnyis pa/ mchod pa'i rim pa dang gsang ba'i skad ces bya ba'i le'u / 80 350bcu gsum pa/ dbang bskur ba'i nges pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 80ge354108wa 398

bcu bzhi pa/ mchod pa sna tshogs nges par bstan pa dang nang gi sbyin sreg ces bya ba'i le'u/ 80 357bco lnga pa/ 'byung ba bsrung ba'i don du gtor ma chen po nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 360bcu drug pa/ de kho na nyid gsum la sogs pa'i rgyas pa nges par bstan pa'i rang bzhin gyi don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 361bcu bdun pa/ dur khrod kyi nges par bstan pa'i don dang / nang gi bsam gtan gyi nye bar 'gro ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 80 365bco brgyad pa/ dpal ye shes thig le'i tshad dang / gnas dang / sa bstan pa'i don dang / phung po rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 370bcu dgu pa/ bla ma dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid brtag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u / 80 375nyi shu pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'i rim pa dang / don zhes bya ba'i le'u / 80 376nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ dpal phyag rgya chen po bcom ldan 'das ma'i rang gi ngo bo bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 377nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ gsang ba'i don zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 378nyi shu rtsa sasum pa/ bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 380nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ dbang bskur ba blang ba dang / phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 384nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ tshig rgyas par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 387nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ de kho na nyid kyi snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 390nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 391nye shu rtsa brgyad pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i sgom 108wa 399

pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 393nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ bstod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 80 397sum cu pa/ mchog chen po nang gi rnam par shes pa drug gi bstod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 806398rgya bar gyi mkhan ngo chen po shrī pradz+nyā gup+tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad kyis dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su zhu thig g.yar khral bgyis/bsdur mchan/(399) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(415)0445 dpal de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 80 416rgya sar gyi mkhan ngo chen ngo pradz+nyā shrī gup+tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/dus phyis dang/la sa skya'i dben gnas su bsgyur cing zhus te das par byas/bsdur mchan/(431) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(433)ga sangs rgyas thod pa'i skor/(0446)0446 dpal sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 80ge434dang po/ dngos grub thams cad dang ye shes gtan la dbab pa dang /thod pa kha phye ba las glegs bam byung ba'i le'u/ 80 434gnyis pa/ thal ba'i sbyor ba dang las sna tshogs gtan la dbab pa dang /sngags kyi le'u/ 80wa 441gsum pa/ lha bskyed pa dang / dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 80ge446bzhi pa/ sha li ga'i sbyor ba dang / chu'i sbyor ba'i le'u/ 80ge451708wa 400

lnga pa/ sman bzang po dang / dgongs pa bshad pa'i le'u/ 80 463drug pa/ dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri ba dang / slob ma dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 80 466bdun pa/ dkyil 'khor dang he ru ka bskyed pa dang sgom pa'i le'u/ naX 468brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u/ 80 471dgu pa/ spyod pa'i le'u/ 80 475bcu pa/ sman chen po khyad par can dang / mo sham gyi khrus kyi cho ga'i le'u / raX 476bcu gcig pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sbyor ba'i man ngag nges pa'i le'u/ 80ge480bcu gnyis pa/ sngags sna tshogs kyi rab tu sbyor ba'i le'u/ 80nge481bcu gsum pa/ sems rnam par dag pa'i le'u/ 80zhe486bcu bzhi pa/ sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / shes rab ma gsol ba gdab pa dang / rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 80 488rgya bar gyi mkhan po shrī sa ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(492) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(505)nga ma hā mā ā'i skor/(0447)0447 dpal sgyu 'phrul chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 80ce506dang po/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bstan pa'i le'u/ 80 506gnyis pa/ sbyor ba gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 80 509gsum pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo rnams kyi dbongs pa mchog tu gsang ba gsang ba chen po nye bar spyod pa dang bcas pa/'i sgrub thabs 188wa 401

ma cu so gsum pa/ dbyangs can ma'i cho ga bsam gtan gyi bsgrub pa'i le'u / 81wa 237sum cu so bzhi pa/ gzhon nu mas rtsi ba'i le'u/ 81 243sum cu so lnga pa/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i le'u/ 81 243sum cu so drug pa/ kha dog 'byung ba'i le'u/ 81 243sum cu so bdun pa/ rengs par bya ba'i sngags kyi le'u/ 81 244sum cu so brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 81 246sum cu so dgu pa/ ston mo dang shes rab mas rnam par dag par byed pa'i le'u/ 81go246bzhi bcu pa/ rol mo'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 247bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ rab tu sbyor ba'i le'u/ 81 247bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ byol song bskrad pa'i le'u/ 81 248bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i le'u/ 81 248bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor gyi le'u/ 81—na49bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ phas kyi dpung 'joms pa'i le'u/ 81 2gabazhi bcu rtsa drug pa/ gzung ba dang dor ba'i le'u/ 81 2gobazhi bcu rtsa bdun nga// skar ma'i le'u/ 81 250bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ dge ba bsam pa'i le'u/ 81 250bzhi bcu rtsa dgu nga// lam gyi cho ga'i rim pa'i le'u/ 81 251lnga bcu nga// a tharba sha ba rī'i sngags kyi le'u/ 81 251ldang 'phrul gyi gtsus las khang chen por sa ra mo cher pha rgyal khams pas zhus pa'i don du nga ṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo/ sa man+ta shrī dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rwa dge slong chos rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(252) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(277)108wa 416

(7) rigs drug pa khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud/(0463)0462 ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 81 278dang po/ lha yi dam tshig gi le'u/ 81 278gnyis pa/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 81wa 280gsum pa/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 81 282bzhi pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 81 283lnga pa/ rgyud gzhan dang thun mong ba'i le'u/ 81 284rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po tāk+ṣa ka ga ṇa dang / lo tsā ba mang 'or dbe slong byang chub shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(287) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(288)3 thabs gtso bor ston pa pha'i rgyud kyi skor/(0464wa 0503)0474 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang chen gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po chen po/ 81 289dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u/ 81 289gnyis pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi le'u/ 81 298gsum pa/ rdo rje bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 301108wa 417

bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u / 81 304lnga pa/ kun du spyod pa'i mchog gi le'u/ 81 306drug pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u/ 81 308bdun pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 81 312brgyad pa/ bshang gci'i dam tshig gi le'u/ 81 316dgu pa/ don dam pa'i dag pa de kho na nyid kyi don gyi dam tshig gi le'u/81 319bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 322bcu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid rig pa'i skyes bu mchog gi le'u/ 81 326bcu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sbyor ba dam tshig sgrub pa mchog nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 81ge332bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje'i dam tshis bkod pa de kho na nyid kyi don sgom pa mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 340bcu bzhi pa/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rmad du byung ba sngags kyis 'gugs pa rnam par sprul pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 358bco lnga pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig gi snying po rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 371bcu drug pa/ dngos grub thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81ge389bcu bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa rdo rje'i byin gyi rlabs kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81—402rgya gar gyi mkhan po shad dhā ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang ngo/sa bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/188wa 418

slad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas chag lots+tsha ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis gus pas zhus shing dag par bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(426) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(441)0465 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ 81—442dang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81—442gnyis pa/ byang chub sems kyi le'u/ 81—452gsum pa/ rdo rje bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 81—455bzhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u / 81—457lnga pa/ kun tu spyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 81—459drug pa/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i le'u/ 81—462bdun pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 81—465brgyad pa/ bshang gci'i dam tshig gi le'u/ 81—469dgu pa/ don dam pa'i dag pa de kho na nyid kyi don gyi dam tshig gi le'u / 81—472bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81—476bcu gcig pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngags kyi dam tshig de kho na nyid rdo rje'i rig pa'i skyes bu mchog gi le'u/ 81—479bcu gnyis pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sbyor ba'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u/ 81—486188wa 419

bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje dam tshig bkod pa de kho na nyid kyi don bsgom pa mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81—ga4bcu bzhi pa/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rmad du byung ba'i sngags kyis 'gugs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 511bco lnga pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig gi snying po'i rdo rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 525bcu drug pa dngos grub thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 542bcu bdun pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig dang / sdom pa rdo rje'i byin gyis brlabs kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 555rgya bar gyi mkhan po shrad+dhā ka ra wam dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dbe slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī dz+nyā na ka ra bas bshad nas/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis (1sa/bsdur mchan/(579) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(583)0466 rgyud phyi ma/ 81 584rgya gar gyi mkhan po u tsār+ya shad dhā ka ra warma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(604) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(611)0467 dgongs pa lung bstan pa zhes bya ba'i rgyad/ 81—412dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ ༄ 81 612gnyis pa/ byang chub sems bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 631gsum pa/ rdo rje bkod pa'i mchog gi le'u/ 81 641bzhi pa/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ 81 646108wa 420

lnga pa/ sngags rnams kun gyi spyod pa'i le'u/ 81wa 650drug pa/ rdo rje gsum gyis byin gyis brlab pa'i le'u/ 81—455bdun pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa mchog gi le'u/ 81wa 661brgyad pa/ bshang gci'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i le'u/ 81 667dgu pa/ dam tshig gi tshul bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 673bcu pa/ de nyid bskul ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 680bcu gcig pa/ rig pa skyes bu mchog gi le'u/ 81 688bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje sbyor ba'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i mchog bstan pa'i le'u / 81ḍi701rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dbe slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/zur mchan/ snar thang dkar chas tu lnga pa 'i gsan yis tu dharma shrī'i tshab tu shad dha ka ra warma byung zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(731) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(751)0468 rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba mngon par brjod pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba/ 81 752dang po/ gsol ba gdab pa dang / dri ba dang / slob ma'i las nyid la sogs pa rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 81 752gnyis pa/ slob dpon dang slob ma brtag pa dang dbang bskur ba'i le'u / 81 761gsum pa/ rdo rje phreng ba'i tshig dbye ba'i le'u/ 81—465bzhi pa/ 'dus pa/'i tshig lhas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 81—3768lnga pa/ stong pa nyid kyi don bstan pa'i le'u/ 81 769788wa 421

drug pa/ thig le'i dbye ba dang rnal 'byor mchog thob par byed pa'i le'u / 81 772bdun pa/ nā da'i tshig rnam par bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 777brgyad pa/ gsang ba chen po'i tshogs ma lus par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u / 81 778dgu pa/ sdom pa'i tshig gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 81 779bcu pa/ dam tshig gi don gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 81 781bcu gcig pa/ sgra tsam gyi don gtan la dbab pa'i le'u/ 81 783bcu gnyis pa/ rlung gi de kho na nyid bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 785bcu gsum pa/ bde ba chen po'i tshig rnam par bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 788bcu bzhi pa/ rdo rje pad+ma yang dag par sbyor ba bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 791bco lnga pa/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid gsungs pa'i le'u/ 81 793bcu drug pa/ rlung gi grangs kyi rim pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u/ 81 797bcu bdun pa/ rtsa'i 'khor lo'i gnas kyi rim pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 81go801bco brgyad pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i lus kyi rtsa bsdus pa'i le'u/ 81 805bcu dgu pa/ skad cig ma'i mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 808nyi shu pa/ dga' ba'i mtshan nyid rnam par dbye ba'i le'u/ 81 808nyi shu gcig pa/ thig le gsum rnam par dbye ba'i le'u/ 81 810nyi shu gnyis pa/ sku gsum gyi snying po bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 812nyi shu gsum pa/ de kho na nyid gsum gyi dam tshig gtan la dbab pa'i le'u / 81 816nyi shu bzhi pa/ sna'i rtse mo gsum gtan la phab pa'i le'u/ 81 821nyi shu lnga pa/ stong pa nyid kyi tshig bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 824nyi shu drug pa/ lus kyi lha ye shes kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 81 826188—422

nyi shu bdun pa/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lha mo bzhi rim pa rnam par phye ba'i le'u / 81 827nyi shu brgyad pa/ 'char ba dang nub pa'i le'u/ 81 831nyi shu dgu pa/ dga' ba bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 81 832sum cu pa/ rtsa 'bab pa'i mtshan nyid kyi go cha zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 833sum cu gcig pa/ mtshams kyi rtsa gsum gyi nges pa'i le'u/ 81 834sum cu gnyis pa/ rlung gis bskyed pa skyes bu skye ba 'jug pa'i le'u/ 81 836sum cu gsum pa/ rlung gi rim pas srog zad pa rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u / 81 838sum cu bzhi pa/ mkha' 'gro ma sdud pa'i le'u/ 81 840sum cu lnga pa/ rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gcod pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 81khe840sum cu drug pa/ rnam rtog med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 81 841sum cu bdun pa/ rtsa rnams nub pa'i sbyong ba'i le'u/ 81 842sum cu brgyad pa/ 'khor lo drug sgom pa'i le'u/ 81 843sum cu dgu pa/ dus dang dus tshad rnam par bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 844bzhi bcu pa/ gsang ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 81 846bzhi bcu gcig pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi don bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 846bzhi bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 848bzhi bcu gsum pa/ rigs kyi dbye ba'i don bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/81 848bzhi bcu bzhi pa/ phyag rgya'i dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 850bzhi bcu lnga pa/ phung po la sogs pa dang skye mched kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 81 852bzhi bcu drug pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i don rnam par nges pa'i le'u/ 81 853bzhi bcu bdun pa/ nyams kyi dbye ba bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 854108wa 423

bzhi bcu brgyad pa/ a haṃ gi sgra'i don bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 855bzhi bcu dgu pa/ stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 81 856lnga bcu pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i phreng ba bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u / 81she858lnga bcu gcig pa/ mtshan mo nyin mo rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 859lnga bcu gnyis pa/ ā li kā li rgyas par bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 860lnga bcu gsum pa/ mtshams kyi 'char ba'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 81 860lnga bcu bzhi pa/ cho ga nyi shu'i las rgyas pa'i le'u/ 81 861lnga bcu lnga pa/ cho ga nyi shu pa'i rgyu mtshan dang 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u/81 880lnga bcu drug pa/ nang gi bdag nyid mchod pa'i cho ga'i rnam par dbye ba'i le'u/ 81 881lnga bcu bdun pa/ lha mo'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 81 884lnga bcu brgyad pa/ e bam̐ zhes bya ba dang po'i ngag bshad pa dang rgyu mtshan bstan pa'i le'u/ 81 884lnga bcu dgu pa/ e baṃ ma yā zhes bya ba dang po'i ngag bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 885drug cu pa/ nang gi bdag nyid kyi sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 81khe889drug cu gcig pa/ bdud rtsi lnga bza' ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 81 891drug cu gnyis pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa dang / rnal 'byor ma dang 'dres pa'i le'u/ 81 893drug cu gsum pa/ gsang ba'i tshig bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 897drug cu bzhi pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa'i le'u/ 81 899drug cu lnga pa/ sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos dang dge 'dun la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi tshig rgyas pa'i le'u/ 81 902drug cu drug pa/ slob ma'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa dang / zhi ba la 188wa 424

sogs pa'i las kyi 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u/ 81wa 905drug cu bdun pa/ khro bo'i bzlas pa dang / zhi ba la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad kyi le'u/ 81 906drug cu brgyad pa/ dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa'i le'u/ 81 909rgya gar gyi mkhan po su dza na shrī dz+nyā na dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po bod kyi lha btsan po bla ma dge slong zhi ba'i 'od kyi zhal snga nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la bapazlor/ mchan/(917) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(947)0469 lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa/ 81 948dang po/ lha mo spyan mas yongs su zhus pa'i le'u/ 81 948gnyis pa/ lha mo mā ma kris zhus pa'i le'u/ 81wa 951gsum pa/ lha mo na bza' dkar mos zhus pa'i le'u/ 81—152bzhi pa/ lha mo sgrol mas zhus pa'i le'u/ 81 954rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dz+nyā na krirti nyid kyis bsgyur cing zhus te bshad nas btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(958) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(961)0470 ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 81 962rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba khu ston dngos grub kyis bsgyur/slad nas bla ma de nyid dang / dbe slong tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus shing btan la phab/bsdur mchan/(972) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(974)047) phrin las thams cad 'byung ba'i sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 81 975788wa 425

lnga pa/ gsad pa sngags kyi le'u/ 83wa 106drug pa/ rab tu gsang ba'i le'u/ 82—107bdun pa/ bdud rtsi bum khrus kyi le'u/ 83 108brgyad pa/ bum pa khrol bu phye ma dang/ 'de gu dang / khong du gtang ba'i le'u/ 83 109dgu pa/ rkun thabs kyi dug bzlog pa'i le'u/ 82—109 bcu pa/ bsnyen sgrub kyi ltas dang / gnod rtags bstan pa'i le'u/ 110bcu gcig pa/ gdug pa'i dug rus pa la sleb pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 112bcu gnyis pa/ gdug pa'i dug rdzas kyis gdul ba'i le'u/ 82—113bcu gsum pa/ dregs pa can shin tu tshar gcad pa bsreg pa drag po'i le'u/ 83 115bcu bzhi pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i gnon pa'i le'u/ 83 116rgya gar gyi slob dpon a ba yug ti dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba bla ban chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(118) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(125)0483 dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma/ 83 126dang po/ dug dang dug 'joms byed kyi le'u/ 83 126gnyis pa/ gdus pa srog gi 'khor lo'i le'u/ 83 127gsum pa/ dam tshis srog gi 'khor lo 'jam pa dang rtsub pa'i sngags kyi le'u/ 83 128bzhi pa/ phrin las mi 'gyur ba'i 'khor lo'i le'u/ 82—128lnga pa/ chu 'khyags lo tog 'joms byed kyi le'u/ 83rdo129788wa 441

drug pa/ bstan pa la gnod pa cham la dbab pa'i le'u/ 83ge130bdun pa/ lus rnam par sba ba'i le'u/ 83 132brgyad pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 83 133rgya gar gyi slob dpon a ba yug ti la dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba bla ban chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(134) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(137)0484 mi lam mthong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 83rtse138bsdur mchan/(139) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(139)0485 phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gnod sbyin drag po chen po rdo rje me lce'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 82—140dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 82—140gnyis pa/ nges tshig gi le'u/ 183wa 43gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor dang lha'i le'u/ 82—144bzhi pa/ mchod pa'i le'u/ 82—151lnga pa/ nang dang sngags kyi le'u/ 83wa 156drug pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 82—160bdun pa/ las thams cad rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa'i le'u/ 83 164brgyad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga'i le'u/ 83wa 166dgu pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u/ 83wa 168bcu pa/ klu gdug mdangs 'phrog gi gdon 'dul ba'i le'u/ 83wa 173bcu gcig pa/ tshangs pa srin po'i gdon 'dul ba'i le'u/ 83wa 177bcu gnyis pa/ gshin rje brang dmar gyi gdon 'dul ba'i le'u/ 83 182188wa 442

bcu gsum pa/ gnod sbyin gdong ser gyi gdon 'dul ba'i le'u/ 83 187bcu bzhi pa/ bris sku dang glegs bam gyi le'u/ 83wa 191bco lnga pa/ las sna snarngegs kyi le'u/ 83wa 193rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po rat+na bīrti dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis bka' drin mnos nas rgya dpe bod du spyan drangs te bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(201) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(217)0486 rdo rje snying po rdo rje lce dbab pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 83 218'di dang po ska cog bis bsgyur zhing phyis sanyan 'o ts+tsha ba dar ma grasas kyis kyang bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(223) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(225)0487 dpal phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud/ 83she226dang po/ sgrub pa po gang zag bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 226gnyis pa/ sgrub pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 227gsum pa/ bskyed pa'i dmigs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 227bzhi pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dmigs pa bstan nga/'i le'u/ 83 228lnga pa/ 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 228drug pa/ rig pa phul ba'i le'u/ 83 229bdun pa/ sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 83 229rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta wa la tsan+d+ra dang / lots+tsha ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(230) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(231)0488 bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan 108wa 443

pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 83 232dang po/ rab tu dga' ba'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 83 232gnyis pa/ sgrub pa po'i gang zag bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 234gsum pa/ sgrub pa'i gnas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 83 235bzhi pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 83 236lnga pa/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i le'u/ 83 237drug pa/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 241bdun pa/ 'khor nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 244brgyad pa/ las sgrub pa'i lha rdo rje gtum po khyung gi bsgrub pa bstan pa'i le'u / 83 245dgu pa/ gnod sbyin nag po sgrub pa'i le'u/ 83 248bcu pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 251bcu gcig pa/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 83 253bcu gnyis pa/ klu sgrub pa'i le'u/ 83 258bcu gsum pa/ klu'i nad zhugs pa brtag pa'i le'u/ 83 261bcu bzhi pa/ klu'i nad bsal ba'i le'u/ 83 264bco lnga pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 265bcu drug pa/ yum sgrub pa rnam par phye ba'i le'u/ 83she267bcu bdun pa/ las sna tshogs bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 269bco brgyad pa/ char dbab pa'i le'u/ 83 273bcu dgu pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 275nyi shu pa/ mtshan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod pa'i le'u/ 83 278nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ rgyud ji ltar bstan cing sba ba dang / rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u/ 83 280188wa 444

rgya gar gyi mkhan po wa la tsan+d+ra gu ru chen po dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis byang phyogs sham+bha la'i dpe dang bstun te bsgyur/slad kyis yul dbus kyi dpe dang / kha che nas byung ba dang bstun nas legs par gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(283) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(295)0489 rdo rje bde khros rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 83 296dum bu dang po bstan pa/ 83 296dang po/ gtam rgyud kyi rim pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 296gnyis pa/ sgrub rdzas kyi le'u/ 83wa 297gsum pa/ lha bsgom pa'i le'u/ 83wa 297bzhi pa/ gsang ba'i snying po dang mtshan ltas bstan pa'i le'u/ 836298lnga pa/ me'i bsam gtan gyi le'u/ 83wa 298drug pa/ bsrung ba'i le'u/ 83 298bdun pa/ gzhan gyi gnod pa brtag pa'i le'u/ 83 299brgyad pa/ zhi byed mchod thabs kyi le'u/ 83 300dgu pa/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi le'u/ 83 300dum bu gnyis pa bstan pa/ 83ge300bcu pa/ drag sngags khros pa'i le'u/ 23 300bcu gcig pa/ bum pa khros pa'i le'u/ 83 301bcu gnyis pa/ 'khor lo khros pa/'i le'u/ 83nge301bcu gsum pa/ phur pa khros pa'i le'u/ 83 302bcu bzhi pa/ me dpung khros pa'i le'u/ 83 302bco lnga pa/ ri rab khros pa'i le'u/ 83 303dum bu gsum pa bstan pa/ 83 303188wa 445

bcu drug pa/ las phra mo'i le'u/ 83 304bcu bdun pa/ rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u/ 83 304dz+nyā na kā ras bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(305) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(307)0go0 rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhes bya ba/ 83 308dang po/ 'jug pa rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83 308gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83ge312gsum pa/ gsang sngags rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83 321bzhi nga// ting nge 'dzin rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83ge323lnga pa/ gsang sngags kyi ye shes rnam par bsgyings pa'i rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83ge344drug pa/ phyag rgya'i mchod pa rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83 364bdun pa/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i ye shes sgrub pa rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83wa 373brgyad pa/ sbyor ba'i thabs kyis sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83—379dgu pa// sbyin sreg rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83ge388bcu pa/ cho ga thams cad bstan pa rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83 395zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang ngo/sa bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(403) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(428)0ga1 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 83 429dang po/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim par phye ba/ 82—429gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rim par phye ba/ 83ge433108wa 446

gsum pa/ las kyi rim par phye ba/ 82—434bzhi pa/ rnam par rtog pa gsod pa'i rdo rje'i 'phrul 'khor dang sngags dang sman gyis gsad pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba/ 83wa 436lnga pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi go rim bri ba rim par phye ba/ 82—442drug pa/ 'khor lo rnam par bri ba rim par phye ba/ 83nga444bdun pa/ dgug pa la sogs pa'i sbyor ba'i rim par phye ba/ 82—446brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 83 448dgu pa/ 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed ces bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 82—450bcu pa/ rjes su dran pa rim par phye ba/ 83 451bcu gcig pa/ spyod pa ston pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud rim par phye ba/ 82—453bcu gnyis pa/ nye bar mkho ba'i las kyi khyad par thams cad rim par phye ba/ 83 455bcu gsum pa/ dngos grub nges par bstan pa rim par phye ba/ 82—457bcu bzhi pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs rim par phye ba/ 83 460bco lnga pa/ lus med rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rim par phye ba/ 82—465bcu drug pa/ he ru ka sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba/ 83 466bcu bdun pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rim nga/ra phye ba/ 83ge467bco brgyad pa/ 82—470rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen ngo/ mkhas pa dī ṭ+wāṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dbe slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/slad kyis lots+tsha ba dge slong dar ma grags kyis bcos la/ de las kyang dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bcos/bsdur mchan/(472) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(484)052 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 83jo485188wa 447

dang po/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rtog pa/ 82—485gnyis pa/ las thams cad grub pa'i rtog pa/ 83 488gsum pa/ sngags btu ba bstan pa'i rtog pa/ 83 495bzhi pa/ sgom pa'i rtog pa/ 83 goralnga pa/ bris sku'i cho ga'i rtog pa/ 83ge501drug pa/ sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga rgya che ba'i rtog pa/ 83 504bdun pa/ bsam gtan gyi las bsgrub pa brtag pa'i rtog pa/ 83 508bla ma dam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon dpal khā li ta badz+ras bton nas mdzad/rgya sar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa bā ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(514) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(521)0ston dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog pa gsum pa zhes bya ba/ 83 522dang po/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rtog pa/ 83 522gnyis pa/ 'jam dpal gyi rtog pa las dam rdzas sman du bsgyur te bstan pa'i cho ga'i rtog pa/ 83 528gsum pa/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i cho ga las las kyi rgyud dang grogs bstan pa'i rtog pa/ 83 530zur mchan/ sde bka'i dkar chag tu 6'gyur byang ma 'khod kyang / paṇ+ḍi ta a ṭa dang rong zom gyis bsgyur bar grags zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(531) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(536)108wa 448

0go4 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 83 531 dang po/ thabs dang shes rab kyi bsam gtan bstan pa'i le'u/ 83 537gnyis pa/ sbyor ba'i le'u/ 83 540gsum pa/ bris sku'i le'u/ 83 546bzhi pa/ sbyin sreg gi rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 83 547paṇ+ḍi ta chen pa a mo gha'i zhabs nus pa can dang bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa ban+de chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur cing zhus/slad kyis grub thob chen po kuṇ+ḍa shrī'i zhal snga nas mnyan te/ thar pa lots+tsha ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(553) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(559)0ston gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa/ 83 560zur ma na/ sde bka'i dkar chag tu 'gyur byang ma 'khod kyang / dī paṃ ka ra dang rwa lo'i 'gyur zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(562) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(563)0ga6 te'u lo pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 83 564rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī po ka ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba rwa rdo rje grasas kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(567) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(567)0497 gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i 'khor lo las thams cad grub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 83 568paṇ+ḍi ta bā ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas rwa rdo rje grabs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/bsdur mchan/(594) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(601)188wa 449

058 dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 83 602dang po/ mngon rtogs kyi rim par phye ba/ 83 602gnyis pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi skabs rim par phye ba/ 83 610gsum pa/ sngags kyis 'gugs pa rab tu sbyor ba rim par phye ba/ 83 618bzhi pa/ 'jigs par byed pa zhes bya ba rim par phye ba/ 83 620lnga pa/ rgyal po sgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 83 622drug pa/ pha rol gyi dmag nyams par bya ba rim par phye ba/ 83 625bdun pa/ mi snang ba dang mig sman dang bcud len sgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 83 627brgyad pa/ grib gnon bsgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 83 632dgu pa/ ro langs gnod sbyin mo bsgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 83 634bcu pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 83 640bcu gcig pa/ gtor ma'i rim par phye ba/ 83 643bcu gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rim par phye ba/ 83 khyi49bcu gsum pa/ dbang bskur ba dang 'khrul 'khor gyi snang ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ ci 83 651bcu bzhi pa/ spyod pa'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba/ 83 653bco lnga pa/ thabs thams cad sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba/ 83 655bcu drug pa/ dngos grub nges pa'i rim par phye ba/ 83 657bcu bdun pa/ lus med pa la sogs pa'i rim par phye ba/ 83ba660bco brgyad pa/ byang chub sems kyi rim par phye ba/ 83 665bcu dgu pa/ pha rol gyi grong du 'jug pa rim par phye ba/ 83 669bla ma chos kyi rgyal ngo 'i gsung bi 'od zer dang bho ṭa paṇ+ḍi ta'i sasung dang mi'i dbang 708wa 450
