rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'jug pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/ 100 3ye shes kyi le'u'i rgyas 'grel/ 100 3dang po/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la sogs pa spro ba'i mdor bsdus chen po/ 100 3gnyis nga// sku bzhi la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pa nges pa'i mdor bsdus chen po/ 100 70gsum pa/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba'i mdor bsdus chen po/ 100 89bzhi pa/ thabs sna tshogs kyis 'dul ba'i mdor bsdus chen po/ 100 194kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo/ so ma nā tha dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po 'byo dge slong shes rab grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab pa/dus phyis yon tan phul du byung ba bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal ngo/'i bka' lung dang /dngo na chen shākya bzang ngo 'i sasu nga bzhin du/ mkhas pa chen ngo/ zhang ston mdo sde dang la dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul khong du chud pa 'i dbe slong tshul khrims dar gyis/ don gyi cha la dpyad cing lesas pa ra bskul te/ legs pa ra sbyar ba'i skad kyis brda sprod nga/'i bstan bcos ris pa 'i lo tsā ba dbe slong shong ston gyis dpa la sa skya'i gtsug las khang chen ngo ra yu la dbus kyi rgya dpe sanyis la satusas shing legs pa/ra bcos te gtan la phab/slar yang bla ma dam pa/ chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang / dang la ldan dus kyi 'khor lo nga dharma krirti shrī bha dras/ 'di'i don rnams legs pa ra dbongs shing /bka' yis bskal nas de das bi sasung bzhin du/ pa ṇ+ḍi ta chen ngo sbir ma ti'i bka' drin la~X lebs par sbyar ba'i tshul ris pa lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / blo gros dpal bzang ngo sa rgyud dang 'grel pa/'i rgya dpe mang po la gtugs nas das pa rnams dang mthun par bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/188—623

zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di sde bka'i dkar chag tu 6rgyas 'grel 'di nyid bstan bcos su gtogs kyang / sngags kyi tshul thams cad kyi nges gsang bla na med pa dgrol bar byed pa'i rgyud 'grel ma lus pa'i rgyal ngo lta bu yin zhing ston pa 'di nyid kyi bka' dang mtshungs par bkur sti bya ba'i phyir/ sngon gyi mkhas pa dag bis bkod pa ltar 'dir yang par du bsgrubs pa/ yin no/ / zhes 'khod/bsdur mchan/(267) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(274)1117 de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsgrub pa'i don mngon par thob pa'i rgyu/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho ston pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gtsug tor dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 100 275zur mchan/ chos tshan 'di'i 'gyur byang gzhung dngos la mi snang zhing / yongs grags su lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes bsgyur bar grags kyang / 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉par ma'i mtshan byang 'phar ma gnyis kyi dbur 66 rgyal pos bsgyur bar mdzad pa'i mi zhes 'khod pa dang / pe cing dga' ldan byin chags gling du par ma zhig yod par zur du rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bsgyur byang zhig bzhugs pa 'di ltar/ 66rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dang/'a bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba theg pa/ chen po'i mdo'i bsgyur byang /sde snod gsum dang gsung rab yan las bcu gnyis kyi chos thams cad kyi 'byung khungs ni/ 'phags pa'i yul nas byung zhing dar ba las rim gyis yul dbus 'dir yongs su dar bar gyur to//thog mar nub phyogs nas shar phyogs su dar ba'i tshe dbus btsang brgyud nas dar ba yin te/ 'phasas pa/'i yul ni rgya gar ro/ /dbus gtsang ni bod do/ /de'i phyir da lta'i rgya nag la bsgyur ba'i chos thams cad bod du tshang bar yod kyang / dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo gcig pu ma tshang ngo/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/bod yul nas skabs shig tu rgyal po glang dar ma'i ring la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig cing bsnubs nas mdo rgyud kyi glegs bam mer bsregs pa dang /108—624

sa 'og tu sbas pas de'i dus su kha 'thor nas ma tshang bar gyur to//de'i rjes su mkhas pa rnas kyi kha bskangs nas tshang bar 'bri snyam yang / ma dpe ngos ma med pas rang dgar bsnan nas 'brir mi rung ba'i phyir na snon par ma byas so / /de la bu ston gyis gsung rab 'di lo lnga brgya song ba'i rjes su yul dbus nyid du bsgyur nas bod kyi yul du mngon par dar bar 'ong zhes lung du bstan pa yin zhes rgyal srid kyi slob dpon lcang skya hu thog thus bstan bcos las gsal bar mthong ba nges par yid ches pa'i rtags su bya bar rung ngo//nged kyis bya ba khri phrag gi bkod pa byed pa'i long skabs rnams su/ rgyun du gzhung lugs rnams mañju'i skad du bsgyur 'dun che ba'i phyir rtsis kyi gzhung / lugs kyi gzhung / snyan dngags kyi gzhung dang / rgya'i rig byed bzhi'i gzhung dang bcas pa rdzogs par bsgyur ba yin/ yang bsam nga la/ mes rgyal po'i ring la shes rab snying po skad rigs bzhis bsgyur zhing / yab rgyal pos par brkos te kun la bkram par mdzad pa yin/dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'di yang sngar srol bzhin bsgyur e chog ces rgyal srid kyi slob dpon lcang skya hu thog thu la dris par 'di yang snga ma dang 'dra zhing shes rab snying ngo sngar nas bod du yod la/ dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bod du gzhi nas med pas/ gal te rgya nag gi skad nas mañju'i skad du dang / mañju'i skad nas hor gyi skad du dang / hor gyi skad nas bod kyi skad du bsgyur na bu ston gyis lung bstan pa/'i gsung dang mthun pa yin no / /ji ltar ji lta ba bzhin du mi 'ong yang mi zhum par nan tan ma bskyed na mi chog par 'dug pas/thob chin wang la don 'di nyid shes su chub ces bka' phab ste rgyal srid kyi slob dpon lcang skya hu thob thu dang yang rlu na'i sogs kha shas kyis legs par dpyad cing gros bsdur gyis bsgyur nas le tshan le tshan du bris nas gzigs su phul ba rnams nged kyis phyi bshol med par nan tan gyis bcos/ the tshom za ba'i rigs la 'phral du rgyal srid kyi slob dpon lcang skya hu thos thu nas gros bsdur gyis nges par thab bcad pa'o//mdo 'di gnam skyong bi gnam lo chu sprel nas chu lus sga bar du bsgyur te rdzogs pa/ra byas so/ /thob chin wang gis 'di yi bsgyur byang bka' rtsom bka' drin skyong dbos 188—625

tshul zhus pa la brten nas 'di byas pa yin/ nged kyi dgongs pa la dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo 'di/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pas rang nyid kyi dgongs pa'i de bzhin nyid zab mo yang dag par bstan pa'i lugs srol mthar thug pa de rang blos tshig nas bkrol na phyin ci log tu 'gro ba'i phyir mi rung na de la bsgyur byang byed pa'i dbos pa ci yod/ de lta mod kyi 'dir ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bsung ji lta ba bzhin du bsgyur ba yin/spyir srung gi rgyal srid dang/ snying gi rgyal srid gnyis kyi dus su hā shang rnams kyis lugs srol dar bar byas shing don bkral ba'i bstan bcos kyi tshul dang mthun pa/ra phan tshun brgal zhing gtubs nas brjod kyis mi langs pa dang 'dra'o//dper na bkres pa la zas dang skom pa la btung ba byin nga nyid kyis chos bi/ sha dang de'i khu ba sogs zas bsod pa byin nas 'dod pa khengs dbos pa/ min pa/ bzhin no/ /tshul 'dis bltas na sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/sa thugs mi rtog pa ra sanas shing lta ba drang ngo ra mdzad nas don dam pa'i bden pa nges pa/ra ma rtogs pa'i bdul bya rnams kyi blo mis kun rdzob sna tshogs kyi 'ja' tshon kha dos sna lngas bsgribs su med pas 'di las sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa ra byas nas rjes 'jug bi slob ma rnams kyis ris par bya ba'i slad du/ mes rgyal po dang yab rgyal pos sher snying bsgyur nas phyogs kun du dar bar byas pa/'i srol dang cung zad mthun pa yin no/ /sanam skyong bi lo nyer brgyad pa 'i zla ba bcu nga/'i tshes bco brgyad/ mices 'khod pa/sa/ lcang skya rol pa/'i rdo rjes gtso byas te song ma chen lung dang yang h+phu na'i sogs kyis bsgyur bar mngon no//chos tshan 'di bka' 'gyur gyi skor las ches rjes mar bsgyur ba zhig yin pas/ par du 'khod min la mkhas pa rnams la bka' 'dri zhus shing / 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gsu ma la'ang bzhugs pas 'dir par du bskrun pa yin la/ chos tshan 'di spyir mdo sde'i gras su 'jug tu rung na'ang glegs bam gyi che chung dang bstun te 'dir bcug pa yin no//bsdur mchan/(585) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(595)788—626

bdun / rnying rgyud pod gsum dang kun mkhyen bus gzungs phran rnams phyogs gcig tu bkod pa'i skor/(1118wa 1142)rnying rgyud/ () (1༷ 1)1112 chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ 101 3dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 101 3gnyis nga / chos nyid mngon du phyung nas bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 ldagasum pa/ ji ltar byung ba'i khungs bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—4bzhi pa/ nga nyid kyi mtshan bshad pa'i le'u/ 101—10lnga pa/ don gyi 'grel pa'i le'u/ 101wa 12drug pa/ rtsa ba gcig pa'i le'u/ 101—13bdun pa/ rnam grangs bsdus pa'i le'u/ 101—19brgyad pa/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin la sa chos nyid kyi yul kun la bkod pa'i le'u/ 101 22dgu pa/ rgol sgrib skyon sel gyi le'u/ 101wa 26bcu pa/ phun sum tshogs pa shin tu dkon pa'i le'u/ 101 31bcu gcig pa/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po nyid kho nar 'dus pa'i le'u/ 101 39bcu gnyis pa/ nges par lung khungs bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—41bcu gsum pa/ sems kyi bshad lugs kyi le'u/ 101—43bcu bzhi pa/ skal med la gsang ba'i le'u/ 101—47188wa 627

bco lnga pa/ rang bzhin rnam pa gsum mngon du phyung ba'i le'u/ 101—48bcu drug sems dpa' rdo rje la gdams ngag rdzog pa'i le'u/ 101ge55bcu bdun pa/ sku gdung gtad pa'i le'u/ 101 56bco brgyad/ btsal bas mi 'grub pa'i le'u/ 101 57bcu dgu pa/ ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa'i le'u/ 101—naranyi shu pa/ chos thams cad byang chub sems kun byed las byung ba'i khungs kyi le'u/ 101 59nyer gcig pa/ gtan tshigs bshad lugs kyi le'u/ 101wa 61nyer gnyis pa/ bya med rdzogs pa'i lung bcu las mi gnas yul med kyi le'u/ 101 63nyer gsum pa/ bya med rdzogs pa las lta ba yul med kyi nam mkha'i dgongs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 67nyer bzhi pa/ bya med rdzogs pa phyag rgya 'gyur med kyi lung gi le'u/ 101—47nyer lnga pa/ rang sems ston par phyung ba'i le'u/ 101 68nyer drug pa/ bya med rdzogs pa bsgom du med pa'i le'u/ 101 70nyer bdun pa/ bya med rdzogs pa rnam dag dbyings kyi lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 101rdo72nyer brgyad pa/ bya med rdzogs pa 'gyur med btsal mi rnyed pa'i le'u/ 101 73nyer dgu pa/ dgongs pa rnal du bzhag pa'i le'u/ 101khe75sum cu pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi le'u/ 101wa 78so gcig pa/ rdo rje tshig drug bi le'u/ 101she83so gnyis pa/ nges pa tshig bzhi'i le'u/ 101 83so gsum pa/ nges pa'i lung dang drang ba'i lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 84108wa 628

so bzhi pa/ dbongs pa 'dus pa'i lung gi le'u/ 101wa 87so lnga pa/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—90so drug pa/ sku gsung thugs su 'dus pa'i le'u/ 101—11so bdun pa/ bsgom du med pa'i mdo lung gi le'u/ 101khe93so brgyad pa/ lta spyod kyi bol sgrib bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—95so dgu pa/ rgyal ba'i snying po'i le'u/ 101 98bzhi bcu pa/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—100zhe gcig pa/ ngo bo gcig pa'i le'u/ 101wa 102zhe gnyis pa/ bcos su med pa'i le'u/ 101—104zhe gsum pa/ ston par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i le'u/ 101wa 105zhe bzhi pa/ rdzogs chen skal med don med kyi le'u/ 101wa 107zhe lnga pa/ lta ba bsgom med kyi le'u/ 101wa 109zhe drug pa/ dam tshig bsrung du med pa'i le'u/ 101—113zhe bdun pa/ phrin las btsal du med pa'i le'u/ 101—116zhe brgyad pa/ chos thams cad kyi gzhi ma kun byed nyid yin par bstan pa'i le'u/ 101wa 119zhe dgu pa/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la sbyang du med pa'i le'u/ 101—122lnga bcu pa/ rang 'byung ye shes bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—124nga gcig pa/ lam la bgrod du med pa'i le'u/ 101—126nga gnyis pa/ ma g.yos 'dod pa med pa'i le'u/ 101—129nga gsum pa/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin g.yos pa med pa'i le'u/ 101—131nga bzhi pa/ mdo lung thams cad kun byed nyid kyi rang bzhin du bsdus nas bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—134nga lnga pa/ chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems las med pa'i le'u/ 101wa 137108wa 629

nga drug pa/ sems dpa' rdo rjes kun byed kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i sgo nas bsgrags pa'i le'u/ 101wa 140nga bdun pa/ mdo las bstan pa gtad pa'i le'u/ 101—141rgya gar gyi mkhas pa shrī si ha pra bhā dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba pa gor be+e ro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab/nga brgyad pa/ rtogs pa gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 101—142nga dgu pa/ skye ba med pa'i le'u/ 101—144drug cu pa/ bsrung med dam tshig gi le'u/ 101—146re gcig pa/ sgo gsum bya ba med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 101—147re gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor bskyed du med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 101—149re gsum pa/ rang 'byung rtogs pa'i dbang gi le'u/ 101—151re bzhi pa/ lam la bgrod du med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 101—152re lnga pa/ sa la sbyang du med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 101—154re drug pa/ spyod pa blang dor med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 101—155re bdun pa/ ye shes bsgrib pa med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 101—157re brgyad pa/ lhun grub btsal du med par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 101—159re dgu pa/ rtogs pa bsgrags shing bstod pa'i le'u/ 101—160bdun cu pa/ bsgom du yod med bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—162don gcig pa/ lta sgom dbyer med pa'i le'u/ 101—164don gnyis pa/ lta sgom 'dar med pa'i le'u/ 101—166don gsum pa/ ji bzhin pa la bya rtsol dang bral bar gnas pa'i le'u/101—167don bzhi pa/ snying po don la gnas pa'i le'u/ 101—169don lnga pa/ rig pa dbang sgyur la gnas pa'i le'u/ 101—170don drug pa/ snying po lam la gnas pa'i le'u/ 101—172don bdun pa/ don la sbyang med kyi le'u/ 101—173108wa 630

don brgyad pa/ mnyam pa la blang dor med par bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—175don dgu pa/ mi sgrib pa'i le'u/ 101wa 177brgyad cu pa/ lhun grub re dogs bcad pa'i le'u/ 101—178gya gcig pa/ dgongs don lde mig gi le'u/ 101wa 180gya gnyis pa/ rjes su bstod pa'i le'u/ 101—183gya gsum pa/ bstan pa gang la gzhag pa'i le'u/ 101wa 184gya bzhi pa/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—186rgya bar gyi mkhan po dpal gyi seng ge mabon po dang dge slong bai ro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(189) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(218)1119 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor grub pa'i lung kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa chos kyi rnam grangs rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 101 219byung tshul bstan pa dang po/ 101 219dang po/ thun mong bca' gzhi'i le'u/ 101 219gnyis pa/ gdams ngas nges nga/ra gzhag nga/'i le'u/ 101—224gsum pa/ thog mar dam pas gdung ba bton pa'i le'u/ 101 228bzhi pa/ gang bi gdung ba sel bar bgros pa'i le'u/ 101wa 230lnga pa/ lung dam pa bgro bar gsol ba btab pa'i le'u/ 101wa 232drug pa/ gang rmongs nga/ gdung ba sel ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 101wa 237byung tshul bstan pa gnyis pa/ 101 240188wa 631

bdun pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cho 'phrul yongs su bkod pa'i le'u/ 101 240brgyad pa/ gsang sngags rang gi ngo bo bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 253byung tshul bstan pa gsum pa/ 101 258dgu pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i de kho na nyid ston pa'i le'u/ 101 258bcu pa/ khyad par dam pa'i le'u/ 101 267bcu gcig pa/ rgyud dag pa'i skye rgyud bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 270bcu gnyis pa/ dbulas chen po yongs su phyin pa'i le'u/ 101 276bcu gsum pa / skyes bu dam pa dbang thob pa'i le'u/ 101she281bcu bzhi pa// skyes bu dam pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 286byung tshul bstan pa bzhi pa/ 101 291bco lnga pa/ gsang ba dam pa de kho na nyid du nges pa'i le'u/ 101 291byung tshul bstan pa lnga pa/ 101 301bcu drug pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 301bcu bdun pa/ chos snang ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i le'u/ 101ge311bco brgyad pa/ kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/101 316bcu dgu pa/ gang yongs su rdzogs par 'grel ba'i le'u/ 101—320byung tshul bstan pa drug pa/ 101 327nyi shu pa/ gang yongs su ma dag pa'i skye rgyud bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 327nyer gcig nga / 'das pa sngon byung ba'i le'u/ 101ge335nyer gnyis pa/ ru tra nas po'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 338nyer gsum pa / gang gi cho 'phrul bskul ba'i le'u/ 101 343nyer bzhi pa/ 'dus pa chen ngo/sa rnam par bgros pa'i le'u/ 101 348nyer lnga pa/ bka' bgros dam pa bcad pa'i le'u/ 101—350nyer drug pa/ las bzhi rdo rje skos kyi le'u/ 101wa 357108wa 632

nyer bdun pa/ bdud yongs su btul ba'i le'u/ 101 361nyer brgyad pa/ tha ma dman pa'i gdung ba bton pa'i le'u/ 101 371nyer dgu nga / rgyud yongs su sbyangs pa'i le'u/ 101 375sum cu pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa bskul ba'i le'u/ 101wa 377so gcig pa/ thar pa nag po gol ba la ma rgol bar lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 101wa 380byung tshul bstan pa bdun pa/ 101 393so gnyis pa/ thugs ye shes snang ba dam pa'i rgyan bkod pa'i le'u/ 101wa 393so gsum pa/ sku yongs su snang ba dam pa'i rgyan bkod pa'i le'u/ 101wa 403so bzhi pa/ gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bkod pa'i le'u/ 101—410so lnga pa/ spyod pami zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo bkod pa'i le'u/ 101—425byung tshul bstan pa brgyad pa/ 101—428so drug pa/ rmongs pa'i sel ba spyod mthun dgrol ba'i le'u/ 101—428so bdun pa/ gang gi dri ba the tshom bcad pa'i le'u/ 101—440so brgyad pa/ sngon du byung ba gtam rgyud yongs su brjod pa'i le'u/ 101—449byung tshul bstan pa dgu pa/ 101—460so dgu pa/ thugs kyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 101—460bzhi bcu pa/ gsung gi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 101—463zhe gcig nga// thabs kyi mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs nga/'i le'u/ 101—466zhe gnyis pa/ sku'i mdzad nga yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u/ 101—468byung tshul bstan pa bcu pa/ 101—469zhe gsum pa// rjes su byung bar lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—469byung tshul bstan pa bcu gcig pa/ 101—473zhe bzhi pa/ cho 'phrul sngon byung bi le'u/ 101—473108wa 633

byung tshul bstan pa bcu gnyis pa/ 101—478zhe lnga pa/ bkod pa rnam par 'grel pa'i le'u/ 101—478zhe drug pa/ bsdu ba rnam par 'grel pa'i le'u/ 101—490zhe bdun pa/ gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—491zhe brgyad pa/ rtsa ba sbyor ba'i yan lag bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—497zhe dgu pa/ 'brel pa dgos ched kyi yan lag bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 503lnga bcu pa/ yongs su 'dren pa'i yan lag rnam par bgros pa'i le'u/101—na07nga gcig pa/ nges pa dam pa'i yan lag bgros pa'i le'u/ 101 509nga gnyis pa/ 'jug pa thabs kyi yan lag las thabs rnam par 'grel pa'i le'u/ 101wa 509nga gsum pa/ mdo rgya cher 'grel pa'i le'u/ 101 511nga bzhi pa/ chos thams cad kyi me long bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 512nga lnga pa/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gang gi mun pa'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 523nga drug pa/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gang snang ba dag pa'i spyod yul bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 543nga bdun pa/ rnal 'byor rang bzhin gyi le'u/ 101 548nga brgyad pa/ de kho na nyid gsang ba'i dam pa ljon shing bskyed pa'i le'u/ 101wa 553nga dgu pa/ rnal 'byor rjes 'jug gi le'u/ 101 556drug cu pa/ rnal 'byor mig gi sgron ma bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 562re gcig pa/ rnal 'byor sa'i sgron ma bstan pa'i le'u/ 101 565re gnyis pa/ yul dam pa la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 101 569re gsum pa/ nye bar mtshon pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 101 573108wa 634

re bzhi pa/ sgyu ma rol nga/sa rnam par rol pas rnam par grol ba'i le'u/ 101wa 577re lnga pa/ rang 'byung bdud rtsi'i le'u/ 101 581re drug pa/ dam tshig gsang ba'i mchog gi le'u/ 101 586re bdun pa/ bsnyen bkur dam pa mchog gi le'u/ 101ba598re brgyad pa/ chos thams cad kyi sgo rab tu dbye ba'i le'u/ 101 609re dgu pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—413bdun cu pa/ rnal 'byor dam pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 101r+sha616don gcig pa/ rnal 'byor spyod 'jug gi le'u/ 101 618don gnyis pa/ the tshom yongs su gcod pa'i le'u/ 101 638don gsum pa/ rnal 'byor dbang sgyur gyi le'u/ 101 640don bzhi pa/ don nges par bsgrub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 101 651don lnga pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa 'dus pa'i le'u/ 101 653rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo/ dharma bo dhi dang / ring lugs chen po dā na rak+ṣi ta dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba che btsan skyes kyis bru sha'i yi ge las bru sha'i yul gyi khrom du bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(673) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(748)1120 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba/ gsang ba'i mdzod chen po mi zad pa gter gyi sgron ma/ brtul zhugs chen po bsgrub pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 101rdo7gdang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 101—449gnyis pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rim par phye ba'i sgo nas gleng bslang ba 108wa 635

dang sngags kyi spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 101wa 755gsum pa/ sngags kyi mdo bstan pa'i le'u/ 101wa 769bzhi pa/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i le'u/ 101—771lnga pa/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi mdo bstan pa'i le'u/ 101wa 774drug pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba'i le'u/ 101 785bdun pa/ gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 101 789brgyad pa/ phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'i le'u/ 101 795dgu pa/ 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/ 101ger00bcu pa/ 'jigs byed rnams kyi phyag rgya bstan pa'i le'u/ 101—808bcu gcig pa/ bsnyen bsgrub rnam bzhi bshad pa'i le'u/ 101 812bcu gnyis pa/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rnam grangs bshad pa'i le'u/ 101wa 817bcu gsum pa/ dam tshig rnam par bkod pa'i le'u/ 101 844bcu bzhi pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi le'u/ 101—852bco lnga pa/ las kyi rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 101—854bcu drug pa/ nan tur gyi las rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 101go860rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo badz+ra bi shwa mi tra dang zhu chen lots+tsha ba pa sor bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te satan la phab/bcu bdun pa/ gsang ba phyi ma rnam par bkod pa'i le'u/ 101khe865bsdur mchan/(898) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(936)rnying rgyud/ 0 (10 2)1123 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po khro bo rdo rje'i rigs kun 'dus rig 188wa 636

pa'i mdo rnal 'byor grub pa'i rgyud ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 102 3dang po/ rnal 'byor rang bzhin gyi le'u/ 102—3gnyis pa/ rnal 'byor rjes su 'jug pa'i le'u/ 102 50gsum pa/ cho 'phrul bstan pa'i le'u/ 102—75bzhi pa/ dam tshig gsang ba mchog bi le'u/ 102—84lnga pa/ rnal 'byor brda'i le'u/ 102 97drug pa/ rnal 'byor bde ba'i tshogs kyi le'u/ 102wa 100bdun pa/ 'das pa sngon byung gi le'u/ 102—110brgyad pa/ skong ba las kyi bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 102wa 122dgu pa/ rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 102—142bcu pa/ gsang sbyor sgrub pa'i le'u/ 102wa 155bcu gcig pa/ rdo rje tshe bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 102—162bcu gnyis pa/ tshogs chen 'dus pa'i bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 102wa 165bcu gsum pa/ rdo rje rig 'dzin bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 102—184bcu bzhi pa/ rmad byung rdzas kyi le'u/ 102—184bco lnga pa/ mngon shes rig pa'i bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 102wa 199bcu drug pa/ rdo rje thal chen gyi sgrub thabs kyi le'u/ 102—201bcu bdun pa/ mchog phran thabs kyis bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 102 203bco brgyad pa/ sgyu ma rdo rje'i bsgrub lugs kyi le'u/ 102go204bcu dgu pa/ thig le sgrub pa'i le'u/ 102 205nyi shu pa/ dregs pa can gnon pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 102 208nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'khor ba thams cad sgrol ba bsgrub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 102 210108wa 637

sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje theg /dngos grub gnyis kyi gter gyur zhes gsungs pa'i/ /gsang chen sngags kyi phreng ba mtshar du dngar/ /smin byed dbang gi rtsa ba sa la zug /grol byed lam gyi rtse mo dgung la reg /sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mngar ba'i ljon pa che/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chos tshul e ma ho/ /zhes bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las / gsang sngags rgyud 'bum du grags pa'i skor rdzogs so// //de ltar bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma 'di la spyir chos tshan chig stong chig brgya zhe gnyis bzhugs la/ de dag las 'dul ba'i skor la spyir chos tshan brgyad dang / 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉la 'dul ba'i mjug tu byung ba'i smon lam chos tshan bcu drug bsnan pas nyer bzhi/ sher phyin skor la nyer gsum/gsar 'gyur mdo tshan bcu gsum/ phal po che la gcig /dkon brtsegs la zhe dgu/ theg pa che chung gi mdo mang gi skor la nyis brgya dang don bzhi/gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhir gtogs pa bzhi brgya dang nga bzhi/ bsngo smon shis brjod skor la bcu dgu/ gzungs 'dus la nyis brgya nga brgyad/ rgyas 'grel dri med 'od la gcig /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo gsar 'gyur la gcig /rnying rgyud la nyer bzhi/ kun mkhyen bu ston chen ngo/sa phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa'i gzungs phran gyi skor la spyir bzhi brgya tham pa yod na'ang 'dir chos tshan gcig tu byas yod pa rnams so//de dag las gang dang gang mdo rgyud gnyis kur 'khod pa/ dgos pa'i dbang gis bskyar zlos su song ba/ 'gyur mi 'dra bar bkod pa dang le'u'i grangs dang / 'gyur byang mi 'dra ba sogs ni chos tshan so so'i ngos thad du zur mchan gyis gsal bar byas yod do//108—675

spyir chos tshan gyi grangs ni dkar chag so so mi 'dra zhing / de'ang chos tshan mang nyung gis min par par du rko lugs dang dkar chag tu mtshan byang 'debs lugs mi 'dra bas yin la/ dper na/ rtsa rgyud phyi ma rgyud lta bu la 'ga' res chos tshan gcig dang 'ga' res gnyis su byas pa dang / bdud rtsi bam brgyad lta bu'ang de dang 'dra'o//de bas na 'dir ma phyi sde par sor bzhag byas yod stabs/ chos tshan gyi bzhugs byang go rim grangs la sogs pa de dang 'dra bar bkod yod la/ gzhan chos tshan so so'i bam grangs dang sho lo ma'i grangs/ gsang sngags skor gyi chos tshan rnams rgyud dang rigs gang du gtogs pa / dkyil 'khor gyi grangs la sogs pa rnams ni dkar chag gzhan du rgyas par 'byung bas 'dir bskyar zlos kyi ngal ba ma byas so//smras pa/ 'pho med bde chen zla ba dag pa'i dpal//zung 'jug dgongs pa nam yang g.yo med kyang //'phrin las snang ba rgya mtsho'i sprin bzhin du//'gyur bar ston 'di rgyal ba'i thugs rje lags//gang gsung 'od rdul phra mo gcig tsam yang /rna bar lhung na srid pa hrul po ru//nges par bgyid na bka' gsung ji snyed par//lta dang klog par byed rnams smos ci dgos//zhes bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las/ chos tshan gyi bzhugs byang dang le'u sogs dpe bsdur ma'i sgrig rim ltar mthar chags su bkod pa ste/ skabs gsum pa rdzogs so// //108—676

0109 : lha mo dpal phreng gi seng ge'i sgra zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 44wa 7120999 lha mo gtsug tor rol pa'i tan+t+ra/ 9shad4360469 lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa/ 81wa 9390086) lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 43wa 3700242: lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 63wa 4430347 lha'i mdo/ 72wa 7330348 lha'i mdo nyung ngu / 72wa 7390097〉 lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 43 8300179 : lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 59wa 2710703 lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ 91wa 7721096 lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ 9sdod8900021 lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa gsum gyis bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa/ 13wa 9380022 lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 13wa 94308go lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 96wa 8571107 lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ 98 wa947188—754

083na k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i gzungs/ 96wa 428106ta k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i gzungs/ 98wa 685smras pa/ bla dang srog gis rnyed pa'i yid bzhin nor//lung rtogs chos tshul dal 'bab rnam bzhi'i klung //'dzad med nam mkha'i khyon gyis ma zin pa//thub pas rtag tu tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'doms//yang dag dam chos bdud rtsi'i ro bda' ba//mthong ba med na snying po ji ltar lon//de phyir phra zhib rigs pa'i gru gzings kyis//mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i klong la 'jug par mdzod//dmigs med ting 'dzin zas kyi mgron kha la//dgyes/ par rol ba'i spobs pa ma mchis kyang //ldong btsan snang ngu'i lhag bsam sor mo yis//rnam dkar las kyi 'khor lo 'di tsam bskor//bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las/ 'tshol bde ba'i ched du chos tshan gyi bzhugs byang rnams dmigs bsal ka mad kyi bo rim ltar bsgrigs pa ste/ skabs bzhi pa rdzogs so// //188—755

༄ga /mtshan dpe'i 'dab stong brtsegs pa'i gur khyim du//dgyes zhal ge sar dgod pa'i sgros bar nas//legs bshad sbrang char brdol ba'i pad+ma dkar//mi shigs snying gi ra bar rtag tu 'dzum//dka' spyad lo zla ring mo'i khugs pa ru//phangs pa'i srog gi smyug rtse brdar ba las//bka' gsung bod kyi skad du 'dren pa'i mgon//khyed kyi zhabs rjes gangs ri'i zom na 'tsher//stong gsum snod du bde gshegs rang bsrel gyis//bkang ba'i dpal la dang bas mchod pa bas//tshigs bcad gcig tsam 'bri ba'i bsod nams mtha'//brgya byin gyis kyang brjod nus min par gsungs//de phyir 'tshe med zhi ba chen po'i sman//mdo rgyud glegs bam brgya phrag nor bu'i phreng //par du zhus pa'i rnam dkar 'o ma'i mtsho//mkha' la 'gyur ba'i legs byas zad du med//de yang sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gzhon nus rlung dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kun dang / de re re la'ang nang gses rkyang ldan 'dus gsum gyi nad stobs drag zhan bar ma'i khyad par dang sbyar nas so sor thang phye ril bu la sogs pa'i gnyen 188—759

po'i sde tshan ma 'dres par/ lag len rnam par dag pas phra zhib tu gtong ba de bzhin du/ lha mi'i ston pa rnam 'dren shākya'i rgyal pos gdul bar bya ba mtha' dag gi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du las 'bras ston par 'os pa rnams la las 'bras nas bzung ste/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dang / bden pa bzhi dang / kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i gnas tshul dang / theg pa gsum gyi sa lam spyi dang / khyad par du byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang / phar phyin drug dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / sor thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum dang / khyim pa dang rab byung gi spyod tshul mtha' yas pa sogs gang la gang ston pa skabs su bab pa de dang de dag la rang rang gi blo kha dang 'tsham par 'phral phugs bde ba'i thabs su/ dam pa'i chos kyi rol mo tshangs pa'i dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i gdangs kyis bka' bstsal pa dag las cha shas shig /'jig rten gyi mig tu bsngags pa'i lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis/ bod rang gi skad du bsgyur yod pa ni bka' 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid yin pas/ 'di'i dgos pa rgya chen por dmigs te sngon chad lo rgyus steng du'ang / gser dngul gyi rnam grangs mang po phangs pa med par btang nas/bka' 'gyur bri ba dang par du bzhengs pa/ rdo la rko ba la sogs pa'i bgyi ba rlabs po che mang du spel nas/ de dag gi rgyun yang mang du 'phel yod na'ang /dus kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs dang / lhag par du rig gsar gyi god chag des bka' 'gyur bris ma dang par ma phal che ba zhig mi mngon stong pa'i dbyings su rgyas btab ste ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur yod do//da lam par du bsgrubs pa'i bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma 'di ni/ dus rabs 708—760

nyer gcig pa'i nang du / bka' 'gyur rin po che 'phrul par du btab pa thog ma yin la/ 'di par du bsgrubs pa'i dgos pa'i dbang du byas na/ mi rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang mi nyams gong du spel ba dang / sgos su bod skad du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gtong ba dang / yang sgos su 'tshe med zhi bde snying por gyur pa'i nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa 'di nyid ni/ dad mos tsam gtso bor byed pa ma yin par/rigs pa kho na gtso bor byed pa yin pas/ rigs pa yang dag gi lam nas/ lta sgom spyod 'bras la sogs pa gtan la 'bebs pa dang / rigs pa yang dag gi lam nas 'gro ba mi'i rigs lta ci/ srog chags phra mo tshun la'ang gnod pa spang zhing bde ba'i thabs la brtson pa la sogs pa ste/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug kun gyi rims nad drungs nas 'byin pa'i sman gyi ljon pa chen po dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i dngos po zad pa med par stsol ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu yin tsa na/de nyid 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir yun ring du gnas pa la thabs kyi sgo mo sna tshogs pa zhig mchis pa las/ rgyal ba'i bka' gsung ji snyed pa rjod byed yig 'bru'i rnam par byon pa dag par du bzhengs pa ni thabs dam par dmigs pa dang / ston pa'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa dag kyang phyi ma'i ched kho na tsam ma yin par/ tshe 'dir phan pa dang bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs gtso bor gsungs yod pas na/ sa sgang ril mo 'dir rkang rten 'cha' ba'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs ji srid du gnas pa de srid du sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa 'di med thabs med pa dang / lhag par deng gi dus 'dir/ rgyal khab dang rgyal khab kyi bar/ mi rigs dang mi rigs kyi bar/ sa phyogs yul phyogs sde ba tsho ba 108—761

sogs dang / tha na mi dang mi'i bar la nye ring chags sdang gis kun nas bslangs te 'thab rtsod 'khrug long sogs rang gzhan gnyis kur gnod pa'i las byed pa dag gi rna lam du dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i cha shas tsam zhig lhung ba dang lag len du btab pa yin na/ gling lnga'i 'gro ba thams cad pha ma bu tsha bzhin du/ rang 'gul gyis mthun sgril dang zhi bde chen po'i lam du bskyod thub par dmigs pa dang / dka' ba brgya phrag mang po khyad du bsad nas mdo rgyud dam chos mang po bod yul du drangs pa'i lo tsā ba chen po dag gi bka' drin rjes su dran par bya ba'i phyir dang / bstan pa zhes pa'i tha snyad tsam la'ang mgo bo rmongs shing / rang nyid bstan pa 'dzin par khas 'che bzhin bag med kyi las la 'dzem med du spyod pa'i deng dus kyi grwa sprul gzugs brnyan brdzus ma 'ga' re dang mi 'dra bar/nges pa don gyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i skyes bu chen po rnams kyi zhabs pad mi 'gyur rdo rje bzhin du brtan pa dang / yul phyogs thams cad du nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod 'khrug long sogs kyi ming tsam yang mi grags pa dang / rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin du char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang /tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / bkra shes dang bde legs kyi dge mtshan rgyun mi chad du 'byung ba la sogs pa ni 'di'i dgos pa yin no//phan yon gyi dbang du byas na/ ji skad du/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang bsgom pa'o/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bsod nams grangs med 'byung ba'i chos spyod bcu'i rim pa de'ang / gsung rab dri ma med pa 188wa 762

yi ger bris pa'i glegs bam la brten dgos pas na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos rnams glegs bam du bris pa dang / bcang ba dang / bklag pa la sogs pa lhur bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po brjod kyis mi langs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma nas mang du gsungs yod na'ang / 'dir mtshon tsam zhig 'god na/ dam chos pad dkar las/ gang zhig 'do 'di 'dzin pa des/ /nga yi mdun du dge 'dun la/ /mchod pa mang po byas pa yin/ /mos pa snying po gang gyur te/ /gang zhig mdo 'di klog pa'am/ /yi ger 'bri bar byed pa ste/ /de bas bsod nams mang du thob/ /mi 'ga' la las glegs bam la/ /shin tu nges tshig 'brir bcug ste/ /spos dang phreng ba byug pa yis/ /glegs bam de la mchod pa byed//spos kyi 'bru mar bkang ba yi/ /mar me rtag tu su 'bul zhing / /sna ma ut+pal sil ma dang / /tsam pa yis kyang rab tu gtor/ /glegs bam dag la 'di 'dra ba'i/ /mchod pa byed pa'i mi de ni/ /bsod nams mang po rab 'phel te/ /de la tshad kyang yong med do/ /ji ltar nam mkha'i khams kyi tshad/ /phyogs bcu dag ni thams cad du/ /rtag tu rnyed par 'gyur ma yin/ /bsod nams phung po 'di de 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa las kyang / la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /mchod rten rin chen bdun las byas shing mchod byed la/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag gang gā yi/ /bye ma snyed kyis bye ba phrag stong zhing bkang ste/ /yongs su brtag bzung zhing rnams bye ba mtha' yas na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyis/ /las gzhan mi byed lha yi me tog spos rab dang / /byug pas dus gsum bskal pa'am de bas lhag mchod la/ /gang zhig gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu 'byung 'gyur ba/ /108—763

bde bar gshegs kyi yum 'di glegs bam la bris te/ /'chang zhing me tog byug pas bsti stang byed gyur na/ /mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod/ /rgyal ba'i shes rab pha rol phyin 'di rig sngags che/ /sems can khams mang mya ngan sdug bsngal chos zhi byed/ /ces dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa'i mdo las/ gang gis rkang gnyis gtso bo rnams la ni/ /bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du/ /nor dang 'bru dang de bzhin gos dang rgyan/ /spos dang 'phreng ba byug pa phul ba bas/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di la dad byas te/ /nyan cing klog la yi ger 'dri byed pa/ /de la bsod nams tshad ni yod min te/ /bde bar gshegs pas de snyed tshad ma gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / deng gi dus snyigs ma lnga'i sprin nag long long du 'phyur te rgyal bstan nyin byed kyi dkyil 'khor snum zad kyi mar me bzhin du gyur pa'i dus 'dir ni de bas kyang phan yon lhag par 'byung ste/ theg pa chen po'i mdo las/ gang gis sangs rgyas stong rnams dang / /brgya dang bye ba grangs dag la/ /bskal pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed/ /de snyed bskal par bkur ba bas/ /'jig rten mgon gyis gsungs pa yi/ /dam chos 'jig tshe gang zhig gis/ /nyin dang mtshan du 'dzin byed pa/ /de ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /chos 'jig dus na chos 'dzin pa/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes rab gnas pa/ /nga la des ni mchod pa byed/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa'i tshe/ /ston pa'i bstan pa sung byed pa/ /bskal pa bye ba stong rnams su/ /de ni nam yang rgyad mi 'gyur/ /lus kyi bde ba myong 'gyur zhing / /de ni nad kyis btab mi 'gyur/ /de ni yid du mi 'ong bas/ /nam yang 'phrog par mi 'gyur ro/ /ston pa'i bstan pa bsrung byas na/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs 708wa 764

pa dang / /des dang gsal dang mnyen pa dang / /sems can rnams la byams sems 'gyur/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /bde dang dga' thob mdzod ni mang por 'gyur/ /sngon gyi rim gro bye ba 'thob 'gyur zhing / /mi khom brgyad po ma lus zad par spong / /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /dper na nam mkha' skar mas yongs gang ltar/ /rtag tu mtshan gyi go char byas pa dang / /rab tu tshig snyan yid 'ong dbyangs ldan 'gyur/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /gang na yid bde med cing rab sdug pa/ /rigs ngan de ni de yis spangs par 'gyur/ /phyug cing shin tu bde la longs spyod ldan/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /mthu dang stobs dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus ldan/ /mi dman pa rnams kun tu rnam par rgyu/ /sangs rgyas brgya stong dag la bsnyen bkur byed/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /mchog tu rab mdzes gzugs ldan shes rab ldan/ /mi yi 'jig rten mchog tu bsnyen bkur 'gyur/ /rgyal po mkhas pa mdzangs pa rnams kyis bsngags/ /'jig tshe rgyal ba mchog gi chos bzung bas/ /mchog tu gzugs mdzes blta na sdug pa dang / /skyes pa bud med lha rnams dga' bar byed/ /bde zhing mkhas la bsngags shing shes rab ldan/ /ston pa stobs bcu mnga' ba lha yi lhas/ /gang gi mdun du mdo 'di rab bshad pa/ /mi 'di'i lag tu mdo sde 'di 'dra 'di/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe na thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gser 'od dam pa las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu yang 'thor zhing nub par mi 'gyur bar byed pa de ni bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu yang dag pa yin pas bsod nams ji snyed cig thob par 'gyur ba ni bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du brjod pas kyang mthar thug par 188—765

mi 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la sogs pa gang la la zhig /mchod pa dang bkur sti byas nas yi ger bris te rgya cher spel ba dang / gzhan dag la yang dag par ston par byed pas thob pa'i bsod nams gang yin pa de'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang du 'byung ste/ mdor na/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ste sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yis bsams pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan las 'das zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po thob/ /ces sangs rgyas kyi bka' ji snyed pa lta zhog /yi ge 'bru gcig 'dzin pa dang / 'bri ba dang / klog pa dang / bkur sti dang / ri mor bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi mtha' nam mkha'i tshad kyis kyang gzhal bar dka' bas/ 'di phyi gtan gyi 'dun ma thams cad kyi rtsa ba de'ang gcam bu'i tshig tsam ma yin par/ don la gnas par sangs rgyas kyi bka' tshad ma dag las gsungs so//de ltar dgos pa dang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhi dam par gyur pa'i bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma 'di ni/ dus thung tshegs sla ba'i sgo nas 'grub pa ma yin par/ de yang bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa pho stag gi lo'i (spyi lo 1998)lo mjug nas dbu brtsams pa dang / de'i yar sngon du rgyal phyi nang kun tu bka' 'gyur gyi par gzhi khag mang po 'tshol sdud byas shing / thog mar tshodape sdur dang /rim gyis ma phyi'i yi ge rnams glog klad rtsis 'khor du 'jug pa/ de nas por zhus dang dpe sgrig /rtsis len dang bskyar zhib/ zhus chen dang rting zhus/ thang ga 'bri ba dang 'gyig shog mngags pa sogs bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma 'di'i las rim 108—766

mtha' dag la/ gzab nan dang zhib tshags kyi sgo nas gtan la phab cing par zhus kho nar lan grangs du mar song ste chad lhag nor bslad kyi skyon tsam yang med par/ kun gyis yid ches pa'i gnas su bsgrubs te rnam dkar gyi bya ba rlabs po che 'di'i mjug yongs su 'khyol bar byas so//des na thog mar dbu brtsams pa nas deng gi bar lo ngo hril bo bcu lhag gi ring la las gnas 'dir dngos su zhugs shing / bya ba 'di legs 'grub yong bar 'bad brtson chen po gnang ba'i dbu 'dzin dang ched las mkhas pa/ shes brtson gnyis ldan gyi gzhon skyes las grwa pa thams cad kyang lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin lta bur gyur yod pas na/ 'dir de dag gi mtshan tho smra ba la/ dbu 'dzin gyi phyogs nas/ 'ba' pa bkra shis tshe ring / rgyal mo 'brug pa/ gzan dkar sprul ba'i sku thub bstan nyi ma/ sprul sku lcags la bu phrug /dge shis tsa rdo rje/ bkra dga'/ gzhan dpal rdor/ tshangs po/ mdo sde mgon po sogs dang / zhus chen pa'i phyogs nas/ gcan tsha'i 'gyur med/ ma grong dge 'dun/ btsan lha ngag dbang / dpa' ris kun dga'/ las grwa pa rnams yul phyogs kyi dbang du byas na/mtsho sngon gyi phyogs nas/ kun bzang nam mkha'/ tshe ring bsam 'grub/ bstan 'dzin grags pa/ mkhar byams thar/ byams pa dge legs/ dge 'dun phun tshogs/ 'brug mo skyid/ ban+de 'tsho/ sha bo sgrol ma/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab/ o rgyan tshe ring / khams 'ba' thang gi phyogs nas/ lhun 'grub/ bkra shis nyi ma/ blo bzang chos 'phel/ dge phrug /ngag dbang 'phrin las/ bsod nams bkra shis/dar rgyas/ dbang 'dus/ ngag dbang tshe ring / ye shes chos sgron/ g.yu sgron/sgrol dkar/ tshe ring lha mo/ blo bzang don 'grub/ 'phrin las/ lhag pa/ chos 188—767

rgyal/ bkra shis don 'grub/ rgyal mtshan/ 'gyur med/ khams sde dge'i phyogs nas/ kurma tshe dbang / kurma dag pa/ bsod nams nyi ma/ thub bstan dge legs/thub bstan legs smon/ 'jam bzang / dkar sgang / 'chi med sgrol ma/ rdzogs chen chos 'phel/ dbang phyug /nor bu rgyal mtshan/ khams mgo/ blo dga'/gdams ngag /rig 'dzin rdo rje/ rdo rje tshe ring / dkon mchog chung ba/ 'jam rdor/ bstan 'dzin/ pad mtsho/ chos mtsho/ 'chi med sgrol dkar/ 'jam dbyangs lha mo/ dkon mchog /dkar mdzes phyogs nas/ bskal bzang bstan 'dzin/ phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ lha mo tshe skyid/ tshe ring mkha' 'gro/ dbang phyug phun tshogs/ byams pa rin chen/ byams pa bstan 'dzin/ thang rnyed/ 'jam dbyangs bzang po/ rnga pa'i phyogs nas/ dkon bkra/ 'jam blo/ tshe dbang / 'phrin las 'od zer/ kurma stobs ldan/ rgya mtsho/ lha mtsho/ bde dar tshe ring / bkra shis 'byung gnas/ 'jigs don/ mi nyag phyogs nas/ 'jam dpal shes rab/ kun dga' chos 'phel/ bsod nams bkra shis/ rdo kho/ kun bzang mkhas grub/ rta'u phyogs nas/ 'phrin las blo 'phel/ rig 'dzin dbang mo/ mkha' 'gro lha mo/bstan 'dzin tshe ring / mkhas grub/ tshe brtan/ bkra shis rab 'phel/ rong brag phyogs nas/ rdor chung / rig 'dzin nyi ma/ 'jam dpal/ dge mchog /rig don/rgya mtsho thar/ bkra shis phun tshogs/ rig bho/ shar pa'i phyogs nas/ shes rab dbang ldan/ rnam 'brug /ser shul phyogs nas/ nyi 'bum/ tshe ring skyabs/ brag mgo'i phyogs nas/ 'brug chung / bkra shis/ gser rta'i sgrol ma skyabs/ kun lho'i gtsos sangs rgyas mkhar sogs khyon bsdoms mi ngo zhal grangs brgya dang sum cu lhag gis/ dus ring thung ci rigs kyis mdo rgyud kyi glegs bam mang po'i phyi mo (192—768

zhib par dpe sdur dang par du bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po 'di dang /las gnas 'dir dngos dang brgyud nas rogs ram gnang mkhan kurma bde legs dang / blo gros phun tshogs sogs lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'brel gang thogs pa thams cad dang / tha na rnam par dkar ba'i las 'di la dga' ba dang / rjes su yi rang byed pa tshun gyi skye bo mtha' dag gi dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa de dag chud mi 'dza' ba'i ched du/ ji skad du/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma skems bar du de mi skems/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi zad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rang dang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de dag kyang rang gcig pu dang theg pa dman pa'i thar pa tsam kho na'i ched du ma yin par/ mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad gtan gyi btsan sa byang chub chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur ba'i ched du/rang cag thun mong nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis kyis yongs su bsngo bar bya ste/ 'di ltar/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang kun tu bzang po gnyis kyis ji ltar smon pa de ltar du 'grub par gyur cig /smras pa/ shes nyon spros pa'i chu 'dzin stug po gdod nas dag pa nyer zhi'i 188wa 769

dbyings/ /'od gsal phyogs kyi mkha' las ldang ba'i nyin byed snang ba 'bar ba'i sku/ /zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rtse dgas srid zhi'i snying la bde legs kyi/ /ya mtshan ri mo 'bri ba'i byed po khyod zhabs ral pa'i rgyan du len/ /lho phyogs ri las thon pa'i bsung zhim gyi/ /ngad pas phyogs kun 'gengs pa'i dga' ston ltar/ /brtse chen zla ba stong gi 'od zer gyis/ /'gro kun snying la bsil ba yang yang 'bebs/ /don gnyis rin chen 'dod 'jo dbang gi rgyal/ /khams gsum zhi bsil phun tshogs kun gyi dpyid/ /bden bzhi'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i za ma tog /rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba 'dren pa'i shing rta nyid/ /zhi bde'i srog gi ka ba 'dzugs pa'i sman/ /rgyal gsung bdud rtsi'i 'o mtsho 'gyur ba'i sprin/ /mdzad 'phrin sbrang ma'i char zegs re re yang / /phan bde myu gu skyong ba'i dpal gyis khengs/ /e ma srid 'dir yid bzhin nor gcig pu/ /thub pa'i gzhung bzang gser gyi lhun po ste/ /'di las gzhan du thar pa'i skas bzang zhig /mo gsham bu yi lang tsho'i mched zla nyid/ /'tshe med zhi bde drod kyi snying po can/ /nyin byed dbang po mkha' la gsal mi gsal/ /mi bzad nyes pa'i sprin nag mthar byed pa'i/ /byams dang brtse ba'i rlung bu ldang la rag /ut+pal bsung zhim 'thor ba'i skyed tshal du/ /sbrang rtsi'i thig le ring nas 'du byed kyang / /yun ring gti mug klong du 'byams pa yi/ /khron pa'i sbal par tshor rtog ci yang med/ /deng yang bka' gsung glegs bam ngo mtshar brgya/ /nyi zla'i do shal bzhin du gsal na 'ang / /dug gsum khrag gis 'dren byed dmar ba dag /dus dang skal bas nongs bzhin mthong mi 'gyur/ /gtsug lag smra ba'i 'gyur khugs bag la zha/ /'dod yon bshang gci'i ro la rjes su chags/ /bstan pa 'dzin par khas 'che dug sbrang khyus/ /rang gzhan bslu ba'i 1192—770

tshul la mchi ma dku/ /'on kyang phan bde bsil ba'i snying po can/ /lung rtogs rtsibs ma brgya pa'i gdugs dkar po/ /bshad sgrub dpung pas 'dregs pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /mang du bzhugs 'dis dad spro ci yang 'phel/ /khyad par snying rje'i dbang phyug li khri'i mtshor/ /skye rgya'i mig gi bdud rtsir bltams pa'i gzugs/ /gang gi legs bshad 'od rdul phra mor yang / /che rgya'i gtsug gis mdud la glo ba dga'/ /legs byas mu tig zhu ba'i 'o mtsho yang yang bsrubs pa'i dpal las 'khrungs/ /legs tshogs ku mud dgyes pa'i rten du sngo bsangs 'chi med lam du byon/ /legs gsungs snang ba dkar po'i rnam 'phrul dus kyi mchod sdong bsil zer can//legs bris gtsug gi rgyan du ma bzhugs rkang gnyis 'gro ba'i dpal du shar/ /skal bzang gzhon nu'i lhag bsam rā ma ṇas/ /tshogs bsags gzhu rgyud stong las shor ba'i mda'/ /mi mthun 'bod grogs snying la bsnun pa dang / /don gnyis sī ta 'gugs byed 'di rmad byung / /srid pa'i dra ba dum bur gcod pa'i mtshon/ /dam chos gser gyi ral gri rnon po can/ /skye rgya'i blo gros dpung pa'i mdzes rgyan du//nam yang nyams pa med pa'i dpal du bzhengs/ /lhag bsam sprin gyi bang rim dgung la brtsegs/ /'bad brtson rlung bu'i 'phrul 'degs phyogs su g.yos/ /legs byas kha ba'i bye ma spungs pa'i rir/ /yi rang zla ba'i 'od kyis bklubs gyur cig /sna tshogs grub mtha' rgyu skar bzhin 'tsher yang / /gtan bde'i lam bzang ri dwags mtshan ris can/ /thub pa'i ring lugs chu shel dbang po la/ /dad dam gtsang mas sri zhu 'di tsam bgyis/ /'di yi legs spyad nyin byed dmar po'i rdul/ /skye rgya'i snying gi pad+mor sim pa dang / /bde skyid sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar 'bum chags te/ /dga' spro'i snyan glus phyogs kun khyab par shog /ngo mtshar chos srid a mra'i 188wa 771

ljon bzang rdzogs ldan bzhin du mkha' la dkrigs/ /mdo sngags chos tshul gser gyi rdza rnga 'jig rten mtha' dbus med par rdung / /bshad sgrub chos kyi mtsho mo gang zhig lung rigs rlabs kyi rtse dga' 'dzin/ /e ma chos nor sde bzhi'i lang tshos go la'i khyon 'dir mdzes gyur cig /zla shel me tog bzhad pas ri klung mdzes/ /sngo ljang g.yu rlabs rgod pas 'khor yug gtsang / /las kyi ri mo bkra ba'i bsil ldan ljongs/ /zhi ba'i bsti gnas chen por 'gyur bar shog /nang na 'byor pa chu bo'i gter bzhin 'khyil/ /bar na btsan brjid gser gyi ri rab mtho/ /phyi na snyan grags g.yu 'brug skad kyis 'phur/ /btsan phyug dpal gsum rtag tu 'dzoms gyur cig /dkar dmar nyi zla'i 'od khyim gcig gi ngogs/ /gling lnga'i 'gro ba mdza' mthun zam pas sbrel/ /'tshe med zhi ba chen po'i lam bzang du/ /bde blag bgrod pa'i skal bzang mngon 'gyur shog /bsod nams sprin dkar bzhad pa'i 'dab zur nas/ /lhung ba'i dge bcu'i sbrang char bsil ma 'dis/ /'gro kun gdung ba'i tsha rlabs nyer bcom ste/ /bde chen byang chub myu gu smin par shog /bden gnyis zung 'jug me yi 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /sgrib gnyis bud shing thal bar bsregs pa dang / /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes gter/ /sku gnyis zung 'jug nor bu'i dpal thob shog /lung rtogs sbrang rtsi'i bcud bzang yongs 'khyil pa'i/ /thub bstan 'dab brgya 'dzum pa'i pad+ma dkar/ /nyi zla'i snang ba ma 'gags de srid du/ /skye rgu bung ba'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan gyi me tog sku yi bkra shis gzhom gzhig rnam bral mig gi bdud rtsi'i 'od khyim mdzes/ /'gags med rdo rje dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gsung gi bkra shis lha yi rol mo stong ldan 'gyur khugs rna ba'i dpyid/ /zag med ye shes mchog 108wa 772

gi me long thugs kyi bkra shis nyi ma'i gzi byin shes bya'i mkha' dbyings kun khyab pa/ /gsang gsum mdzad 'phrin 'o mtsho'i mthu las grangs med skye rgu'i sdum pa yangs por dge legs nor bus phyug gyur cig /ces bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba las/ par du bsgrubs pa'i dgos pa dang phan yon sogs kyis mjug bsdu ba'i skor brjod pa ste/ skabs lnga pa rdzogs so// //de ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dpe gzhi khag cig bsdur cing zhus nas par du bsgrubs pa'i tshul las brtsams pa'i gtam dkar chag zla ba nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba skabs lnga'i bdag nyid can 'di ni/ spyi lo nyis stong lo'i zla dgu par bka' 'gyur dpe sgrig gi dbu rtsom skabs/ 'di ga bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi dbu khrid rnam pa nas thugs brtse chen pos/ bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zhig khyod kyis 'bri dgos zhes bzlog med kyi gsung sgros spyi bor phebs pa dang du blangs te/ yul reb gong rig pa 'byung ba'i grong khyer gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo lha sde'i dge 'dun bstan 'dzin mchog gi gsung gi bdud rtsi myangs pa'i skal ba can/ ldong nge'i bstan 'dzin grags pa'am ming gzhan ldong chu shel du 'bod pas/ las mang sne 'dzing gi zhor du bka' 'gyur gyi pod re re'i dbur chos tshan de'i le'u rab byed brtag pa nang gses sa bcad dang 'gyur byang sogs rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zhig gcig gyur gyis gtan la phab nas bris shing / slar yang de dag ji lta ba bzhin dkar chag chen mo 'dir bkod de/ the tshom can dang mi gsal ba'i rigs la zur mchan dang bcas deng rabs kyi lugs dang mthun par/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i 108wa 773

nu/ lo sngi za'i lo'i khrims stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa dang por/ gnas ri glang chen 'gying ri'i nye 'dabs/ sngon 'phags pa chos 'phags kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas su grags pa/ ma hā tsi na'i ljongs kyi grong khyer chen po khrin tu'u spos ldan du mjug rdzogs par bris pa 'dis kyang / sa'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad bde dga' mi zad pa'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //oṃ/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa/ he turnye ṣān/ ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñca yo/ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swā hā// //

bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos dngos dang brgyud nas gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud kyi bka' dang / 'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyis bka' yi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos rnams 'jig rten gyi mig gcig tu bsngags pa'i lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis/ yul gangs can pa'i skad dang yi ger bsgyur ba rnams la bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur zhes mtshan du gsol/ 'di dag ni rang re bod kha ba ri pa rnams kyis nang bstan rig gnas nyar tshags dang phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i rin chen kun 'dus shig yin par ma zad/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod khrod kyi rin thang bral ba'i nor bu zhig kyang yin/bka' bstan 'gyur bod du dar ba'i rjes su bod kyi mkhas dbang bgrang gis mi langs pas 'tshol sdud dang zhus dag mdzad de/ gser bris dngul bris mtshal bris snag bris sogs bka' bstan bris ma shin tu mang po bzhengs shing de mtshungs kyi dkar chag tshad ldan sna tshogs brtsams/ de nas sngon rjes su g.yung lo dang /wan li/ 'jang ngam li thang / snar thang / pe cin/ sde dge/ co ne/ rwa rgya/ sog khu re/zhol/ wa ra/ chab mdo sogs su shing brkos bka' 'gyur par gzhi rnam grangs bcu gnyis byung ba dang / pe cin/ snar thang / sde dge/ co ne sogs nas bstan 188—775

'gyur shing brkos par gzhi khag bzhi byung / bka' bstan 'gyur gyi par gzhi khag rnams chabs cig tu mtshon par yong phyir/ mdo sngags rig gnas thams cad la mkhyen rab kyi klong brdol ba'i mkhas mchog dam pa/ mchog sprul rin po che thub bstan nyi ma lags kyis gros gzhi bton pa ltar/ rgyal khab kyi thugs khur dpag med gnang ste 'gro gron dngul 'bor chen btang zhing / krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyis rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rlabs chen po bka' bstan dpe bsdur ma dpe sdur gyi sgo nas par du bskrun pa'i las 'gan phrag tu bzhes/spyi lo 1987lor krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyis khrin tu'u grong khyer du bka' bstan dpe sdur khang btsugs te/ krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi spyi khyab las 'dzin rdo rje tshe brtan sogs dbu khrid zur pa rnams dang / spyi khyab las 'dzin lhag pa phun tshogs sogs dbu khrid rnams kyis 'go khrid dang thugs khur rgya cher gnang zhing / bod kyi rig gnas gong 'phel skor la mdzad rjes khyad du 'phags pa can/ bod rig pa smra ba'i mkhas dbang dam pa/krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi spyi khyab las 'dzin pa gzhon pa 'ba' pa bkra shis tshe ring gis bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi 'gan 'dzin gyi 'gan khur te rlabs chen gyi bya ba 'di'i thog mtha' yongs la 'go khrid dang slob ston gnang / dbu khrid dang mkhas dbang gcig lcogs mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma rin po che nas las gzhi 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi slob ston dang / ma dpe 'tshol bsdu/ zhu chen gyi mdzad pa bla lhag tu bskyangs/ mkhas dbang dam pa dpe war mchog sprul 'chi med rdo rje dang / si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig zhu chen pa ma grong dge 'dun/ lho nub mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan 788—776

chen mo btsan lha ngag dbang tshul khrims/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig zhu chen pa 'gyur med sogs kyis rgyun bzhugs zhu chen dang blo ston pa mdzad/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gi 'gan 'dzin dang rtsom sgrig zhu chen pa rgyal mo 'brug pa lags kyis/ bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi rgyun las 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa'i 'gan 'khur te khrin tu'u dang pe cin phyogs gnyis kyi bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma dpe sdur dang / dpe sgrig /dpe skrun las don spyi bye'i bkod 'doms dang / srid 'dzin zhabs zhu bsgrubs/krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi zhib 'jug pa gzhon pa rgyal rong rdo rje dang / krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi zhib 'jug pa gzhon pa bkra dga' sogs kyis sngon rjes su/ bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa'i 'khur bzhes te/ srid byed las ku'i skor la 'bad brtson lhod med byas te grub 'bras legs po byung yod/dar mdo'i rdo rje brag dgon pa'i sprul sku zhib 'jug pa gzhon pa lcags la bu phrug lags kyis gtsos gzan dkar mchog sprul rin po che dang dpe war mchog sprul rin po che sogs kyi rogs ram la brten/ rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu bka' bstan par ma dang bris ma'i ma dpe 'tshol sdud byas te grub 'bras mi dman pa bzhag /gzhon skyes mkhas pa dpal rdor lags kyis bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi rtsom sgrig khang gi gtso 'gan 'khur nas bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma rtsom sgrig dang zhu dag gi las ka yun ring bsgrubs te rtsom sgrig khang gi byed sgo bde blag tu 'grub par bya rgyu'i thad la nus shugs yod rgu bton/ rtsom sgrig zhu chen pa gzhon pa tshangs po lags kyis khrin tu'u dang pe cin nas rnam dkar gyi bya ba 'di'i dbu 188—777

tshugs pa'i 'char 'god las ka nas mjug grub pa'i bar gyi dpe sdur dang / dpe sgrig /dpe skrun gyi las ga'i gtan 'bebs zhib zhus kyi rkang 'dzin mdzad/ lhag bsam mtshungs med mdo sde mgon po lags kyis rtsom sgrig khang gi spyi'i 'gan khur ba dang / ldong nge'i bstan 'dzin grags pa lags kyis dbu chen dpe sgrig pa'i 'gan dang bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i dkar chag chen mo gsar sgrig gi 'gan khur/ kun bzang nam mkha' lags kyis dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa'i 'gan khur nas dpe sdur dang / dpe sgrig /rtsis len sogs kyi zhabs phyi mdzad/lhag par 'di ga bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis snga phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po dmu dge bsam gtan dang / dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las/ nyan shul mkhyen rab 'od gsal/ 'jam dpal phun tshogs/ mi nyag mgon po/ rtsa ra chos kyi grags pa/ pad ma skal bzang / lu'u lis khyon/ khro ru tshe rnam/ bstan 'dzin/ chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs/ blo bzang lhun grub rdo rje/ dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/dbal shul rdo rje dgra 'dul/ shes rab 'od zer/ bsam 'grub rgya mtsho/ nags tshang byams pa ngag dbang / har ba 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ bstan 'dzin don grub/ skal bzang 'gyur med/ 'brug phrug /dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ lo ren tshang / zla ba blo gros/ don grub rdo rje/ go 'jo dbang 'dus/ 'phrin las chos grags/ sher grags/ kun dga'/ rdo rje bkra shis/ kurma bde legs/ shes rab bzang po/ bsod nams don grub/ bum sgrub blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ thub bstan phun tshogs/ bdud 'dul/ ye shes dar rgyas/ blo bzang rdo rje/ skal bzang dam chos/ mkhan po dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ dam chos tshe ring / shes rab/ ngag dbang dam chos bcas mkhas dbang mang dag cig 108—778

bka' 'dri zhu yul du gdan 'dren zhus te/ khong rnam pas sku dngos dang yig thog nas dge mtshan ldan pa'i slob ston dang dgongs 'char gnang mdzad pa ni rnam dkar gyi bya ba rlabs chen 'di phun sum tshogs par 'grub pa'i nus pa gtso bo zhig yin pa smos ma dgos pa yin no/ / 'dir phangs pa'i ngang nas dmigs bsal zhu dgos pa zhig ni/ las ka gzhi rgya che zhing / dus yun ring ba'i las gzhi chen mo 'di'i dbu khrid gtso bo gnang mkhan 'ba' pa bkra shis tshe ring dang / mkhas dbang lhag bsam mtshungs med rdo rje rgyal po/ ma grong dge 'dun/ nyan shul mkhyen rab 'od gsal/ mi nyag mgon po/kun dga' sogs mkhas dbang mang po zhig dgongs pa zhing gzhan du gtad zin pa ni skyo dgos pa'i gnas shig yin na'ang/ da lta nga tshos khong rnam pa'i thugs bskyed bzhin bka' bstan dpe sdur dang / dpe sgrig /dpe skrun bcas kyi bya ba mtha' dag legs grub byung yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni/ khong rnam pa'i thugs sems dgyes byed kyi maṇ+ḍal rin thang bral ba zhig yin pas nga tsho la sems gso dga' 'os pa zhig kyang skyes byung /gzhan yang snga phyir bod khul sa gnas so so nas bod kyi rig gnas spel bar thugs mos ldan pa'i na gzhon shes yon can brgya phrag la nye ba bsdus pa la dge rgan rnam pas dpe sdur dang rtsom zhus skor gyi slob khrid byas pa dang / de dag gis lag len dngos kyi thog nas sbyong brdar byung ba'i dbang gis/ khong tshos bka' 'gyur dpe sdur dang / glog klad rgyag pa/ rtsom sgrig dang zhu dag rim pa can byed pa/ mjug tu rtsis len bya ba sogs dpe skrun gyi byed sgo mtha' dag rang tshugs thub par gyur te/ da lan rnam dkar gyi bya ba rgya chen po 'di bsgrub par nus 188—779

shugs bton yod par ma zad/ slad mar bod kyi rig gnas dpe skrun gyi bya ba gong 'phel gtong bar rgyab snon gyi dpung sde zhig gso skyong byung yod/da dung sku zhabs sa dbyi h+pho lags kyis deb kyi mdzes cha'i jus 'god dang /yon tan tshe ring dang bu rgan gnyis nas deb kyi mdzes ris bris/ lha bris pa 'jam bzang gis bka' 'gyur dpe bsdur ma 'di'i dbu lha'i skor mjug rdzogs par bris pa bcas so/ /rting mar rlabs chen gyi las gzhi chen po 'di'i sbyor ba'i sta gon nas bya ba las kyi 'khor lo dngos su bstar ba dang mjug legs par grub pa la thugs khur dang / rgyab skyor/ 'bad brtson chen po gnang mkhan gyi rim pa khag gi dbu khrid dang mkhas dbang / las bzo yongs rdzogs la lhag bsam zol med kyis gus 'dud dang thugs rje che zhu zhu/ krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang nas/2༷ ༷ 8lo'i zla 9tshes 22la/

deb brgya dang brgyad pa/krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis rtsom sgrig byas/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/zhin hwa dpe tshong khang pe cin 'grem spel khang gis bkram/bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/pe cin ta yun ho par 'debs 'gan tshad kung sis dpar btab/spyi lo 2008lo'i zla 9par par gzhi dngapo bsgrigs/spyi lo na//bye/sdi sa 9paX/ /sa shāng ༷ btab/1525978—720/shārdo53—126—0
